description.zh: 本課程主要針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變），材料之強化機構與方法。
description.en: This course is a basic topics of  Materials Science.

notes: 選材資系 (材料) 必修，餘 3 系選修

description.zh: 資源工程導論為資源工程的入門學科，其範圍包括天然的金屬、非金屬、礦物與石油、天然氣、建築用砂石、石材與水等原生資源，以及工商業及一般生活的廢棄物或其附帶產生的可再生資源。期對初學者有一整體的基本概念。
description.en: This is a general introduction class to provide student basic knowledge about resources engineering which include metal, nonmetal, minerals, petroleum, natural gas, aggregates, dimension stone and water resources.

notes: 選材資系 (資源) 必修，餘 3 系選修；材資一乙和工程一合開

description.zh: 基礎生物化學，是從認識動、植物和細菌細胞到脂質、蛋白質和 DNA 和醣類構造及其功能關係。
description.en: This course introduces animal, plant and bacterial cells and the basic structural of protein, DNA, RNA, lipid and carbohydrate.

notes: 選分子系必修，餘 3 系選修；分子一和工程一合開

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

notes: 請選：體育室 \ 體育專項

description.zh: 本課程提供大一學生必備之英語文語言技巧，強調專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分，並整合英語文之聽、說、讀、寫之能力，提升英語文在專業領域的應用。
description.en: This course equips first-year students with essential English language skills, focusing on developing their communication abilities in specific professional fields. The content is customized to each college's discipline and integrates the four language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing), thereby enhancing the application of English in professional contexts.

notes: 請選校院級課程 \ 大一學院專業英文 (五)

description.zh: 本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。     奠基於大學之前 12 年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en: This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life. Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 各學院指定向度學分規定如下：機電學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、創新與創業向度課程 4 學分。電資學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、自然與科學向度課程 4 學分、創新與創業向度課程 4 學分。工程學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、創新與創業向度課程 4 學分。管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、自然與科學向度課程 4 學分。設計學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、創新與創業向度課程 4 學分。
description.en: The dimension credits stipulated by each college are as follows：CMEE：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.EECS：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the nature and science curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.College of Engineering：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.College of Management：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the nature and science curriculum.College of Design： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.CHASS：4 credits for t

name.zh: 學院指定向度 - 人文與藝術
name.en: College designated dimension curriculum：Humanities and Art

description.zh: 本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: ■	第一年：以建築設計的基礎為範疇。訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        ■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  ■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
description.en: This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:■ First year: foundations of architectural designTraining of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architectureBeyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.■ Third year: Urban architectureFocus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings■ Fourth year: Graduation projectCultivating ca

notes: 黃宏裕師配合 USR 計畫建築一和創意一合開 (限主修建築系

description.zh: 本課程中學生可以了解建築的一般材料的特性和建築構造的原理，我們強調那些與組件組成相關的知識，學生可以在他們的設計工作中使用這些知識。
description.en: In this course student can understand the property of general material of building and the principles of building construction, we stress those knowledge related with component composition, that student can used in their design work.

notes: 建築一和創意一合開 (限主修建築系選課)

description.zh: 以傳授設計原理、平面及立體設計觀念、美的形式原理、平面及立體的構成練習、對各種材料特性的應用經驗以及造形與色彩的研究達到設計感覺的養成並提高計畫性創造能力，是發展實用性及機能性以前之設計訓練的基礎。
description.en: This course aims to develop the ability of students to meet specific sensory needs through the creation of abstract visual order in the form of two-dimension and three-dimension. The visual organization of design elements including line, plane, volume, and the analysis of their abstract relationships and principles of order are studied.

description.zh: 以手繪與數位平行並進，訓練學生三維思考、設計與表達呈現的能力。
description.en: Introduce both freehand and computational techniques in visual representation. Develop abilities in 3D thinking and comunication.

description.zh: 掌握形式從屬機能旨意，熟悉施作技術限制與創意可行性，學習從設計到實作的落實，透過各種機械設備操作、加工技術學習，實際接觸及操作真實材料，了解材料種類、性質、加工過程、組裝知識、技術與美學等，以呈現設計作品之原型與成品。
description.en: Based on “Form follows Function”, student will learn interacts and limitations among technology feasibility and creative application, in order to master sequential implementations form design ideas to real works. Students are required to operate various mechanical equipment and processing technologies, thus to realize the types and nature of the materials, processing procedure, as well as the assembly of knowledge, technologies and aesthetics to format intended design prototypes and establishments.

description.zh: 應用設計手繪工具與技法於各種設計作品圖面呈現，培養學生對空間、形體、材質、介面、裝置、比例等簡潔繪畫技巧與圖示性設計圖表達能力。
description.en: Students will learn to sketch by hand in various tools and technologies on design drawings. The simple painting tips as, spatial perceptive, presentation of form and materials, interfaces media types and installations, and proportion as well as abilities of the infographic design presentation will be taught in this class.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹程式設計的基本概念和技術，以及人工智慧的發展和應用。課程內容涵蓋程式語言的基本語法，以及人工智慧的基礎觀念與理論，並藉由編程練習及 AI 工具操作來進一步了解人工智慧應用以及程式設計的潛在應用。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental concepts and techniques of programming, as well as the development and application of artificial intelligence. The course content covers basic syntax for the programming languages, along with the fundamental concept theories of artificial intelligence. Through programming practices and AI tool manipulations, the students can gain a further understanding of the artificial intelligence application and the potential application via programming.

name.zh: 程式設計與人工智慧導論
name.en: Fundamentals of Programming and Artificial Intelligence

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC 模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

notes: 需修習本課程始可畢業

description.zh: 本課程內容分二部分進行授課，第一個部份以小組進行校園建築進行實測後，繪製平、立、剖面圖，以加強學生團隊合作，並透過實際量測與繪製建築平、立、剖面圖，使學生感受實體與練習之關係；由於目前臺灣多以集合住宅建照申請居多，且住宅為空間尺度之根本；因此，第二個部份之課堂操作，依序為浴廁、臥室、廚房、餐廳、客廳單元等不同空間尺度練習後，聚焦於住宅平面圖之練習；接著，透過住宅平面圖之練習，衍伸至立面圖與剖面圖與透視圖練習。課程亦將藉由同學上述二個部分之練習，延續第一學期建築製圖基本常識、觀念與技法之傳授，以確實增進學生建築製圖能力。 本課程符合系教育目標如下： 1. 訓練學生建築設計與工程基礎專業能力； 2. 透過實作方式彙整建築設計與建築構造之技能； 3. 引導建立建築專業道德倫理態度； 4. 整合建築理論與實務提升就業競爭力。
description.en: This course will need the knowledge from the previous course Architectural Graphics (1) and apply them into graphics; The course have two parts, first part of the course will split the class into small groups ,students will first measuring the school buildings and than draw them into three-dimensional diagrams. Second, lecture the detail graphics of residential building such as the floor plan, bathroom, bedroom, kitchen etc. and more drawing practice on cross section graphics and elevation graphics. During the semester Introduction to graphics will enable the students ready for second semester. After this course the students will acquire the following aspects: 1). Advance knowledge in architectural design and engineering. 2). Practical skill in architectural design and structure. 3). Correct attitude in architectural professions moral. 4). Integrate theory an

notes: 建築一和創意一合開 (限主修建築系選課)

description.zh: 本課程主要在教導學生對西方 (歐洲及西亞) 認識歷史建築之演進過程與思考涵構，並使學生具備西方文化歷史與思想的相關知識，其主要授課內容如下：1. 在範圍上 -- 自古埃及、西亞、而收至古典建築、基督教建築、中世紀的大教堂時代以至文藝復興及 17、18 世紀的建築歷史。2. 在思想上 -- 自希臘的文化與哲學思想談起，以至各時代之政治、宗教與社會文明之演進，瞭解歷史涵構及其對建築的表現。3. 在建築上─針對每一時期的建築表現，瞭解其構造方法、材料應用及相關細部特徵。
description.en: This course is mainly to teach students the evolution process and connotation of historical buildings in the West (Europe and West Asia), and to equip students with relevant knowledge of Western culture, history and thought. The main teaching contents are as follows: 1. In terms of scope-- From ancient Egypt, West Asia, and the collection to classical architecture, Christian architecture, medieval cathedral era, Renaissance and the architectural history of the 17th and 18th centuries. 2. In terms of ideology-from the Greek culture and philosophical thought, to the evolution of politics, religion and social civilization in various eras, understand the historical connotation and its expression on architecture. 3. In architecture—according to the architectural performance of each period, understand its construction method, material application and related detail features.

notes: 建築一和創意一合開 (限主修建築系選課)

description.zh: 前言：本課程主要為介紹現今主要名家與重要學派之設計理念與其實踐狀況，授課採講演與研討方式進行。內容：瞭解設計相關理論與方法。 瞭解設計之方法與課題。 瞭解設計研究之寫作與閱讀方法。 方式：由授課老師依不同時期，介紹所屬領域之理論、方法及參考文獻。授課方式，採講義、討論、參觀及邀請演講等方式綜合進行。為
description.en: he content of this course is to introduce the design philosophy and implementing skills of contemporary noted architects and major schools. This course will be carried on by lecturing and seminar.

notes: 建築一和創意一合開 (限主修建築系選課)

description.zh: 本課程主要針對目前之軟體來調查並學習如何在三度空間表現、模擬、動畫、掃瞄及虛擬實境的運用。
description.en: The utilization of computer-aided visualization techniques through the use and investigation of commercially available software for photo-realistic rendering, lighting simulation, animation, scanning, raster graphics and virtual reality.

description.zh: 設計的溝通扮演著如何將設計理念成功地傳達以及讓使用者清楚的理解設計本意的重要角色。本課程將透過設計思考過程藉由文字、口說、圖面等達到設計溝通之目的及訓練，經由了解設計領域應用之文字搭配口說及圖面進而增進設計者說明設計概念的溝通能力。課程內容包含設計溝通的基本原則、技巧及策略，以及如何利用不同的溝通媒介及工具來傳達設計理念。課程操作包含案例分析搭配實際的簡報演練及口說訓練讓同學們累積應用經驗。
description.en: Design Communication plays an important role in how to successfully deliver design concepts and have users understand the design intention clearly. This course will practice and reach the goal of design communication through design thinking by vocabulary uses, verbal speeches, and image presentations.  From understanding the proper application of design language including vocabularies and diagrams in various design fields, designers may improve their skills of concept presentation and communication.  The course content includes basic principles, techniques, and strategies in design communication as well as how to use different media and tools to deliver design concepts.Course activities include case studies with presentation practice and oral speech to help students have experiences in actual application.

notes: 創意一、工設二、互動二合開 (請排 50 人以上教室)

It is based on the practical application in the future work and life. Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 各學院指定向度學分規定如下：機電學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、創新與創業向度課程 4 學分。工程學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、創新與創業向度課程 4 學分。管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、自然與科學向度課程 4 學分。設計學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、創新與創業向度課程 4 學分。人社學院：社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、自然與科學向度課程 4 學分、創新與創業向度課程 4 學分。修完學院指定向度課程 12 學分，剩餘 6 學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業 18 學分。
description.en: The dimension credits stipulated by each college are as follows：College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.College of Engineering： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.College of Management： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the nature and science curriculum.College of Design： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.

name.zh: 學院指定向度 - 社會與法治
name.en: College designated dimension curriculum：Social and Rules of Law

description.zh: 本課程主要以人文學的研究方法為主，使修課者對人文學科之研究方法有基本的認識，熟悉資料蒐集、分析與詮釋的方式，以及培養研究的能力，並應用所學，在課程期間完成一份研究報告。以歷史學門為例，其課程內容包括學科的定義、史料的蒐集與辨別能力，歷史的詮釋，及歷史研究的侷限性等等問題。
description.en: This course is primarily based on the research methods of humanities. Students who select this course will have a basic understanding of the research methods of humanities. Besides, they will be familiar with the mode of data collection, analysis and interpretation, moreover, their capacity of doing research will be trained up. They have to finish a research report by applying what they have learned during this course. Take the history as an example, this course includes the definition of the subject, the interpretation of the history, and the limits of historical research. Besides, students will also learn how to collect and identify historical data in the course.

description.zh: 本課程旨在讓學生瞭解管理學基本概念，奠定紮實的理論根基，使其具備分析、處理實際問題以及開創的能力，進而能應用於文化事業經營，以利往後修習進階課程訓練的基礎。本課程主要內容包含管理學概論、管理在企業組織的功能、現代化的組織設計、組織領導與策略規劃、執行與績效考核、企業經營職能、企業的 e 化管理、非營利事業管理、企業的外在環境 (政府文化創意產業政策)、創業管理、企業的社會責任等。本課程特色在於進行每個單元時，均輔以國內外文化創意產業有關的個案，以利學生理解。
description.en: This course presents the basic concepts and processes of management for students with cultural vocation development majors. Topics will include: the introduction to management, managing and the manager's job in an organization, modern organizational design, leadership and strategic planning, implementing and controlling , organizational effectiveness and performance, function roles of organization, e-business management, non-for-profit business management, external context of business (the government policy on cultural and creative industries), entrepreneurship management, corporate social responsibility etc. Students will develop skills and knowledge related to the manager function and required in the field of cultural creative industries. This course can also provide a basis for understanding the managerial implication of related cases in cultural creative industries. The featured course: each unit of this course will be facilitated by cultural and creative industries-related cases.

notes: 文發一和創創專區合開

description.zh: 本課程是為大一學生所開的課程，它同時結合了美學與藝術史的討論。美學是一門研究人類感性知識的學科，與藝術史的發展息息相關。本課程嘗試在東西方平面藝術及其作品的討論中，融入東西方美學思想和審美意識，使美學與藝術史能夠相互印證。並希望課堂上的同學們能將課堂的內容化為文化創意的元素。
description.en: This course is for first-year students, combines aesthetic and art discussions. Aesthetics is a discipline that studies human perceptual knowledge and closely related to the development of art history. This course attempts to integrate Eastern and Western aesthetic ideas and aesthetic consciousness into the discussion of Eastern and Western art and its product, so that aesthetics and art history can corroborate each other. Expect that students in the classroom can turn the content of the class into cultural and creative elements.

description.zh: 文化史課程以台灣各地的文化變遷為主。本課程授課內容，是透過物質生活 (衣、食、住、行)，集體生活 (社會、政治組織)，精神生活 (文學、藝術、哲學、宗教信仰) 等之介紹，讓學生對台灣文化有更進一步的認識與了解。授課方式以口頭講授為主，討論及書面報告為輔，使得上課方式更為生動與活潑。
description.en: The course of History and Culture mainly focuses on the evolution in terms of culture that takes place in every part of Taiwan. The contents of this course including the introduction of material life (clothing, food, housing and transportation), collective life (society, politics, and organization), and spiritual life (literature, art, philosophy and religious belief). Students will obtain further cognition and acquaintance about Taiwanese culture. The teaching mode is by giving students a lecture orally, and students have to discuss and hand in written reports. The teaching style is more vivacious.

description.zh: 本課程旨在探究文化與科技的關係，以及科技社會結構如何影響我們的思考。在科技與社會快速變化的過程中，課程將帶領學生發掘科技創新的可能性，這也促使許多文化實踐需重新思考，以適應此刻以媒體驅動的社會，以及如何將它們被應用於策展、文化活動和相關的創作中。本課程亦涉及科技本質上的探索，以了解它如何與文化變革密切相關，包括人文、社會科學、虛擬創作、人工智慧、數位典藏、媒體藝術和媒體傳播等面向上。
description.en: The course examines the relationship between culture and technology and how tech-social structure works to shape our ideas. Exploring the possibilities of technological innovation in rapid change, many cultural practices need to be rethought and reworked for a further media-driven society and how they are adopted into curating exhibitions, cultural events, and related productions. The course also addresses the nature of technology in general to understand how it is linked closely with cultural change, in terms of humanities, social sciences, virtual contents, artificial intelligence, digital archives, media art, and media communication.

notes: 計網電腦教室

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC 模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

notes: 需修習本課程始可畢業

description.zh: 學習邏輯思考的目的在於幫助我們培養一種邏輯能力，使我們能夠邏輯理性地以語言進行思考。要達成上述目的，我們首先要了解語言做為一種符號的內在邏輯架構。我們要明白什麼是概念、與概念所指涉的對象、與概念具備的意義和觀念；然後，語句的性質，包含其真假值，它們與字詞和概念的關係。之後，如何用語句去建構論證。為了建構論證，我們要學習傳統的歸納法、三段論法、自然演繹法的基本推論規則與自然語言和形式語言之間的翻譯。總之，我們要會在生活中如何理性地思辨問題並有效地與他人溝通。課程講授將配合一些心理測驗、課堂遊戲與電影教學。
description.en: The purpose of learning “Logical Thinking” is to help us acquiring a kind of ability in virtue of which we will be able to think logically and rationally.  To achieve that goal, we need to know the innate logical structure of our language.  That means, we will need first to grasp the essence of concepts including their reference, meaning, and ideas. Then, we shall study the essence of sentences including their truth-value and the relations with words and concepts.  After that, we shall learn how to establish a sound argument. For that purpose, we plan to study induction, syllogism, basic rules of inference in the method of natural deduction in quantificational logic, and translation between natural and formal language.  In a word, we will be able to speculate problems in our life rationally and communicate with others effectively.   The lecturing of the course will mix with psychological texts, games and practices in the classroom, and scientific films or regular movies.

notes: 上限 30 人

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

notes: 請選：體育室 \ 體育專項

description.zh: 本課程提供大一學生必備之英語文語言技巧，強調專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分，並整合英語文之聽、說、讀、寫之能力，提升英語文在專業領域的應用。
description.en: This course equips first-year students with essential English language skills, focusing on developing their communication abilities in specific professional fields. The content is customized to each college's discipline and integrates the four language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing), thereby enhancing the application of English in professional contexts.

notes: 請選校院級課程 \ 大一學院專業英文 (四)

description.zh: 本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。     奠基於大學之前 12 年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en: This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life. Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

description.zh: 各學院指定向度學分規定如下：機電學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、創新與創業向度課程 4 學分。電資學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、自然與科學向度課程 4 學分、創新與創業向度課程 4 學分。工程學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、創新與創業向度課程 4 學分。管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、自然與科學向度課程 4 學分。設計學院：人文與藝術向度課程 4 學分、社會與法治向度課程 4 學分、創新與創業向度課程 4 學分。

name.zh: 學院指定向度 - 人文與藝術
name.en: College designated dimension curriculum：Humanities and Art

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1. 極限與連續，2. 導數及其應用，3. 不定積分與定積分，4. 超越函數及其反函數，5. 積分法則，6. 不定型與瑕積分，7. 定積分的應用，8. 空間幾何與向量微積分，9. 偏導數，10. 重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 介紹程式語言設計的基本概念，包含基本輸入與輸出、程式的流程控制、函數的應用等指令之撰寫、程式之編輯、編譯、聯絡與程式之執行，並發展一套應用程式。並加強實務程式製作。
description.en: This course introduces the basic data processes of C++ language. They include input/output, program process control, application of functions, program editing and execution, and so on.

description.zh: 學習經濟理論的基本觀念，涵蓋個體與總體經濟學相關議題，包括市場如何運作，市場與福利，公共部門經濟學，廠商行為與產業組織，勞動市場經濟學，總體經濟學資料，長期實質經濟，長期貨幣與物價，開放體系的總體經濟學，短期經濟波動等主題。
description.en: This course provides the basic concept of economic theory, including microeconomics and macroeconomics. The topics are as follows: how markets work, markets and welfare, the economics of the public sector, firm behavior and the organization of industry, the economics of the labor market, the data of macroeconomics, the real economy in the long run, money and prices in the long run, the macroeconomics of open economics, and short-run economic fluctuations.

description.zh: 本課程可使學生瞭解：貨幣與資金市場、投資問題、如何取得資金與運用資金、使公司價值最大、使股東權益最大化、瞭解代理制度、瞭解公司股票、債務之利用，股利政策等事項。
description.en: This course has provided: money and capital market、Investments 、How to obtaining and using funds、Maximize the value o their firms、How to maximize stockholders' stock、To know agency problem 、To know the price of the firm's stock, use of debt and dividend policy.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹企業的管理系統如何有效的計畫、設計和分析及實行，包括管理系統的分析、可行性研究、系統設計、系統發展、雛形設計、測試、文件製作和評估等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to provide the students with a broad understanding of information systems, information technologies, information systems development and management in business and other organizations.

notes: 新聘專任教師

description.zh: 本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。課程內容包含（一）勞作教育理念介紹。（二）勞作教育實作。（三）課堂討論與反思。（四）期末成果分享。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

notes: 需修習本課程始可畢業

This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

The content is customized to each college's discipline and integrates the four language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing), thereby enhancing the application of English in professional contexts.

description.zh: 本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。     奠基於大學之前 12 年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en: This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life. Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

name.en: College designated dimension curriculum：Humanities and Art

description.zh: 本課程旨在瞭解設計的基本要素與美的形式原理，應用各種媒材的特性與構成，從平面及立體的構成的實作練習中，激發出設計美感與創造力。透過「使用者 — 產品 — 環境」三者間互動關係的深入探討，掌握住視覺傳達與多媒體的基本語彙，作為互動設計的基礎，創造出全新的體驗與感受。
description.en: The course is to prepare students for understanding the basic elements of design and the form and principle of art. To achieve these goals, the course provides opportunities for students to apply characteristics and compositions of diverse media for the form of two-dimension and three-dimension in practice. Also, the course arouses student’s design aesthetics and creativity. To explore the context of user-product-environment, students understand visual communication and multimedia language as a basis of interaction design toward completely new experiences and sensation.

notes: 限本系生 73 人，轉 / 復生需先修過基本設計 (一) 才可修此課

description.zh: 本課程旨在為互動媒體脈絡提供學生創意思考與企劃故事腳本，使學生瞭解互動媒體實務運作時，最前端的構思與規劃所需要的知識與技能，以及與不同領域專業的溝通表達。本課程包括一系列的腳本企劃、使用者體驗、創意呈現，以及互動媒體企劃實務案例探討。本課程之評量是以分組討論與腳本企劃報告為主。
description.en: This course is to provide the creative thinking and story-script with the context of interactive media by which students can understand the practice of interactive media, and learn the knowledge and skill for planning and creation. The contents include a series of script planning, user experience, creative representatives and the case study of interactive media. The assessment of this course depends upon the group discussion and script planning report.

notes: 一般教室，限本系生，媒體組必修優先，限 50 人

description.zh: 色彩在藝術史的發展過程中，一直以其獨特的內在感覺邏輯與外在現實世界不停的交互進行運動，因而織就一門豐富的內在視覺感知語彙。本學期課程除延續上學期色彩調和論的介紹外，亦藉由對色彩原理、感覺與運用方式循序漸進的課堂操作，以及作品色彩操作形式的分析，讓同學能夠活用色彩成為一種造形語彙。
description.en: In the history of art, color science has made its unique The course is designed as an introduction to color harmonies following last semester and examines colors from as many ways as possible. Through progressive training and the case analysis of artworks, students learn to add colors to have their own design style.

notes: 一般教室，本系視傳組必修優先，限 50 人

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹程式設計的基本概念和技術，以及人工智慧的發展和應用。課程內容涵蓋程式語言的基本語法，以及人工智慧的基礎觀念與理論，並藉由編程練習及 AI 工具操作來進一步了解人工智慧應用以及程式設計的潛在應用。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental concepts and techniques of programming, as well as the development and application of artificial intelligence. The course content covers basic syntax for the programming languages, along with the fundamental concept theories of artificial intelligence. Through programming practices and AI tool manipulations, the students can gain a further understanding of the artificial intelligence application and the potential application via programming.

name.zh: 程式設計與人工智慧導論
name.en: Fundamentals of Programming and Artificial Intelligence

notes: 限本班生 75 人 (含微學程), 需自備筆電

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC 模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

notes: 需修習本課程始可畢業

description.zh: 在這個 e 化的時代，傳送訊息的表現手法如文字、影像、聲音、影片等都被廣泛的運用，組織這些文字、影像、聲音、影片等資料的就成了一個必須重視的課題。本課程將導覽文化創意產業之定義、起源與當前文化創意產業之背景，進而將藝術與文化產業整合於數位內容中；課程規劃重點包含建立學生對數位產品的基本認識，解說數位產品設計的流程與步驟，介紹數位產品設計的方法。
description.en: In the electronic age, text, image, sound, and video are all widely used; organizing this data has become an important issue. This course focuses on the definition, origin, and background of cultural creativity. The curriculum includes building a basic understanding of digital products, explaining the process and procedures of how digital products are designed, and introducing the design methods for digital products.

notes: 一般教室，限 50 人

description.zh: 介紹多媒體各項基礎技術，包括文字、圖像、影像、動畫與音訊，以及各項技術的整合應用。
description.en: This course introduces the elements of multimedia design, including text, graphics, video, animation, and audio, as well as the applications of the integration of those elements.

notes: 限本班生 71 人修

description.zh: 本課程將提供學生學習包括 2Ｄ平面設計及 3Ｄ造形模擬基礎電腦輔助設計軟體程式之應用要領、傳輸介面及其週邊設備之規劃，並配合上機實習，以培養學生互動設計圖像製作的基礎。
description.en: This course will provide student in the field of interaction design the application skill, principle, planning, limitation and conversion techniques of 2D/3D graphic design by using computer-aided design software package.

notes: 互動一和互動外生一合開，限本班生 30 人

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年 (一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年 (一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1. 極限與連續，2. 導數及其應用，3. 不定積分與定積分，4. 超越函數及其反函數，5. 積分法則，6. 不定型與瑕積分，7. 定積分的應用，8. 空間幾何與向量微積分，9. 偏導數，10. 重積分，11. 級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is aimed directly at the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: (1) 草繪。 (2) 基本特徵、3D 實體零件設計。 (3) 工程特徵、3D 實體零件設計 (4) 3D 零件組裝 (5) 工程製圖
description.en: (1) Sketching. (2) Basic features, 3D part design. (3) Engineering features, 3D part design. (4) 3D part assembly. (5) Engineering drawing

notes: 計網電腦教室，限 40 人

description.zh: 本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。課程內容包含（一）勞作教育理念介紹。（二）勞作教育實作。（三）課堂討論與反思。（四）期末成果分享。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

notes: 需修習本課程始可畢業

description.zh: 概論，熱力學第一定律，理想氣體及純物質，熱力學第二定律。本課程之學習目標是要學習熱力學基本觀念。內容包含物質熱力學特性、改變能量形式之基本原理、熱力學第一定理、熱力學第二定理、封閉系統與開放系統的能量與質量分析、熵增定理、可用能、蒸汽動力廠等。
description.en: The learning objective of this course is to learn the basic concepts of thermodynamics. Contents include material thermodynamic properties, basic principles of changing energy forms, the first law of thermodynamics, the second law of thermodynamics, energy and mass analysis of closed systems and open systems, the entropy increase theorem, available energy, steam power plants, etc.

notes: 限專班學生

description.zh: 修本課程之學生必須是已經具備國手身分，學生必須每星期至少 5 天至訓練單位或企業實習。不但可以專心參加選手訓練，同時可以修實習學分。修此課程，必須事先提出申請，經由技優專班辦公室核准。
description.en: Students who take this course must already have a qualification for the WorldSkills International Competition. Students must go to the training unit or the business for an internship at least 5 days a week. You can not only concentrate on participating in player training, but you can also take internship credits. To take this course, you must first submit an application, which is approved by the Office.

notes: 限本專班入圍正取國手的學生參加。

description.zh: 本課程將邀請專家學者以專題演講方式，介紹電力工程之最新科技與應用。研究生亦被安排報告其研究計畫與進度。參與者透過密集討論、書面報告、或舉行口頭發表等方式，可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的認識。
description.en: This course will introduce the latest technology and application on the power engineering via seminar. Speakers are the Well-known scholars and specialists. Graduate students will also be arranged to report their graduate studies. The participants are encouraged to have intensive discussion, written reports, or further oral presentation. Efficient opinion exchange would be also expected to derive more extensive interest.

notes: 甲組

notes: 乙組，請協助安排先鋒教室

Renowned researchers and scholoars are invited to share their research results and experience through extensive discussion.  Furthermore, all students in this course are required to make formal presentations on their specialized topics.

Renowned researchers and scholars are invited to share their research results and experience through extensive discussion. description.zh: 硬體描述語言介紹、FPGA 製作、特殊應用積體電路設計、CMOS 邏輯電路設計與合成、數位電路時序調整、比較器、取樣保持電路、參考電壓與線性轉導電路、基本信號轉換電路介紹、數位類比轉換電路、類比數位轉換電路、超取樣轉換電路、鎖相迴路設計、雜訊與不良匹配分析等單元。
description.en: Verilog and VHDL, FPGA, ASIC, Combinational logic gates in CMOS, Timing issues in digital circuits, Comparator, Sample and Hold, Voltage reference, Translinear circuit, Data converter fundamentals, Nyquist-rate DAC, Nyquist-rate ADC, Oversampling converters, PLL, Noise and Mismatch.

notes: 電機所和半導體碩班合開

description.zh: 此課程包含以下主題：(1) 直流馬達、伺服馬達、及永磁交流馬達的建模、控制系統設計與模擬，(2) 馬達速度及位置觀測器設計與模擬，(3) 數位控制及驅動器設計與模擬。
description.en: The contents of this course include: (1) Modeling, control system design, and simulation of DC motor, servo motor and permanent magnet synchronous motor. (2) Motor speed and position estimator design and simulation. (3) Digital control and driver design and simulation.

name.en: Design and Simulation of Electric Machine Control Systems

description.en: Image processing, Visual tracking of mobile robots, Eye-in-hand visual servoing of mobile robots, Eye-to-hand visual servoing of mobile robots, Mobile robotic SLAM, Visual tracking of manipulators, Eye-in-hand visual servoing of manipulators, Eye-to-hand visual servoing of manipulators, Final project proposals and presentations, Final project implementation and demonstration, Final project reports.

notes: 電機所。半導體碩班。創新 AI. 機械自動化和電資外生班合

description.zh: 培養學生使用多通道波束形成器技術應用在降噪、降混響，並使用 Matlab 撰寫多通道語音增強演算法。學生可以學習到: 1. 空間取樣概念。2. 延遲相加波束形成器技術。3. 最小變異無失真響應波束形成器技術。4. 線性限制最小變異波束形成器技術。5. 廣義旁辦消除波束形成器技術。6. 多通道維也納濾波器降噪降混響技術。7. 線性卡爾曼濾波器結和廣義旁辦消除波束形成器技術。
description.en: Students will learn to use multichannel beamformer techniques and Matlab for speech enhancement. Students will learn: 1. Spatial sampling concept. 2. Delay-and-sum (DAS) beamforming technique. 3. Minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) beamforming technique. 4. Linearly constraint minimum variance (LCMV) beamforming technique. 5. Generalized sidelobe canceller (GSC) beamforming technique. 6. Multichannel Wiener filtering for denoising and dereverberation. 7. Integrated sidelobe cancellation and linear prediction Kalman filter (ISCLP)

description.zh: 本課程程主要為介紹深度學習和生成式人工智慧概念和基本原理。通過掌握這些原理，學生能了解可能極限，更能思考深度學習和和生成式人工智慧的應用。
description.en: This course mainly introduces the concepts and basic principles of deep learning and generative artificial intelligence. By mastering these principles, students can understand the limits of what is possible and be better able to think about the applications of deep learning and generative artificial intelligence.

name.zh: 深度學習和生成式人工智慧導論
name.en: Introduction to Deep Learn and Generative Artificial Intelligence

description.zh: 此門課程的主要目標，將介紹數位多媒體晶片設計，讓學生對於數位多媒體晶片設計有深入的認識與了解，進而產生濃厚的興趣與設計能力。
description.en: This course covers theoretical foundations and applications in digital multimedia IC design. The outline of this course is given as follows. 1. Introduction 2. Digital IC Design3. Color Science4. Multimedia System   a. Image and Video Coding  b. State-of-the-art Image and Video Coding Standards (industry)  c. 3D Video System  d. Holographic System5. Multimedia IC Design Methodology

notes: 電子所和半導體碩班合開

description.zh: 本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。目的二，進一步教授 ESG 及聯合國 SDGs 指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。最後，透過對於 ESG 與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en: The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

notes: 工管碩、博和管理博合開，碩士班請選此課號

description.zh: 為取得工學碩士必修課程，3 至 6 個學分需先經系所核可。
description.en: For the degree of Master of Engineering 3 to 6 credits with department approval.

notes: 碩士班

description.zh: 此課程旨在以人為本，研究互動系統之設計與評估。使學生了解人類認知過程之理論與模式以及其工作與環境之特性，並使學生能應用設計程序與評估方法來提升系統之績效。
description.en: This course focuses on the design and evaluation of interactive systems from a human centric perspective. Students will learn about the theories and models of human cognitive processing with the consideration of task and enviroment characteristics; and students will learn how to apply design processes and evaluation techniques for improving system performance.

notes: 配合 USR 計畫

description.zh: 機器視覺檢測乃結合光學設備 `影像處理` 與電腦輔助計算處理，藉由擷取受測物影像之特徵進行後續各種應用 (如檢測 ` 辯識等)。 為確保機器視覺應用之精確度及速度，受測物影像必須依用途進行不同前處理以突顯特徵，後以不同之演算法則判斷之擷取特徵是否符合應用要求。 機器視覺近年來大量使用於各產業，除提昇製造業之產品品質外，對人身安全認證之生物科技亦功不可沒 。
description.en: Machine vision has been extensively used in inspection and biometrics in recent years. This course provides the fundamentals and practical applications of machine vision for graduate students. Increasing the knowledge and capability in machine vision for a well-trained industrial engineer is the final goal of this course.

name.en: The Principles and Applications of Machine Vision

notes: 工管四甲乙、工管所合開

description.zh: 本課程主要分成三部分。第一部分介紹工業機器人的結構，分類和其工作空間等基礎。第二部分介紹機器人的端效器、語言指令及其控制系統和安全。最後再介紹機器人如何與系統相整合，以執行功能性的製造單元 (或製造系統)。
description.en: This course basically is composed of 3 parts. First, configuration, classification and work cell of the industrial robots will be introduced. Secondary, end-of-tooling, programming & instruction, control system controller and safety is covered. Finally, the robot and system integration to execute a functional manufacturing cell (or system) will be provided.

description.zh: 這是一門研究所課程，內容包括多元數據分析和高等回歸應用。本課程的目標是確保工業工程與管理領域的研究生能夠解釋、實現和操作幾種不同類型的基本回歸分析。本課程主要致力於高等回歸分析。重點是發展一個嚴格的微積分計算及矩陣代數為基礎的最小平方法 (OLS)、違反回歸假設、假說檢定及一般線性模型。此外，本課程的重點是協助學生理解分析技術這部分的領域知識，如：統計的基本概念 (描述和推理統計，概率分佈)，簡單線性回歸、多元線性回歸、邏輯回歸及對數線性模型之應用。
description.en: This course covers multivariate data analysis as well as advanced regression applications. The course is primarily devoted to advanced regression analysis. Th? emphasis is on developing a rigorous calculus and matrix algebra-based understanding of ordinary least squares (OLS), violations of regression assumptions, hypothesis testing, and the general linear model. In addition, the emphasis of this course is on the acquisition and understanding of analytical techniques such as basic concepts of statistics (descriptive and inferential statistics, probability distributions), simple linear regression, multiple linear regression, logistic regression, log-linear model.

notes: 2 週【停開】

description.zh: 本課程提供學生對於專案管理之主要原則與專案排程實務，並學習運用專案排程管理軟體工具。本課程探討專案管理與排程實務課題，包括專案之需求、經理、工作團隊、溝通、排程管理、預算、成本控制等，並學習專案排程管理軟體工具。
description.en: The course objective is to introduce students about key principles of project management and the use of project scheduling software.This course discusses the factors necessary for the successful project management.  Topics include project management concepts, needs identification, the project manager, teams, project organizations, project communications, project planning, scheduling, control and associated costs.  Project management software tools will be an integral part of the course.

description.zh: 論文指導教授與醫師協商讓學生於在學期間的寒暑假到論文研究相關醫院進行實習。
description.en: Advisor in consultation with physicians suggest the student to practice at the hospital related to the thesis research during the winter and summer vacations at school.

notes: 馬偕醫院上課；限丙組學生

description.zh: 本課程主要在講述醫學工程基本觀念，內容包括解剖學及生理學、生物力學、復建工程及輔具科技、生醫材料、組織工程、生醫電子系統、生醫感測系統、生醫訊號處理、生醫影像處理、生醫超音波、生醫光學及雷射。
description.en: This course mainly introduces the basic concepts of  Medical Engineering, including anatomy and physiology, biomechanics, rehabilitation engineering and assistive device technology, biomaterials, tissue engineering, biomedical electronics, biomedical sensing systems, biomedical signal processing, biomedical image processing, biomedical ultrasound, biomedical optics and laser.

notes: 丙組必修

description.zh: 讀書報告、專題討論、機電系統產品介紹與討論、Seminar 心得等。可重覆修習。
description.en: Case Study, Mechatronics in Industry, Seminars.

notes: 綜三演講廳

description.zh: 硬體簡介、影像處理 (單色、彩色、3D 及即時)、圖案識別 (Patten Recognition)、機械視覺於順序控制之應用、機械視覺於回授控制之應用、高速檢測、機械人與機械視覺之結合及應用。
description.en: Introduction to Hardware of Vision System, Image Processing (Monochrome, Color, 3D and real-time), Pattern Recognition, Application of MV to Sequential Control Application of MV to Feedback Control. High Speed Inspection, Combined Applications of Robotics and MV.

notes: 計網電腦教室，限 50 人；甲◎

description.zh: 深入探討最新的 IC 製程技術，包含前段的加熱、離子植入、物理沈積、化學沈積、微影、蝕刻等製程，及後段的各種封裝技術及測試方法，並介紹其研究方向、製程與元件物理的關係及製程整合的技術。
description.en: Study the state of the art of the IC fabrication processes, including heating, ion implant, PVD, CVD, lithograph, etching of the front-end processes and packaging and testing of back-end processes. The trends of the processes, the relationship of the processes with the physics of the devices and the process integrating technology will also be taught in this course.

notes: 限 25 人，甲、乙組選修

description.zh: 在諸多工程應用實例中，如 LED、晶片之散熱問題、流體在能源系統中之熱交換、燃料電池衍生之熱問題等，都與材料之規格選用、處理方法、加工方式、製造過程有明顯的相關性。本門課程主要針對材料工程與熱管理相關的技術問題，提出探討與對策，期使學生對熱管理在材料與系統工程上的應用提供適當的專業知識。
description.en: In engineering applications, such as LED, chip cooling, heat exchange in energy systems, fuel cells, are always comes with the problems of thermal generation. Meanwhile, manufacturing process and heat treatment of these products are also strongly dependent of the selection of material specifications. The purpose of this course would like to employ practical problems and lead the students in finding appropriate solutions or technical approaches to solve the related problems they could meet.

The related equipment and apparatus applied in the biomedical engineering field will de be introduced. The course will also include current news to the students for expanding their knowledge in the biomedical engineering field. This course is an introductory course. The students who are interested in this field are welcomed to attend this course.

description.zh: 顆粒物質充斥在日常生活且廣泛應用在許多工業問題中，例如筒倉、流體化床以及積層製造等等。本概論式課程將提供學生顆粒物質流的基礎概念以及模擬方法，並對其實際應用問題能有更深入的了解。課程將從顆粒物質的基本流動特性開始介紹，進而介紹顆粒物質流的離散模擬方法。此課程最後一部分將實際展示在工程上以及工業上所遇到的顆粒物質流問題。
description.en: Granular materials are ubiquitous in our daily lives and have attracted growing interest in many industrial applications, such as silo storage, fluidized bed, additive manufacturing, etc. This course is an introductory course to provide the general concepts and simulation methods of granular material flows, and a comprehensive understanding for its applications. The course will start from the basic flow characteristics of granular materials, and then move to the discrete simulation approaches. The final part of this course will demonstrate the practical engineering and industrial problems of granular material flows.

description.zh: 積層製造技術 (又稱三維列印) 在近十年來試圖改變整個製造技術的生態，已不再是原型的製造與小量生產，它已經達到符合經濟生產效益的經濟規模製造方法。雖然積層製造以加工方法可分為七大分類，但以工程材料分類則以金屬為最具經濟價值與工業應用最為廣泛。因此，本課程主要以金屬積層製造的方法為出發點，說明可以列印金屬的加工方法，以縮短學術與工業應用的距離。在本課程中，也說明金屬三維列印件的材料選用、列印件的設計考量、加工參數優化、列印件的使用壽命檢測、與數值模擬等。修習本課程後，學生可以了解：1. 金屬積層製造方法的原理與材料限制 2. 金屬列印件的設計考量、前處理與後處理 3. 各種列印方法的加工參數設定與其對列印件的影響 4.ASTM 規範金屬列印件的巨觀測試方法與微觀檢測方法 5. 金屬列印件的輕量化拓樸結構優化設計與分析 6. 金屬積層製造的數值分析方法
description.en: Additive manufacturing technology, also known as 3D printing, has attempted to revolutionize the entire manufacturing ecosystem over the past decade. It has evolved beyond prototyping and small-scale production, reaching an economically viable scale for mass production. Although additive manufacturing can be categorized into seven major types based on processing methods, when classified by engineering materials, metals hold the highest economic value and are the most widely applied in industrial settings. Therefore, this course primarily focuses on metal additive manufacturing methods, explaining the processes that enable metal 3D printing, and bridging the gap between academia and industry. The course also covers material selection for metal 3D printing, design considerations for printed parts, optimization of processing parameters, life time testing of printed parts, and numerical simulation.After completing this course, students will understand and can briefly explained:1. description.zh: 本課程之目標為依人力職能需求，參考國內外之先行經驗，整合智能化生產所需之知識與技能訓練，以淬鍊出一套務實之智能化生產課程。本課程將涵蓋工業 4.0 - 智能化生產所需相關基礎技術之教學與實作課程，包括物聯網基礎技術與應用實例、雲端服務系統與資訊安全技術、巨量資料管理、分析、及應用實例、智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用、自動化與機器人技術及應用等等。

This course will cover the topics related to the basic technology required for intelligent production, including the basic technology and application examples of the Internet of Things, the cloud service system and information security technology, the huge amount of data management, Intelligent enterprise and factory management systems and applications, automation and robot technology and applications, and so on.

The next two chapters describe the engineering options currently available for the synthesis, processing and fabrication of nanostructured materials. The last two chapters deal with different application of nanostructured materials.

description.zh: 工程進度規劃與控制是營建工程進行專案管理時之重要知識與技術，此課程包含 ADM 及 PDM 網圖、要徑分析、PERT 分析、趕工計畫、及實獲值分析等理論知識，同時也會結合工程進度控管軟體應用技術。本課程目標意在培養同學具備工程進度規劃與控制觀念知識，並透過專案練習及軟體操作讓同學具備工程進度規劃與控制能力。
description.en: Construction project scheduling and control is necessary and important for effective management of construction projects. The course introduces the major concepts and methods for construction project schedule scheduling and control. The course includes plan and analysis of ADM and PDM networks, analysis of critical paths,, plan for catch-up, introduction of PERT and earned value analysis methods. The course will teach students the major concept and methods of construction project scheduling and control. Furthermore, the course will enhance students abilities and techniques integrated with project practices and project schedule software uses.

description.zh: 本門科目主要為介紹隨機震動學基本理論、頻譜分析與小波分析理論。主要的授課內容涵蓋基本統計理論、隨機訊號定義、期望值與相關函數、傅立葉轉換及快速傅立葉、功率頻譜密度函數、頻譜分析、非定常訊號判斷、基礎小波分析等。配合結構動力學，本科目亦講授結構系統受到隨機外力作用而產生之結構反應的頻率域動力分析應用及小波分析應用等範例。
description.en: This course is designed to introduce the basics of random vibration, spectral and wavelet analysis. The schedule includes those topics such as fundamental theories of statistics, definition of random signals, expectation and correlation functions, Fourier transform and F.F.T., power spectral density, spectral analysis, non-stationarity judgement, and basic theories of wavelet analysis. To harmony with Dynamics of Structures, this course also introduces examples of dynamic analysis of structural systems excited by random loadings in the frequency domain and applications of wavelet analysis.

name.zh: 隨機震動學與時頻分析
name.en: Introduction to Random Vibration and Time-Frequency-Domain Analysis

notes: 土木 205

description.zh: 資訊檢索（Information Retrieval）是搜尋引擎背後的技術基礎，以給定的查詢詞彙找出帶有相關資訊的文件，能夠處理與比較未結構化或半結構化的文字資料。在人工智慧與機器學習技術飛越成長的當代，自然語言處理（Natural Language Processing）及文本探勘（Text Mining）輔助人們在散亂的文本當中發掘有意義的資訊。傳統的資訊檢索理論在文本探勘的任務當中則扮演了重要的輔助角色，其賦與將文件以向量表達的基礎，亦即使諸多人工智慧應用能夠順利的與文本探勘任務接軌。本課程將教導修課同學資訊檢索、自然語言處理與資料探勘的理論基礎，以及各種新穎的人工智慧與機器學習應用如何取代傳統方法。並且訓練修課同學使用現成的程式語言套件來分析自己手邊的文本資料。
description.en: Information Retrieval (IR) is the process that retrieves the information which is relevant to a specific information need from a data collection. Search engine systems provides a famous example of IR applications. In recent years, with the growth of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing (NLP), many of the AI applications can help discover useful information in unstructured or semi-structured text collections, such a process is called Text Mining. The traditional IR technique also play an important role to support the AI applications. It can vectorize the texts and make it possible to compare the similarities between different pieces of text.This course aims to train the enrolled students to learn the basic concept of IR, NLP, and AI applications which are relevant to Text Mining tasks. In addition, this course also trains the enrolled students to use existing tools and software packages which can support the AI applications.

name.zh: 資訊檢索與人工智慧應用

notes: 土木 208
