description.zh: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。本課程將從專利範圍解讀開始，熟悉專利的權利範圍，然後介紹專利策略以及佈局的方向，提供專利佈局與專利策略理論及實務經驗。本課程的綱要如下：1. 專利權利項解讀 2. 專利侵權分析流程 3. 專利迴避設計要件 4. 專利策略分析 5. 專利佈局實務 6. 案例研究
description.en: Patent litigation, either initiation or defense, has become one of the industrial strategies, and more and more patent suit cases have forced the manufacturers to undertake patent design around.  In fact, the industrial fields in Taiwan, theoretically, do not feel strange on design around and patent strategies.  However, in practice, they perform much less.  That is the reason why Taiwan still has to pay more than five billion US dollars each year for royalty.  This course will start from patent claim interpretation, getting patent claims well known, then following with introduction on orientation of patent strategies, and providing theory and practice on patent strategies.  The outline of this course is given as follows:Patent claim interpretation;Process of patent infringement analysis;Requirements of patent design around;Patent strategy analysis;Practice on patent strategies; andStudy on patent cases.

description.zh: 本課程主要以實務案例之解析為內容，並結合商標法理論剖析之教學方式，來深入介紹我國商標實務上之重要爭議，讓同學了解司法實務中，如何具體適用法律、判決或學說等。此外，本課程亦將分別介紹國外相關學說理論及著名司法案例，期望同學透過本課程之修習，來培養對國內外商標法案例思辨及評析之能力。
description.en: Primary contents of this course are focused on case analyses, and its teaching method is trademark legal theories analyses in order to further introduce significant disputes about Taiwan trademark practices. Thus, students could understand how to concretely apply laws, precedents, or theories to judicial practices. In addition, this course will also introduce relevant foreign theories and well-known judicial cases to develop students’ abilities of examining and analyzing domestic/foreign trademark cases when students take this course.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹專利檢索及專利地圖的觀念，課程包含以下兩部分：一、為什麼需要進行專利檢索以及如何有效率地找到相關前案，二、如何建構專利地圖及相關資訊的應用。
description.en: The concepts of patent search and patent map will be introduced in this course. The topics of the course includes: 1. Why it is important to do patent search. 2. How to find a related prior art efficiently, 3. How to construct a patent map and exploit related information.

description.zh: 本課程下學期亦以智慧財產局頒布之「專利審查基準」為藍本，先介紹專利申請之特殊分割程序與改請程序，再就專利申請之「實體審查」部分依序說明先申請原則、發明單一性、優先權、說明書及圖式之補充與修正、更正、以及分割改請。
description.en: This course will be based on the "Patent Examination Guidelines" issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office, and introduces the special procedure for patent division application and patent conversion application according to the principle of "formality before substantive examination". Then, in the "substantive examination" section, topics such as the first-to-file rule, unity of invention, the priority of a patent application, amendments of description, claims and drawings,  division of a patent and conversion of a patent will be sequentially discussed.

name.en: Examination Guidelines for Patent and Utility Model (II)

description.zh: 本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，準備實際電機技術 (元件、電路、方法) 之專利申請案，讓同學模擬實際申請專利的過程，首先是進行專利檢索與分析，討論專利佈局的策略；接著讓同學進行專利說明書 (含申請專利範圍) 撰寫實習，模擬實際上申請各國專利之程序，然後討論之後專利答辯、領證繳費及後續維護事宜。
description.en: In this course, we will focus on the practices of the patent application in   electrical engineering technology. Students will learn how to do patent search and analysis, write specification/drawings/claims, and reply office action responses. In addition, the practical aspects of international patent application are presented. The patent filing and maintenance strategies will be also discussed in class.

name.en: Practice of Electrical Engineering Technology Patent Application

description.zh: 本課程主要為台灣專利申請之文件，其相關的主題包括：專利之檢索、專利文件之閱讀，以及專利申請書、說明書、申請專利範圍與圖示等之撰寫。
description.en: This course focuses on the prosecution for Taiwan’s patents. The topics will include patent search, reading and drafting about patent specification, claims, figures and son on.

description.zh: 「心靈的理論與實踐」(The Theory and Practice of the Mind) 旨在對人的心理各個層面，從不同的角度進行探討。課程將以理論講授與實際操作交替進行：我們將借重當代學術研究成果，如腦神經科學、心理學、哲學、神經生物學、社會學等等，以增進我們對人自身重要議題的認識。這些議題至少包括：心靈 (Mind)、心流 (Mental Flow)、情緒 (Emotion)、選擇 (Choice)、決定 (Decision)、感官 (Sensations)、直覺 (Intuition)、自我分析 ( Self-Analysis)、單純性 (Simplicity)、潛意識 (Subconscious)、創新 (Novelty)、洞察力 (Insight) 與意志力 (Willpower) 等等。若時間允許，我們將在課上播放相關的科學影片與電影。
description.en: The course investigates several key aspects of human mind from different angles.  To achieve the goal, we shall discuss current topics and issues on the following subjects: Neuroscience, Psychology, Philosophy, Neurobiology, Sociology, etc.  The lecturing shall proceed from reading texts to practicing subjects and methods.  And the topics and issues will include at least: Mind, Mental flow, Emotion, Choice, Decision, Sensations, Intuition, Self-Analysis, Simplicity, Subconscious, Novelty, Insight, and Willpower, etc.  We may watch some relevant scientific films and movies in the class if time allows.

name.en: The Theory and Practice of the Mind

notes: 上限 10 人

description.zh: 本課程探究文化保存的各項議題，包含有形無形文化保存的真實性、文化價值的差異與認定、詮釋與再現；同時透過國內外文化保存的實踐案例的分析與討論，思考未來文化保存的多元發展可能性。
description.en: This course aims to understand the concept of cultural preservation, and the methods of doing cultural preservation by examining different case studies in the world. Different issues related to cultural preservation are also discussed in this course, include the value and authenticity of cultural heritage, the representation and interpretation of culture, and reuse and management of cultural spaces. A creative practice of cultural preservation will be conducted in this course.

notes: 配合 USR 計畫

description.zh: 本課程是動態影像的進階課程，不以歷史性發展為課程目的，旨在探究各類影像涉及的感官經驗以及所屬的文化意義，包含藝術電影、紀錄片、實驗電影與數位影像等，進而說明以動態經驗為基礎的混合現象，其涉及的美學、文化、技術與當代性。閱讀文本涵蓋電影、媒體與視覺文化評論。
description.en: This advanced moving images course aims to exam sensory experiences and cultural significances of various cinematic forms from art cinema, documentaries, and experimental images to the digital turn of VR films and beyond. However, the goal of the course is not to be a historical survey but instead an investigation of this hybrid moment and its relationship to aesthetics, culture, technology, and modernity. Readings cover topics in film theory, media theory, and visual cultural critical theory.

name.en: Theory and Praxis in Moving Images

notes: 上限 10 人

description.zh: 透過認識紙質、纖維實驗與材質研發的單元設計貫穿、活化課程，也由此串聯課程理念。達到培育美學素養、認識材質特性、應用紙藝與纖維文化。學生可透過選修這門課，養成美學素養、材質特色認識、紙藝與纖維文化應用。課程為理論與實務之結合，包含 : 1. 文化藝術與自然科學知識之傳授。2. 創意設計實作。後者 (2) 可做為檢視學生對前者 (1) 的學習與吸收狀況。作業訓練達到二項目標 : 1. 加強產學合作，強化實務教學。2. 培育紙質與纖維創意設計人才。
description.en: With the help of curricular components of paper qualities, fiber experiments as well as R&D on raw materials, the course essentials can thus be unified and the theme vitalized. WE aim to provide the course with aesthetical principles, knowledge of the raw materials, applied paper craftsmanship and fiber civilization—which will be comprehensively instilled into the course so that the students who take the course will be equipped with a good command on them. The course is made up of both aesthetical theory and practice, including a) knowledge on culture, arts and natural science and b) innovative & creative practice, with the later utilized as criteria to evaluate to what extent the students are successfully trained. The assigned homework is set so as to: 1. Enforce cooperation between industry and academics and strengthen course materials into practice; 2. Train and discipline more design talents in paper qualities and innovation in fiber.

name.en: Paper’s Fiber Culture and Its Application

notes: 上限 13 人

description.zh: 使學生瞭解科學研究的特性、研究的類型、測量的程序與工具、資料的收集、資料的分析、撰寫研究計畫的方法，在從事管理問題之研究與探討時，知道如何正確選用適當方法，並取得所需資訊。
description.en: This course will introduce the selection of a research topic, construction of a bibliography, literature survey and data collection, and preparation of a research proposal.

notes: 科研 825

description.zh: 本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。目的二，進一步教授 ESG 及聯合國 SDGs 指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。最後，透過對於 ESG 與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en: The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

description.zh: 本課程將由個人資料保護原則開始對個人資料保護作全面性的介紹，並說明《個人資料保護法》與《個人資料保護法施行細則》如何與個資保護原則互相呼應，期使學生瞭解目前個人資料保護的管理議題與實務考量，並且說明可參考的標準與指引，以強化學生對於個人資料保護的基礎概念。藉由《個人資料保護法》及《個人資料保護法施行細則》的介紹帶入 ISO/IEC 29100 的個資保護框架、隱私衝擊評鑑 (PIA)，接下介紹 ISO/IEC 27701 個資保護實作指引等相關國際標準，本課程以實際的案例以及國際標準讓學生這對於個人資料保護有更進一步的概念與瞭解。
description.en: This course will begin with a comprehensive introduction to personal data protection principles and explain in detail the "Personal Data Protection Act" and the "Enforcement Rules of the Personal Data Protection Act". Student will learn managerial and practical considerations of personal data protection. Relevant standards and guidelines, such as ISO/IEC 29100, ISO/IEC 27701, will be discussed to strengthen students' understanding of fundamental concepts of personal information management systems (PIMS). In addition, the process of a privacy impact assessment (PIA) and its related standard ISO/IEC 29134 will also be introduced in this course. All in all, this course aims to give students a solid understanding of personal data protection through cases studies and international standards.

notes: 資財所和創新資安合開

description.zh: 本課程介紹資金管理的理論與實務應用。如何判斷一個交易系統好壞，使其不斷產生利潤？我們將從理論出發，套用在實務交易模擬上，包含單一策略、多商品、多市場、多策略的運用。本課程將以 R 語言搭配模擬。
description.en: This course introduces the theory and practice of money management. How to determine a trading system is good or bad, how to continues to generate profits in a trading system? We will start from the theory, applied to the simulation of real trading market, including single strategy, multi-commodities, multi-markets, multi-strategies. This course will be run with R language.

description.zh: 本課程將延續財務工程導論的內容，將持續在衍生性商品評價、避險以及風險控管等問題上繼續深入探討；本學期將把焦點放在股票衍生性商品與利率衍生性商品的評價與避險上，並利用 C (或 C++) 和 Matlab 兩種工具來執行 (1) 樹狀結構 (2) 蒙地卡羅法 以評價選擇權的價值。
description.en: This course will still focus on the methods for derivatives pricing and hedging, such as the evaluation of stock and interest rate options. For implementation purposes associated with the concepts introduced, such as the tree structure and Monte Carlo simulation, two programming languages for computation will be provided: C (or C++ ) and Matlab.

description.zh: 區塊鏈和數位資產是未來金融和科技領域的重要趨勢之一，本課程將介紹區塊鏈以及數位資產的基本知識與原理，並探討如何利用區塊鏈以及比特幣技術搭建新型態的金融基礎設施與永續的生態系統，內容包含 (1) 區塊鏈基礎；(2) 比特幣運作原理；(3) 穩定幣等數位資產；(4) 比特幣進階，含閃電網路、側鏈、智能合約層、永續挖礦… 等；(5) 實體世界資產 (RWA，Real World Asset)；(6) 區塊鏈分析；(7) 法規與監管… 等，為參與課程的學生建立正確的區塊鏈與數位資產的觀念。
description.en: Blockchain and Digital Asset are one of the important trends in the future of finance and technology. This course will introduce the basic knowledge and principles of blockchain and digital assets, as well as explore how to use blockchain and Bitcoin technology to build a new type of financial infrastructure and sustainable ecosystem, the content includes (1) Blockchain basics; (2) Bitcoin operating principles; (3) Digital assets such as stable coins; (4) Bitcoin advanced including Lightning Network, Rootstock, Stacks, sustainable mining...etc. (5) Real World Asset (RWA); (6) Blockchain analysis; (7) Regulations and supervision... etc., to establish a correct concept of blockchain and digital assets for students participating in the course.

notes: 哈佛 / 資財四甲、資財所合開

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹人工智慧（AI）領域包含各種機器學習的開發與實作，特別關注如何使用 Python 進行模型的開發與部屬。課程將涵蓋深度學習的基本概念、常見的 AI 框架（如 TensorFlow、Keras），並深入探討如何利用 Python 編程語言來設計、訓練與優化 AI 模型。此外，課程也將重點討論人工智慧在開發與部屬過程中需要考量的安全性問題，從資料安全與可稽核性，AI 透明度，模型加密與攻擊防範等，提供學生一套全面的安全檢核框架。學生將學習如何確保 AI 系統在實際應用中具備高度的安全性與可靠性，並瞭解如何在 AI 部屬的不同階段識別與解決潛在的安全風險。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the development and implementation of various machine learning techniques in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI), with a particular focus on how to use Python for model development and deployment. The course will cover the fundamental concepts of deep learning, popular AI frameworks (such as TensorFlow and Keras), and will delve into how to use the Python programming language to design, train, and optimize AI models. Additionally, the course will emphasize the security considerations necessary during the development and deployment of AI systems, including data security and auditability, AI transparency, model encryption, and attack prevention. Students will be provided with a comprehensive security framework to evaluate these concerns. They will also learn how to ensure the high security and reliability of AI systems in practical applications, and how to identify and mitigate potential security risks at various stages of AI deployment.

notes: 資財四甲、資財所和創新資安合開

description.zh: 本課程將介紹環境、社會和治理 (ESG) 投資的概念。ESG 投資，也稱為永續投資，是一種將 ESG 因素與基本面分析結合起來進行投資決策的投資策略。首先，我將介紹一些投資的基本概念，例如績效衡量和因子模型分析。接下來，我將介紹 ESG 因子，並從學術研究和實務觀點討論 ESG 投資。此外，我將為您提供有關 ESG 投資的另類觀點。最後，本課程將關注全球暖化和氣候變遷議題，並提供修課同學環境教育的重要概念。
description.en: This course introduces the concepts of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investing. ESG investing, also referred to as sustainable investing, represents an investment strategy that incorporates ESG factors alongside fundamental analysis in investment decision-making. Initially, I will introduce some essential concepts of investment, such as performance measurement and factor model analysis. Next, I will review ESG factors and discuss ESG investing from both academic and practical perspectives. Furthermore, I will provide you with alternative viewpoints on ESG investing. Finally, I will focus on the issues of global warming and climate change, which are critical components of environmental education.

notes: 1 週【停開】

description.zh: 本課程結合設計思考與深度學習技術，專為金融領域應用而設計。學生將學習設計思考的五個核心步驟：同理心、問題定義、創意發想、原型設計和測試，並運用這些步驟解決金融實際問題。課程內容涵蓋數據收集與清洗、特徵工程、深度學習模型構建與訓練，及模型部署與應用。學生將使用 Pandas、NumPy、Keras、TensorFlow 等工具，進行數據處理和模型開發，並通過 PBL 項目進行實務操作，體驗跨域合作的過程。課程特別強調實務應用，涵蓋信用風險評估、股票價格預測、信用卡欺詐檢測等金融案例。學生將參與多次業界專家分享和企業參訪，了解最新的行業動態和實務經驗。本課程致力於培養具備前瞻性思維、創新能力和實務操作能力的金融科技專業人才。
description.en: This course combines design thinking and deep learning techniques tailored for financial applications. Students will explore the five key steps of design thinking: empathy, problem definition, ideation, prototyping, and testing. These steps will be applied to solve practical financial challenges.The course content includes data collection and cleaning, feature engineering, deep learning model building, training, and deployment. Students will work with tools like Pandas, NumPy, Keras, and TensorFlow for data analysis and model development. The learning process is enriched through PBL (Project-Based Learning) projects, offering hands-on experience in interdisciplinary teamwork.By integrating technical skills and innovative thinking, this course aims to develop forward-thinking financial technology professionals equipped with practical expertise.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於從科學哲學層次、研究方法層次、與實際操作層次探討設計研究的本質，內容包括界定設計研究問題、選用適當的量化或質性研究方法與特定工具、研究結果詮釋、案例解析、以及論文寫作等，俾使同學具備研究之基礎觀念以及進行創作或論文寫作之能力。研究方法二強調質性研究，例如：以深度訪談以及參與式觀察法探究互動行為脈絡，課程內容包含質性研究導論、質性研究過程與步驟、質性研究設計、質性研究方法、譯碼的程序、質性資料蒐集與分析、質性研究報告撰寫、質性研究在創新設計研究上的應用。教學以課堂講授與論文研討與發表為主要方式，並以隨堂測驗、報告與分組討論與發表為評量依據。
description.en: The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at the three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and practical execution. The contents involve the introduction of defining the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis.This course provides graduate students with the ability of fundamental concept and design creation or research thesis. These research methods two focus on qualitative research with the exploration of in-depth interview and participant observation. The details of content includes introduction, research process and approaches, research design, research methods, coding scheme, data collection and analysis, writing up and implication of innovation and design. The teaching methods include lectures, paper discussion and presentation based on the course assessment of assigned project, panel discuss

notes: 一般教室，限本班生 25 人修 (非本班生勿選)

description.zh: 本課程為一延續性的專題研究，其目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: This special topic is a continuous course within two semesters. This course is to explore the fields of interaction design, interactive media and interactive art and focus on the literature study, paper discussion and case studies. With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and practice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of graduate of interactive media design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the professional of interactive media design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct a multi-disciplines learning environment which performs a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate a interactive media design project. It may execute interactive media design by wo

name.en: Special Topics on Interactive Media Design (II)

notes: 一般教室，限本班生 25 人修 (非本班生勿選)

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度，切入虛擬實境產業的各種可能性。從教育應用、設計工具以及虛擬實境遊戲設計、虛擬實境互動式動畫製作等，進行探討。
description.en: The main objective of the program is taking from the application and design perspective, cutting into the possibilities of the virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

notes: 大三 / 外生三 / 日碩 / 外碩合開，一般教室，各 13 人，自備筆電

description.zh: 本課程將透過介紹及研讀創新服務的標竿案例，以了解創新服務的本質與實質效益。學生將透過共同研討與分組實作的的方式，針對不同場域及技術的創新服務，透過資源整合的方式，提出具體的創新服務專案，並提出其評估的方法。
description.en: This course will provide the student basics knowledge and practical benefits of the innovative services through benchmark case introduction and study. Students will collaborate to each other to propose practical innovation service project proposal in the aspect of resources management, technology applications, service mechanism and associated assessment methods  in various domains.

notes: 互動日碩、外碩合開，PBL 教室，限 40 人

description.zh: 讀書報告、專題討論、機械與自動化科技相關技術及產品介紹與討論、Seminar 心得等，可重覆修習。
description.en: Case study, workshop, group discussion, seminars, mechanical engineering and automation in modern Industries.

notes: 機電博和機械自動化外生班合開

description.zh: 碩士學位論文研究與寫作。
description.en: A student must write a thesis to fulfill the partial requirements for the Master degree.

description.zh: 本課程專注於太空系統設計、驗證和確認的基本概念與技術。本課程涵蓋了任務要求、系統架構、系統貿易研究、設計優化以及驗證和確認方法等主題。學生將學習如何設計符合特定任務要求的太空系統，同時確保系統具有可靠、安全和高效的特性。本課程還將向學生介紹各種驗證和確認性能的技術，包括模擬、測試和分析。
description.en: Mission and System Design, Verification and Validation is a course that focuses on the fundamental concepts and techniques used in the design, verification, and validation of aerospace systems. This course covers topics such as mission requirements, system architectures, system trade studies, design optimization, and verification and validation methods. Students will learn how to design aerospace systems that meet specific mission requirements while also ensuring the system is reliable, safe, and efficient. The course will also introduce students to various techniques for verifying and validating the performance of aerospace systems, including simulation, testing, and analysis. By the end of this course, students will have a deep understanding of the process of designing, verifying, and validating aerospace systems.

name.zh: 任務和系統設計驗證確認
name.en: Mission and System Design, Verification and Validation

notes: 億光 405 教室，與自動化所跨所合開

description.zh: 複雜系統專案管理是一種專門用於複雜項目的管理技巧。它使用分項管理方法，來預測和了解不斷變化的應用環境，確保複雜的工程項目的品質和成本，以及確保計劃準時完成。它由深入的規劃、品質管理、問題解決、進度及準確的檢測和調整所組成，並從團隊中運用整合協調和溝通管理，確保具備競爭優勢的項目順利達成。課程中包含，複雜系統專案概念，管理能力、架構、流程、方法等。
description.en: Project management of complex systems is a management technique specifically designed for complex projects. It uses an itemized management approach to predict and understand the different application environments, ensure the quality and cost of complex projects, and ensure that programs are completed on time. This course includes complex systems project concepts, management capabilities, structures, processes, and methodologies.

description.zh: 本課程屬於影像處理的進階課程，以遙測影像為主軸，聚焦於多光譜和高光譜影像分析與處理，並將涵蓋一般日常使用的彩色影像（多光譜影像的一種），分析各自不同的差異以及所需的影像處理技術。課程內容將涵蓋多光譜和高光譜影像的基礎、各種影像於分析時所面臨的挑戰以及所需的影像處理技術，包括線性分解、資料降維與升維、光譜與空間上的特徵萃取、機器與深度學習演算法。 選修本課程的學生需要具備基礎的信號處理、機率、線性代數和影像處理方面的背景。
description.en: This is an advanced course on image processing. The main focus of this course is the analysis and processing of multispectral and hyperspectral images. It will cover the general color images as a type of multispectral image based on remote sensing for analysis of their differences and corresponding image processing techniques. The scope of this course includes fundamentals of multispectral and hyperspectral imagery, challenges in image analysis, and corresponding image processing techniques, such as linear unmixing, dimensionality reduction, spectral and spatial feature extraction, and machine/deep learning algorithms. Students are expected to have a basic background in signal processing, probability, linear algebra, and image processing prior to taking this course.

notes: 太空所和創新 AI 合開，億光 405 教室

description.zh: 太空工程實務專題課程旨在讓學生瞭解和掌握太空工程領域的實踐技能和實務知識，以及培養學生的團隊協作、問題解決和創新思維能力。學生將進行一個實際的太空工程設計項目，通過實踐瞭解太空工程的設計、測試、實施和管理流程，並透過報告、演示和評審等形式展示項目成果。通過此課程的學習，學生可以瞭解太空工程領域的最新發展，掌握相關的技能和知識，並提升團隊合作和項目管理能力。本課程可同時藉由產學合作設計進行實際演練。
description.en: The aim of the Space Engineering Practical Project course is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

notes: 億光 405 教室

description.zh: 本課程探討衛星通訊系統收發機設計，介紹衛星端與地球站通訊收發資料流。課程涵蓋的主題包括：通訊協定、通道編碼演算法、調變技術、多天線設計、軟體無線電技術、通訊數據機實現。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解衛星通訊收發機設計的技巧，並學習以軟體無線電實現通訊數據機。
description.en: This course discusses the design of transceivers for satellite communication systems and introduces the flow of data sent and received in communications between satellites and earth stations. Topics covered in the course include communication protocols, channel coding algorithms, modulation technology, multi-antenna design, software-defined radio technology, and the implementation of communication modem. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the techniques of satellite communication transceiver design and learn to implement communication modems using software-defined radios.

notes: 億光 405 教室，與電資學院低軌衛星通訊與接取網路

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在探討太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，與太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的專題演講與小組討論，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The aim of the Space Science & Technology Seminar is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

notes: 億光 405 教室

description.zh: 本課程目的為深入研究非地面通訊網路（NTN）的相關技術和應用。課程將首先介紹 NTN 的基本概念，包括其定義、特點以及在通訊領域中的角色。接著，將深入研究 NTN 網路的架構和應用，使學生了解 NTN 在不同場景中的實際應用情境。課程亦將探討 3GPP 對 NTN 網路的規劃和進展，使學生瞭解 NTN 在國際通訊標準中的地位與發展趨勢。此外，課程還將介紹不同類型的 NTN，包括各種型態的應用範疇和特點。而隨著 5G 的發展，課程也將討論 NTN 在 B5G/6G 系統中的應用和相關標準化。學生將了解 NTN 如何融入未來通訊網路的發展趨勢，以應對更高效、更智能的通訊需求。最後，課程將深入討論 NTN 的重要議題，包括安全性、效能優化和未來發展方向等方面。透過課程，學生將獲得對 NTN 技術全面且深入的理解，並具備應用和解決相關議題的能力。
description.en: This course explores the technologies and applications of Non-Terrestrial Communication Networks (NTN). Starting with the basics, it introduces NTN's definition, characteristics, and role in communication. This course then investigates NTN network architecture and applications, offering practical insights. The course also covers 3GPP's planning for NTN networks, understanding NTN's global position and development trends. Different NTN types and their characteristics are introduced, along with discussions on NTN's applications in B5G/6G systems within the context of 5G development. The course concludes with an in-depth discussion on key NTN issues, including security, performance optimization, and future directions. Students will gain a comprehensive understanding of NTN technology and the capability to address relevant issues.

notes: 億光 405 教室，與電子所跨所合開，與電資學院

description.zh: 本課程介紹系統分析的基本概念與方法，以及如何從一個系統的角度來看待和設計複雜的資訊系統，從而提高系統的效率和效益。內容包含：系統分析、系統設計、系統建置、系統運轉、系統評鑑等之實施方式及步驟。學生需要學習使用一些專業工具，如統一塑模語言、資料流圖、結構化程式設計。
description.en: This course introduces the basic concepts and methods of system analysis, as well as how to approach and design complex information systems from a systemic perspective, in order to improve system efficiency and effectiveness. The content includes implementation methods and steps such as system analysis, system design, system construction, system operation, and system evaluation. Students are required to learn to use some professional tools such as Unified Modeling Language (UML), data flow diagrams, and structured programming.

The invited speakers include well-known scholars in the engineering field and project executors from National Taipei University of Technology.

description.zh: 「鐵道車輛系統與維修基地」課程，乃為培養具有鐵路車輛分析設計及檢修技術操作能力之人員，掌握鐵道裝備設計製造、檢修的基礎知識與應用能力，具有鐵道車輛製造、檢修、運用、管理等綜合職業能力和創新精神的高素質技能型專門人才。本課程將從鐵道車輛基本結構開始介紹，並探討鐵道車輛與鐵道基礎之互制關係。而後導入各式特殊鐵道車輛設計之原理與用途，如：高速客車、傾斜式列車、自導向系統…. 等，並研討各種車型之行駛穩定性與脫軌風險計算方式。最後介紹鐵道車輛維修之概念與實務，並介紹維修基地之設計與配置，再導入先進預兆健康預防檢修法與 AR 技術於檢修之應用與發展。
description.en: This course of "Railway Vehicle System and Maintenance Depot" will cover the basic design criteria of the railway vehicle, its sub-systems and integration. We will discuss factors that affect the design, sizing, manufacturing and maintenance of the sub-systems of the railway vehicle, including their integration with other sub-systems to work as one complete train. Various factors affecting reliability, accessibility and maintainability will be addressed. Then several types of vehicle (high-speed-vehicle, tilting train, self-guide bogie will be introduced to determine the dynamic stability and derailment risk. Finally, the design of maintenance depot will be studied and the latest technologies (PHM, AR) on railway vehicle maintenance will be introduced.

Topics include big data concepts, distributed computing infrastructure, and machine learning methods commonly used in processing big data, such as neural networks, support vector machines. In addition to concept introduction, parallel programming exercises and term projects are included to help students understand the processing steps and practical tools in big data anlaytics.

description.zh: 當代都市議題經常為跨領域、開放性的複雜問題，在資料蒐集與分析上，需要整合地理空間、時間的維度；在分析與對策上，須平衡公部門、私部門、民眾等多重利害關係者的，是一門相當複雜但重要的學問。本課程從真實的都市議題出發，教導學生掌握地理空間資訊、資料分析、資料建模、資訊視覺化、策略論述等綜合能力，培養學生對於都市複雜議題的觀察與剖析，進而對真實環境提出洞見與創意。
description.en: Contemporary urban issues are complex, requiring the integration of geographical, and temporal dimensions in data collection and analysis. Balancing the interests of stakeholders like the public, and private sectors is crucial. This course focuses on real urban issues, teaching skills in geographical information, data analysis, modeling, visualization, and strategic discourse. It aims to cultivate students' ability to observe, analyze urban issues, and propose insights for real environments. It's an advanced course, requiring basic programming and GIS concepts. Through group projects, students learn API usage, geographic computation, model building, and data visualization. The course includes one midterm report and one final project report.

description.en: Mathematical logic is an important foundation of various fields in theoretical computer science. This course focuses on its applications from software/program verification to machine-checkable proofs. Through various tools like SAT/SMT solvers and proof-assistant Coq, this course will cover the following topics: proportional logic, first-order logic, satisfiability module theory, model checking and program verification.

description.zh: 本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。目的二，進一步教授 ESG 及聯合國 SDGs 指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。最後，透過對於 ESG 與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en: The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

description.zh: 光電化學即利用太陽光能源或其他光源驅使一個完整的電化學氧化還原反應，並充分使用光電催化反應後產生的電子轉換為電力，即為太陽能電池，其中有機材料、無機材料與電解質為太陽光電池反應時主要的影響因素。本課程將會介紹光電化學原理與測定，光電催化，光電化學能轉移及儲存，不同材料發展出不同型態的太陽能電池，進而介紹光電化學如何應用於染料敏化太陽能電池。
description.en: The concept of photoelectrochemistry is to utilize the solar energy and other light sources to drive a complete electrochemical oxidation-reduction reaction where the photocatalytic electron reaction has been converted into electrical energy. Photovoltaic cells which also known as solar cells composed of organic and inorganic materials and electrolytes are the great example for the photoelectrochemical reactions. Here the proposed course is constructed to introduce and implement the basic photoelectrochemical principles, measurements, photoelectrocatalysis, photoelectrical charge transfer and the storage of chemical energy. Further the remaining section of this course will be focused on the detailed studies about the development of different inorganic, organic materials for the fabrication of dye-sensitized solar cells.

This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文 ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐 / 應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

notes: 請選校院級課程 \ 大二專業英文 (一)

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

notes: 請選：體育室 \ 體育專項

description.zh: 本課程提供大一學生必備之英語文語言技巧，強調專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分，並整合英語文之聽、說、讀、寫之能力，提升英語文在專業領域的應用。
description.en: This course equips first-year students with essential English language skills, focusing on developing their communication abilities in specific professional fields. The content is customized to each college's discipline and integrates the four language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing), thereby enhancing the application of English in professional contexts.

notes: 請選校院級課程 \ 大一學院專業英文 (一)

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1. 極限與連續，2. 導數及其應用，3. 不定積分與定積分，4. 超越函數及其反函數，5. 積分法則，6. 不定型與瑕積分，7. 定積分的應用，8. 空間幾何與向量微積分，9. 偏導數，10. 重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 本課程的目的是為了：1. 驗證物理理論之真實性，2. 培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3. 培養同學數據處理的能力，4. 啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。
description.en: In this course there will be 1 credit for each of two semesters, and 3 laboraborial hours per week. The first semester experiments involve mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, and waves, etc.. The second semester experiments contains electromagnetics, optics, and modern physics, etc.. The purposes of this course are 1: to identify the physical laws, 2:to cultivate the ability of data reduction of students, 4: to instruct the students solving the problems of measurements of measurements by self-designments.

description.zh: 介紹單位換算與有效數位，元素的原子結構、化學方程式平衡與計算，反應熱，氣體與氣體定律，大氣層與環境污染，週期表，化學鍵，化合物的分子結構，熱力學，動力學，反應機構，平衡常數，氧化與還原，酸鹼反應，電化學，混合物的分離及現代科技材料，奠定良好化學基礎。
description.en: The course is designed for chemical engineering major. The topics explore chemistry at a greater depth and with more emphasis on concepts, problems, and calculations. Topics include significant figures, thermochemistry, gases, quantum theory and the electronic structure of atoms, periodic relationships, chemical bonding, chemical reaction, oxidation-reduction reaction, chemical kinetics, chemical equilibrium, acids and bases, changes of states, synthetic polymer materials, electrochemistry.

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service Mechanical & Electrical Engineering students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

description.zh: 本課程將閱讀並討論聯合國 2030 年持續發展議程的議題，主題和做法。 藉由對全球繁榮，社會平等和環境可持續性共同藍圖的認識，學生能進一步參加全球活動，並在本地和跨域發展共同夥伴關係，以參與持續發展目標的行動。 此外，學生將能夠通過批判性閱讀和討論來強化英語能力，並為與可持續發展目標有關的更深入的交流做好準備。
description.en: This course will read and discuss issues, topics, and practices of the UN’s 2030 agenda for sustainable development, adopted by all UN member states. With full insights and comprehensive views of the shared blueprint for global prosperity, social equality and environmental sustainability, students are expected to participate in global activities and form partnership locally and across borders to engage in SDGs actions. In addition, students will be able to enhance their English competence through critical reading and discussion, and will be prepared for more in-depth communication pertaining to the SDGs.

notes: 高級

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領具進階英文能力學生讀、理解並分析國際時事，提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ advanced-level reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

notes: 高級

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調電資專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service Electrical Engineering and Computer Science students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

name.zh: 進階專業英文 - 電資 (二)
name.en: Advanced ESP (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) II

notes: 高級

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering.

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生在全球化環境下的專業英語溝通能力，整合科技、商業、社會及文化觀點。學生將探索新興科技、國際商業及數位經濟等關鍵議題，學習分析資訊並於多元專業環境中有效溝通。本課程強調理解這些領域，以提升在全球職場的專業能力。
description.en: This course develops professional English communication for a globalized world, integrating technology, business, social, and cultural perspectives. Students explore key topics like emerging technologies, international business, and digital economies, learning to analyze information and communicate effectively in diverse professional contexts. The course emphasizes understanding these areas to enhance global workplace proficiency.

description.zh: 本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。     奠基於大學之前 12 年的國語文能力上，課程設計朝向多元實務應用的方向，以建構學生多元溝通表達之職場需求力為要，包括資訊蒐集力、資訊應用力、簡報製作力、文案企劃力、自我宣傳力、口語溝通力、採訪寫作力、理念論述力、創新思維力等諸多領域的能力，並重視啟發學生培養生活品味力，深化學生對於生命關懷力的體認，以契合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統，以及學生未來畢業後的實務需求。
description.en: This course, "Practical Application of Chinese Language", is designed for the students of the University of Science and Technology. It is based on the practical application in the future work and life. Based on the Chinese language ability of the previous 12 years before the university, the curriculum design is oriented towards the application of multiple practices, with the construction of students diverse communication and expression in needs of the  future work as the main, including information gathering ability, information application ability, presentation production ability, writing ability , self-promotion, oral communication, interview writing, idea exposition, innovative thinking, and many other areas, and attaches great importance to inspiring students to cultivate their taste in life, deepening students' understanding of practical use of Chinese in the future.

notes: 限外籍生修讀，初級班（A0）

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1. 極限與連續，2. 導數及其應用，3. 不定積分與定積分，4. 超越函數及其反函數，5. 積分法則，6. 不定型與瑕積分，7. 定積分的應用，8. 空間幾何與向量微積分，9. 偏導數，10. 重積分，11. 級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

notes: 限外國學生

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

notes: 請選：體育室 \ 體育專項

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹程式設計的基本概念和技術，以及人工智慧的發展和應用。課程內容涵蓋程式語言的基本語法，以及人工智慧的基礎觀念與理論，並藉由編程練習及 AI 工具操作來進一步了解人工智慧應用以及程式設計的潛在應用。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental concepts and techniques of programming, as well as the development and application of artificial intelligence. The course content covers basic syntax for the programming languages, along with the fundamental concept theories of artificial intelligence. Through programming practices and AI tool manipulations, the students can gain a further understanding of the artificial intelligence application and the potential application via programming.

name.zh: 程式設計與人工智慧導論
name.en: Fundamentals of Programming and Artificial Intelligence

notes: 計網電腦教室，產品組

description.zh: 本課程提供學生學習資料分析與處理的基本技巧，包括資料管理、資料格式轉換、資料表格建立、數據模型及視覺化處理及實例應用之探討。本課程以物件導向程式語言為基礎做為資料分析之工具，並且實作各應用實例，修習本課程之學生需具備一定之程式及數學基礎。
description.en: The course, Data Analysis and Processing, teaches the basics of data management, analysis, modeling and visualization that apply to all domains using object-oriented programming languages. Solid programming background and mathematics are required to take this course.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹最佳控制之相關原理與應用，內容包括如下：最佳控制簡介，性能指標，動態規劃法，變分法，變分法在最佳控制之應用，最佳控制之數值解與個案研究等。
description.en: English Description:  This subject is arranged to introduce the principles and applications of optimal control. The subject includes the following subtopics: introduction of optimal control, performance measure, dynamic programming, calculus of variations, variational approach to optimal control problems, numerical solution of optimal control, and case studies.

description.zh: 粉末冶金是工業先進國家積極發展的重點科技之一，其內容涵蓋粉末製造、粉末成形固結以及燒結體的後處理等範圍，本課程即安排包括粉末製造、粉末特性與其測定、粉末混合與造粒、成形、燒結理論與實務、燒結體性質與其測定、燒結體的後處理等基礎項目。另外，再講述利用粉末冶金技術製造的材料與產品的實務應用項目等，以期讓學生能對粉末冶金技術能有基本上的認識。
description.en: Powder metallurgy is one of the most important highlighted high-tech in the developed countries, its content includes powder making,powder formation and condensing,and the final treatment of sintered body,etc.Thus, this course includes the fundamental items such as powder manufacturing, powder characteristics and its test, powder mixing and granulation, formation, sintering theory and practice, the property of sintering body and its test, the post-treatment of sintering body. Besides, it also lectures practice method like using powder metallurgy to manufacture material and product, in order to let students have basic knowledge about powder metallurgy.

description.zh: 本課程討論，利用儀器分析工作之理論，儀器之原理，構造操作及計算等。包括光譜化學，原子吸收光譜，電漿發射光譜儀，發光光譜儀，電分析化學，PH 計，電解沉澱法，伏安法，極譜儀，等儀器之探討。
description.en: This course discusses the theoryof instrumental analysis operation, the principle of instrument, structural operation and calculation. It includes spectrum chemistry, atomic absorption spectrograph, plasma jet spectrograph, light spectrograph, electric analytic chemistry, PH meter, electrolytic precipatation, volt ampere, polar spectrograph, etc..

notes: 配合 USR 計畫

description.zh: 本課程內容目的在介紹電化學之原理與其應用。一、在原理方面包括離子之作用及其平衡，電解質之導電性質，界面現象，電極電位，電化學電池和電極動力程序等內容。二、在應用方面則涵蓋溶液化學參數測量，電化學分析技術，電鍍，表面處理，金屬腐蝕防治，電池應用，和電合成等
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to principles of electrochemistry and its applications. In the principles which includes ionic interaction, ionic equilibrium, the conducting properties of electrolytes, interfacial phenomena, electrode potentials, electrochemical cells and electrode kinetic process. For the application covers determination of physical parameters in the solutions, electroanalytical techniques, electroplating, electrochemical sensors, surface finishing, metal corrosion prevention, cells, electrodialysis, and electrosynthesis etc.

notes: 四必選一

description.zh: 材料表面處理是各種製造工業不可或缺的過程，不論是傳統的工業或現代的高科技產業，表面處理都一直扮演著極重要的角色。本課程主 要是對表面處理技術在理論基礎，方法與應用等方面的講述，以期 培養學生的興趣與專業的知識。課程內容包括表面處理技術的基本 理論，前處理技術，各種表面處理的方法與相關知識，以及各種表面處理技術的應用等項目。
description.en: Surface coating and chemical surface treatment are the main subjects to be taught in this course. The phase composition of the each coating methods is introduced initially. Association of theses process with chemical pre-treatment of the material surface is reviewed next. Both experimental procedures and techniques base on concepts of electrode reactions and impedances are discussed during the entire presentation of this course.

description.zh: 隨著先進能源科技的快速進展，各種形態能源的生產、儲存、再生、與利用成為技術發展的重點。材料科技是提升能源效率的重要一環，本課程結合包括金屬、陶瓷、高分子、奈米等複合材料系統，討論材料在在包括儲氫合金、二次電池、燃料電池、太陽能電池、熱電、超電容等新型能源儲存或生產等裝置上的應用領域與其限制。
description.en: The demands for advanced energy requires the development of technologies for sustainable energy production, converting, and storage. Materials are key blocks to improved performance in new energy technologies. These new materials systems often combine the knowledge in the fields of metals, ceramics, polymer, and nano-materials. This course will discuss the applications and limits of materials in hydrogen storage, secondary batteries, fuel cells, solar cells, thermoelectric devices, and supercapacitors to give undergraduate students a basic understanding of energy-related materials.

description.zh: 本課程目標在教授學生太陽能光電科技及能源產業之實務知識，及相關材料設計。課程設計將著重基礎太陽能光電科技知識的建立，首先介紹太陽能光電科技所應具備之基礎知識，並教授能源材料的基本特性及原理及目前應用之概況。藉由說明太陽能電池設計原理與效率提高準則為出發點，教導學生了解太陽能光電科技所應用到之材料基本特性及相關製作程序。本課程將由本校專任教師配合企業講師和技術實務專業教師演講，透過實例之講解及工廠參觀，引導學生了解應用領域及製造產業。期盼培育學生迅速進入太陽能光電及能源科技相關產業。
description.en: The course "Technical progress and future prospect on solar photovoltaic" aims to provide the core knowledge for the material development of solar energy technology. It intends to educate and train students with the fundamental theories and technical application of solar energy and solar-cell fabrication technology. The future prospect of photovoltaic will be revealed to help students understand strong demands in solar industries. The experienced industrial lectures will present the potential marketing, working principles of solar devices, and progress in commercialization of solar cells. Students will also be given opportunities to visit the solar-related industries.

name.zh: 太陽光電電池材料與開發

description.zh: 本課程介紹現代矽奈米之元件物理與其操作原理，課程主題涵蓋金屬 / 半導體接面、能帶圖、金氧半電容元件、金氧半場效電晶體、金氧半場效電晶體之微縮、先進金氧半場效電晶體與其製程技術。
description.en: This course provides an introduction to the fundamental physics and operation principles of silicon-based nano devices in modern electronics. This class will cover topics include metal/semiconductor junctions, energy band diagrams, MOS capacitors, MOS field-effect transistors (MOSFETs). MOSFET scaling, modern MOSFETs, and future transistor technologies will also be discussed.

notes: 材資四甲和材料所合開

description.zh: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: Case Study. Seminar. Group meeting.

notes: 限碩二修習

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹薄膜製作有關的基礎理論與技術。講述內容包括真空技術，薄膜基礎，薄膜製作技術，蝕刻技術，薄膜評估方法以及薄膜技術的應用等。讓學生認識薄膜在高科技產業上的應用與其重要性，製作薄膜的方法與技術以及其未來的發展。
description.en: This course is a special topics of Thin films technology and Thin film materials science. 2. Vacuum science and technology 3. Thin film evaporation processes 4. Discharge, plasma, and ion-surface interaction 5. Plasma and ion beam processing of thin films 6. Chemical vapor deposition 7. Substrate surfaces and thin film nucleation 8. Film structure 9. Characterization of thin films and surface 10. Interdiffusion, reactions, and transformations in thin films 11. Mechanical properties of thin films.

description.zh: 主要介紹結構陶瓷，生醫陶瓷，複合陶瓷等。
description.en: This course is a special topics of Structural Ceramics.

description.zh: 本課程介紹現代矽奈米之元件物理與其操作原理，課程主題涵蓋金屬 / 半導體接面、能帶圖、金氧半電容元件、金氧半場效電晶體、金氧半場效電晶體之微縮、先進金氧半場效電晶體與其製程技術。
description.en: This course provides an introduction to the fundamental physics and operation principles of silicon-based nano devices in modern electronics. This class will cover topics include metal/semiconductor junctions, energy band diagrams, MOS capacitors, MOS field-effect transistors (MOSFETs). MOSFET scaling, modern MOSFETs, and future transistor technologies will also be discussed.

notes: 材資四甲。材料所和半導體碩班合開

description.zh: 這門課除了教授傳統企業環境管理及相關實務之外，特別將著重在企業提升如何透過綠色創新來提升綠色競爭力的策略與做法；此外，課程另一重點將會是企業如何透過協助聯合國永續發展目標 (UN SDGs) 的達成，來創造企業的永續競爭力。學生將會深入探究金字塔底層 (BOP) 與創造共享價值 (Creating Shared Value, CSV) 之理論及實務做法，以及成為一個真正永續企業的策略。
description.en: In this course, traditional corporate environmental management and the strategies for improving green competitiveness will be taught. In addition, the strategies of corporate sustainability- how the corporate to create sustainable competitiveness by coping with the 17 goals of UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs) will also be taught. Theories and practices of Bottom of the Pyramid (BOP) and Creating Shared Value (CSV), as well as the strategies of being a true sustainable enterprise will be emphasized in the class.

notes: 碩博合開

description.zh: 室內空氣品質及室內空氣污染對人體之危害、空氣環境汙染物、換氣與通風、檢測方法、污染源診斷、空氣品質控制及改善、國內外法規、管理計劃規劃。含室內空氣污染物之移除技術、室內空氣清淨機原理應用於室內空氣品質之控制。
description.en: Indoor and outside air conditions, air pollutants, fresh air and air conditioning & ventilation, indoor air quality control, management and regulation, indoor air cleaners.

name.zh: 室內空氣品質控制與管理
name.en: Indoor Air Quality Control and management

notes: 碩博合開

description.zh: 講授透視圖的基本原理、種類與方法及透視陰影，並以設計實例透視圖練習應用，培養靈活應用透視圖法於設計表達。
description.en: This course aims to provide the student with theories and skills of perspective drafting by specifically introducing perspective theories and ways of drawing, and being concurrent with the practice of drawing in industrial design.

notes: 家室組

description.zh: 將試作技術課程內所習之試作技術應用發揮，以產品設計圖為依據，應用各種材料及加工技術完成產品之立體表達。
description.en: To practice product model building techniques . Based on product engineering drawing , let techning design students to practice model making techniques with difference material and working methods .

notes: 家室組，使用設計館 B1 金工廠，上限 30 人

description.zh: 基於學生畢業後的生涯發展，本課程目標旨在提供學生清楚認知未來的生涯發展，進而規劃自己的進路。針對設計學生畢業後的發展可以從學術界與實務界兩方面考量，學術界以直升研究所或工作後再修讀在職專班，而實務界則以可從事的相關職場做介紹與分析各行業的特色與前途，可擔任的職務名稱包括：互動設計師、互動程式設計師、使用者介面設計師、互動廣告企劃等，以供學生參考。
description.en: Based on the personal career development,  the course aims to provide a clearly scope and knowledge of future career development. This career can be analyzed in two categories, one is academic field that provide the master program and in-job training program; the another is practical field which concerns about more related design job, such as interaction designer, interactive programmer, user interface designer and interactive advertisement planner. This course not only introduces the design-related job, but also analyzes their characteristics and future development route.

notes: 一般教室，限本系生 70 人修

description.zh: 以圖像語言的架構教授分析性繪圖 (Analytical Drawing Process) 的概念與操作，以及分析性繪圖在設計速寫上的應用。課程以課堂講解與實地速寫來進行，主題包括感知與理解層面的三維觀察與紀錄、圖解、與圖像筆記。教學目標為：1. 介紹分析性繪圖與徒手草寫。2. 訓練以徒手草寫的過程來觀察、分析、與記錄結構、空間、與建成環境的三維特性。3. 熟悉感知與理解的圖學系統與速寫表現手法，能以圖像筆記來記錄設計主題。
description.en: This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.The objectives are:1.Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 2.Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 3.Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

notes: 光華 409, 預選 16 人

description.zh: 本課程將結合理論說明與示範實習，使同學對雷射基本原理及光電科技應用有一完整的認識，內容包括：1. 光電工程概論，2. 基礎光學，3. 電射發光原理，4. 雷射光的調製，5. 光電科技應用概論。
description.en: This course is a special topics of Photo- Electronic Materials.

description.zh: 本課程藉由不同情境之英語錄影帶，以及專題的語彙題目來提供一個英語談話的情境使學生能學習合宜的詞句。小組討論、角色演練、口頭報告皆為主要教學技巧，俾能增強學生之聽說能力。
description.en: This course aims at providing an English-speaking environment to allow students learn about the speaking strategies and common expressions used in different situations through viewing video films and oral practice. Small-group/pair discussion and role-playing are also parts of the methodologies.

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號除 3 餘 2，02/05/08 等，僅限英文系學生修讀

description.zh: 本課程旨在為學生奠定紮實的英語文法與句型結構基礎，幫助學生掌握不完整句、連寫句、誤置修飾語、不連結修飾語、錯誤平行結構等關鍵文法知識。於此基礎上，課程將進一步培養學生的段落寫作技巧，包括敘述、描述、闡釋和論證等，使學生能撰寫條理分明、結構嚴謹之段落。
description.en: This course provides a solid foundation in English grammar and sentence construction, helping students master key grammatical elements like sentence fragments, run-on sentences, misplaced modifiers, dangling modifiers, and faulty parallelism. Building upon this grammatical foundation, this course further develops students’ paragraph writing skills through techniques such as narration, description, exposition, and argumentation, enabling students to craft well-structured paragraphs.

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號偶數，僅限英文系學生修讀

description.zh: 本課程目的在啟發學生英語聽力，分析及思辨能力。本課程自報紙，雜誌及電視選取豐富的新聞及媒體教材，以訓練聽力及筆記的技巧。 此外，在課堂上將討論一些有爭議性的或者有趣的議題，以培養學生獨立思辨能力。
description.en: The course aims to develop the student's techniques of listening, analyzing and critical thinking in English. A variety of journalistic and media texts will be selected from newspapers, magazines and T.V. to reinforce listening training and note-taking skills. Besides, some controversial or interesting issues will be discussed in class to encourage the student's independent and critical thinking.

name.zh: 新聞英語及聽力訓練（二）

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號偶數，僅限英文系學生修讀

description.zh: 本課程旨在引導學生閱讀英美短篇故事，探討其敘事技巧、情節、人物、觀點和語言等，如何在故事中建構意義，並著重故事所傳達的文化意涵。
description.en: This course will guide students to read short fiction written by British and American authors.  By reading a wide range of short stories, we will examine how such narrative techniques as plot, character, point of view and language construct meaning in stories.  We will also examine what these stories tell us about the cultures that produce them.

description.zh: 課程之設計旨在教導學生使其具備科技產業所使用之語言能力、知識和觀點，以利學生未來職涯發展。藉由大量的閱讀及討論，使學生了解科技產業之發展，同時建立學生在實務界的真實情境中所需的高度英語文認知與溝通能力。課程包含科技發展、議題及趨勢的深入分析，以及職場上真實情境的演練。
description.en: This current course is geared to empower students with the language, knowledge and views of technology industry in order to carry out their career goals. Ample opportunities are provided to understand technological and industrial developments through reading and discussions while building high-level of awareness and proficiency of the English language in use to address realistic scenarios in field industries. The course adopts an integrative approach to accommodate in-depth analysis of technological advances, issues and trends as well as real-life workplace scenarios in technology fields of work.

description.zh: 當代英美流行小說，例如：帶珍珠耳環的少女，時空旅人之妻，姊姊的守護者，暮光之城系列等等，主題推陳出新，內容扣人心弦，有的反應當前的文化議題，有的表現出創新的文學想像，在在都激發著同學們閱讀原文小說的興趣。又由於小說的書寫語言為當今英語世界所使用，沒有年代隔閡，所以原文流行小說也是優良的英語學習材料。在字彙，片語，句型，段落及文章結構，到故事情節發展與深入探討主題的每個層面上，都提供了豐富的素材，供同學們學習觀摩。因此，本課程將挑選不同類型之時下英美流行小說四本，每月一本，規劃進度，在課堂上進行導讀與討論，並加強字彙，句型，與文章結構上的分析，幫助同學們在英語書寫，閱讀技巧，跨文化了解與思辨能力上，獲得最大的進步！
description.en: Contemporary popular novels originally written in English, such as the Girl with a Pearl Earring, the Time Traveler's Wife, and the Twilight, have a strong appeal to readers worldwide, but non-native English speakers often enjoy these works in translated versions or film adaptations.  To encourage our students to read these popular English novels in the original language, the instructor will choose four novels of various subject matters and use them as effective teaching materials in the classroom. The objectives are (1) to enrich students' cultural background knowledge of the English speaking world today, (2) to cultivate students' life-long reading habit of keeping up contemporary materials, and (3) to strengthen their critical thinking as well as language skills, especially reading and writing, through line-by-line close readings in the context and guided discussions on the narrative structures of the whole fiction.

description.zh: 本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。課程內容包含（一）勞作教育理念介紹。（二）勞作教育實作。（三）課堂討論與反思。（四）期末成果分享。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

notes: 需修習本課程始可畢業

description.zh: 本課程幫助學生習得敘述、描寫、推論、議論、省思、說明等文體方面的寫作技巧，並指導學生從閱讀、圖片、日常生活事件，及課堂討論內容中取材，以加強邏輯思考和流暢寫作能力。
description.en: This course aims to develop and reinforce students’ strengths to create unified and coherent pieces of composition in a variety of styles--narrative, descriptive, argumentative, reflective, and expository. Students will be guided to write in response to readings, pictures, events in their daily lives, and discussions from the class. Thought-provoking topics dealing with current issues are used to stimulate and foster critical writing strategies. This course enables students to write and discuss logically and clearly; they also need to incorporate grammatically newly-built vocabulary into their writing.

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號偶數，僅限英文系學生修讀

description.zh: 本課程欲提升英文系學生之溝通能力，並著重於簡報部份。中高階英語能力之學生須發表口頭報告，藉此增進有效之語言使用策略。
description.en: This course aims to enhance English-major students’ communicative competence with special emphasis on business presentations and meetings. By developing effective skills, strategies and tactful language use, students with high-intermediate proficiency level of English will be able to prepare as well as present verbal reports to achieve career goal.

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號偶數，僅限英文系學生修讀

description.zh: 培養正確的英語發音與腔調，並訓練學生熟悉如何使用音標記錄發音以及辨認學習者在英語發音中經常發生的問題。  課程中也介紹英語語音系統的主要規則。
description.en: This course will be concerned with English speech sounds and stress patterns, the use of phonetic symbols for transcribing pronunciation and identifying pronunciation problems. The general principles of English phonology will be introduced.

description.zh: 以對流行事物，如電影，音樂，廣告，服裝，電視，通俗小說等，在當代文化思潮中的影響，及其所扮演角色探討為經，並對於英語在各範疇中展現之語彙，修辭，語法，技巧之賞析為緯，引領學生進入一個交織著現代語文與現代意涵的世界。
description.en: This course aims at giving an approach to the study of television, popular music, popular literature such as magazines and best sellers, fashion and movies, as well as an examination into the influence of all aspects of our daily lives on our basic beliefs and values. It involves the use of methodologies from both the humanities and the social sciences in the effort to interpret expressive cultural forms. Students are encouraged to participate in discussion over selected topics from contemporary issues.

description.zh: 本課程為中英口譯基礎課程，讓學生了解各類型口譯實務。學生認識口譯員具備之技術與語言能力，以漸進方式學習基礎視譯與短逐步口譯。課程著重於強化學生公開演說能力、口譯聽力技巧、重述演練、一心多用與短期記憶重述運用以及基礎逐步口譯筆記與摘要之模擬演練。
description.en: This is an introductory course to Chinese-English interpreting. The course provides a practical insight into different modes of interpreting and introduces skills and aptitude integral to interpreting progressively. Students learn basics of sight translation and short consecutive interpreting. Topics include public speaking, active listening skills, paraphrasing, multitasking, recall and memory, and gist extraction followed by basic CI note-taking techniques.

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號偶數，僅限英文系學生修讀

description.zh: 此筆譯入門課程旨在使學生熟悉中英翻譯的基本概念、技巧與原則。課程中亦將介紹中英對比分析與翻譯之關聯，並協助學生將語言對比知識應用於翻譯實務中。學生將能於本課程中習得各類型翻譯所需之策略。
description.en: This is an introductory course aiming to familiarize students with basic concepts, skills and principles of Chinese-English translation. Moreover, the relevance of Chinese-English contrastive analysis to translation practices will be introduced, and students will learn how to apply the linguistic knowledge to practical work. By the end of the course, student will develop useful and appropriate translation strategies to deal with a range of translation tasks.

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號偶數，僅限英文系學生修讀

description.zh: 本課程主要在培養進階寫作能力，採用功能導向的方式，諸如書函，文章／書本摘要，評論，創作，學術專技報告等專項進行演練。
description.en: This course, using a functionally-oriented approach, aims at increasing university-level EFL writing students' English writing skills and developing them into more fluent, confident writers. To achieve this goal, students in this course will have ample opportunities to compose a wide variety of extended writing pieces, including letters, memos, abstracts, reviews, creative writings, and technical reports.

notes: B 組 - 學號尾號偶數，僅限英文系學生修讀

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹英語全球化、不同種類英語的出現，以及英語作為通用語言之發展、相關概念與論述。經由閱讀與課堂討論，學生將有機會檢視與英語全球化和全球英語相關的重要議題。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with an overview of the spread of the English language around the world, the emergence of English varieties, and the development of the popularization of English as a lingua franca. Through readings and class discussion, students will have the opportunity to examine key issues arising from the spread of English as well as the development of Global Englishes.

description.zh: 本課程介紹常用的統計與數據分析方法。課程設計著重跨領域的問題解決能力，學生將學習如何蒐集、處理與詮釋資料，根據具體的案例進行數據分析與報告撰寫，並使用 AI 工具進行文本分析與數據視覺化。課程結合現代 AI 技術與語言學的應用，為學生提供跨領域的專業發展，提升其在全球化市場中的競爭力。完成本門課程的學生將能熟悉資料科學領域中主要的統計分析技術，並同時掌握透過編寫程式的方式執行數據分析的能力。
description.en: This course introduces common statistical and data analysis methods, focusing on interdisciplinary problem-solving skills. Students will learn how to collect, process, and interpret data, applying these techniques to real-world case studies. They will engage in data analysis and report writing, utilizing AI tools for text analysis and data visualization. The course combines modern AI technology with linguistic applications, providing students with professional development in interdisciplinary fields. Upon completion, students will be familiar with key statistical analysis techniques in data science and will be able to conduct data analysis through programming.

name.zh: AI 運用之跨領域數據分析
name.en: Artificial Intelligence and Interdisciplinary Data Analysis

description.zh: 本課程廣泛介紹社會語言學的各個次領域，目的在引導學生瞭解此領域早期的基礎研究與現代的關注議題。學生可藉此認識英語在社會上的運用以及各種社會變因對於語言運作的影響。修完本課程後，學生有能力辨認現代英語的不同語體、解釋語言使用所牽涉到的社會因素、運用社會語言學中適切的研究方法完成語言研究，並能將社會語言學的概念應用到語言教學。
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive overview of sociolinguistic subcategories with the goal of introducing students to both early foundational work and current issues in this field. It provides students with valuable knowledge in the use of the English language in society and the effects of intricate social variables on language operation. Upon completion of this course, students will be able to identify the social varieties of English spoken in the present world, to explain the social factors involved in language use, to use appropriate methodology in sociolinguistics to conduct linguistic research, and to apply sociolinguistic knowledge to language teaching.

description.zh: 本課程將透過每週專題演講方式，讓學生了解環境工程與管理之最新理論，技術及最先進之研究成果。演講者之安排將以校外知名專家學者及校內各計畫執行者為主。
description.en: This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application on the environmental engineering and management. Invited Speakers are well-known scholars in areas related to environmental engineering and management. Graduate students or thesis advisors are also invited to report research results of their graduate studies.

description.zh: 本課程介紹科技論文寫作與報告，課程內容包括科技論文寫作元素介紹 (摘要、介紹、方法、結果、討論、結論) 與撰寫方式，文獻搜尋與整理，報告與發表注意事項，以利環境所碩博士生應用於未來論文撰寫與成果發表。
description.en: This class focuses on the Introduction of major elements in technical writing, including abstract, introduction, research methods, results, discussion, and conclusion. Writing grammar, style, and methods to perform literature search and review are also introduced. The main aim of this course is enhancing the ability of graduate students in future thesis writing and research publication.

notes: 博班必修，碩班選修

description.zh: 學生與教授討論擬定之論文研究主題，在教授個別指導下，進行實驗之研究或模式計算，尋找相關資料與文獻，及獨立研究的訓練，並將其研究成果撰寫成博士論文及發表於國際期刊。
description.en: PhD. students have to carry out independent research at Ph.D. level. Under the guidance of advisor, PhD. students will be assigned a research topic, conduct independent experimental design, data analysis, and write doctoral dissertation. To Submit papers to international journals for publication is necessary.

description.zh: 碩士學位論文寫作。
description.en: A student must write a thesis to fulfill the partial requirements for the Master degree.

description.zh: 研究生在教授之個別指導下，針對特定研究主題進行研究，並將研究成果寫成論文。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis.

notes: 限博士班修習

description.zh: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: Case Study. Seminar. Group meeting.

notes: 限博士班修習，新聘一

description.zh: 銲接冶金課程深入研究金屬銲接技術與冶金過程，培養學生在材料處理和銲接技術方面的專業能力。課程包括銲接方法、銲材選擇、熱影響、金屬結構與性能及銲接缺陷等內容，並結合實際案例，使學生能理解並應用於工程實務。
description.en: The welding metallurgy course in the graduate program delves into metal welding techniques and metallurgical processes, cultivating students' expertise in material handling and welding technologies. The curriculum covers welding methods, selection of welding materials, heat-affected zones, metal structures and properties, welding defects, and incorporates real-world cases to enable students to comprehend and apply them in engineering practice.

notes: 機電。製科。機電博含外生班合開，限 30 人 (乙

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋的範圍包括基礎的雷射物理與工程、雷射光束的傳播、高斯雷射光束、光學共振腔的原理、設計與分析等等。內容包含：1. 基本光學  2. 雷射基本原理  3. 各種雷射介紹  4. 雷射動態特性  5. 雷射的應用
description.en: The lectures will cover the fundamental aspects of laser physics and engineering of lasers of all kinds, including ray tracing, Gaussian beams, principles of the optical cavities design and analysis...etc. The lecture outline is as follows:1.Basic optics  2. Laser principles  3. Specific types of lasers  4. Laser dynamics  5. Laser applications

notes: 機電所和半導體碩班合開，限 40 人，甲◎

description.zh: 本課程主要學習各企業在半導體製程的各關鍵製程，包括晶圓製造、蝕刻及封裝測試等，同時深入探討最先進的半導體製造設備。透過與業界專家交流，使學生了解產業實務案例，並掌握應對半導體產業人才需求。率先引領台灣半導體產業發展以真實具體的企業經驗為教材，進而鼓勵學生追求半導體科技創新的渴望，強化學生對職涯願景的規劃。
description.en: This course focuses on studying the key processes of various companies in the semiconductor manufacturing process, including wafer manufacturing, etching, packaging, and testing, etc., and also provides an in-depth discussion of the most advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Through exchanges with industry experts, students can understand industrial practical cases and master the talent needs of the semiconductor industry. It takes the lead in leading the development of Taiwan's semiconductor industry by using real and concrete corporate experience as teaching materials, thereby encouraging students to pursue semiconductor technology innovation and strengthening students' career vision planning.

name.zh: 企業實務講座 - 半導體製程與設備

notes: 機電、製科和半導體碩班合開；限 20 人；甲乙丙組選修

description.zh: 機械手臂基礎理論，內容包含座標轉換、機械臂運動學、反運動學、動力學、軌跡規畫、機械臂設計、機械臂控制、機械臂的程式語言等。
description.en: It is a fundamental course concerning the theories of robotic manipulators. Topics contain frame transformations, manipulator kinematics, inverse kinematics, dynamics, trajectory planning, manipulator design, control of manipulators, robot programming languages.

notes: 機電。製科。機電博含外生合開，限 20 人；甲◎

description.zh: 偏微分方程式、變分法、張量分析、工程統計及積分方程式等工程分析用工具知識。
description.en: Partial Differential equation, Variation Principle, Tensor Analysis, Engineering Statistics and Integral equation.

notes: 限 20 人；甲乙丙組選修

description.zh: 本課程之重點在於將熱力學機基本定律，應用於較為實際的化工問題上。主要內容包括：熱力學及輸送現象性質之估算方法，氣液相平衡及液液相平衡在分離製程的應用等.
description.en: The objectives of this course are to apply principles of thermodynamics in practical chemical processes. The contents of the curricula are 1) estimation of the thermodynamic and transport properties of fluids and solids, 2) vapor-liquid equilibrium as well as liquid-liquid equilibrium for separation processes application.

notes: 網路預選限 40 人；大三合開

description.zh: 本課程旨在利用電腦模擬與計算工具，深入探討化學工程領域的核心知識，主要涵蓋單元操作及輸送現象（一）至（三）中應用於化工程序設計的兩大重點領域：分離程序與熱整合。在分離程序部分，本課程以單元操作與輸送現象（三）為理論基礎，通過化工模擬軟體 Aspen Plus 操作各種單元模型，設計化工廠常見的分離單元。課程內容包含氣體吸收塔、氣提塔，以及連續式與板式蒸餾塔的操作與內部設計，並涵蓋實際案例模擬與數據分析。進階部分將以膜分離為主，介紹客製化模組的設計。在熱整合方面，課程以單元操作與輸送現象（一）與（二）為理論基礎，通過 Aspen Plus 模擬實際上的能源再利用及廢熱回收程序，計算常見程序中單元之間的作工與耗能，並介紹熱交換器的單元設計。此課程對化工系學生而言，將深化單元操作與輸送現象的核心知識，強化單元設計與模擬能力，為頂石課程中的化工程序設計奠定堅實基礎。對於非化工專業學生，本課程則提供通過電腦模擬與計算理解化學工程核心概念的機會，為跨領域學習鋪設基礎。
description.en: This course aims to utilize computer simulation and computational tools to explore core knowledge in the field of chemical engineering, focusing on two key areas of chemical process design applied in unit operations and transport phenomena (I to III): separation processes and heat integration.In the separation processes section, the course is based on the theoretical foundations of Unit Operations and Transport Phenomena (III) and uses Aspen Plus to operate various unit models, designing common separation units in chemical plants. The content includes the operation and internal design of gas absorption columns, stripping columns, continuous and plate distillation columns, as well as practical case simulations and data analysis. The advanced section will focus on membrane separation, introducing the design of customized modules.In the heat integration section, building on the theory from Unit Operations and Transport Phenomena (I and II), the course will use Aspen Plus to simula

notes: 大三合開

description.zh: 本課程在教授學生藥用及化妝用高分子材料之相關產業製程及配方技術的實務知識，課程設計將首先介紹高分子材料的基本合成方法、物理化學性能、界面活性劑、乳化膠體及生物分解安全性。並教授高分子材料之應用區分為兩大類：其一是指在製藥之劑型加工時所用的和為改善藥物傳輸性能而採用的輔助材料 (Excipients)，例如稀釋劑、潤滑劑、黏合劑、崩解劑、助流劑、緩和劑、穩定劑、保濕劑、膜包衣及膠囊殼等。藥用及化妝用輔助材料本身並不具有藥理作用，只是在藥品及化妝品的製造和使用中起從屬或輔助的作用。另一類高分子藥物則不同於前一類，它依靠連接在聚合物分子鏈上的藥理活性基團或高分子本身的藥理作用，進入人體後，能與機體組織發生生理反應，從而產生醫療美容或預防性效果。
description.en: The course is to provide the core knowledge for the development of pharmaceutical and cosmetic technology. It aims to educate and train students with the fundamental principles and applications of biodegradable polymers, surfactants, colloids, emulsions and their related physico-chemical properties. Then potential prospects of pharmaceutical and cosmetic polymers will be taught in two parts to help students understand the future frontiers in polymer science and technology. The first part of lectures will cover the wide range of polymer excipients such as diluents, lubricants, binders, disintegrants, glidants, demulcents, stabilizers, humercants, coatings, and capsules etc, which are inactive pharmaceutical ingredients used for assisting drug delivery. The second part will focus on polymer drugs, which are active pharmaceutical ingredients conjugated to polymer matrices such as polymeric micelles, liposomes, colloidosomes, and solid phase nanoparticle

name.zh: 藥用及化妝用高分子材料

description.en: This course covers the fundamentals of chemical sensors and biosensors based on chemical modifications, electrochemistry, spectroscopy, semiconductor technologies, and physiological electrical signal measurements. Articles from the current literature are discussed. We will also invite researchers to introduce current research. Active student participation is expected as an integral part of the course.

description.zh: 資料探勘是從大量資料中尋找有用的資訊，是一個跨越統計、資料庫和人工智慧的學門。本課程著重在從資料庫的觀點來看資料探勘的意義，並深入探討幾種資料探勘功能及其技術，最後並以實例討論來驗證資料探勘的應用價值。探討議題包括資料探勘概念、資料探勘功能、資料探勘步驟、資料倉儲、決策樹分析集群分析、關聯分析與購物籃分析等。
description.en: The data mining (DM), which involves in Statistics, Database and Artificial Intelligence fields, prospects to seek Useful information from a great deal of data. This course emphasizes at the view of the database, besides go deeply into several data mining techniques. Finally, the practical case studies will also be discussed. The topic includes the concept of DM, the function of DM, the step of DM, data warehouse, Decision Trees Analysis, Clustering Analysis, Association Rule and Basket Analyzes, etc.
