description.zh: 駭客是一門非常廣泛的學科，涵蓋了廣泛的主題。 本課程將提供駭客攻防的各種概念，並解釋如何在即時環境中使用它們。本課程將包括駭客的類型，駭客的優勢 / 劣勢，駭客的目的，駭客的工具，駭客的技能，駭客的流程等。
description.en: Hacking is a very broad discipline, which covers a wide range of topics. This course will provide the various concepts of Ethical Hacking and explain how you can use them in a real-time environment.This course will include the type of hacking, advantage /disadvantage of hacking, the purpose of hacking, tools of hacking, skill of hacking, process of hacking, etc.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹學生軟體工程的概念與技術。學生將學習開發高品質軟體相關的原理、觀念、方法、與技術。本課程將介紹下列主題：一、軟體工程簡介二、軟體流程模型三、需求工程四、軟體設計方法五、物件導向軟體開發六、軟體測試與驗證七、軟體品質確保八、軟體維護九、軟體專案管理與規劃十、軟體工程進階主題
description.en: The objective of this course is to provide students with a full awareness of the knowledge and technologies of software engineering. In particular, students will learn about the practices, concepts, methods, and techniques for producing high quality software. The course will cover the following topics: 1.An Overview of Software Engineering2.Software Process Models3.Requirements Engineering4.Software Design Methods5.Object-Oriented Software Development6.Software Testing Strategy and Tactics7.Software Quality Assurance8.Software Maintenance9.Software Project Management and Planning10.Advanced Topics in Software Engineering

description.zh: 物件導向程式語言已成為當前軟體發展主流語言，利用抽象、封裝、委任、繼承、多形等特性達成軟體設計的彈性、重複使用性等。隨著軟體規模日漸龐大，軟體工程師需更進一步具備更有效的抽象化與重覆使用設計技術，而設計樣式為當前滿足此目標主要的設計方法。本課程以建立此項核心能力為目標。學生須於課後投入約 150~200 小時完成一個樣式導向軟體設計專題。    本課程涵蓋下列主題：1	物件導向式程式設計原理 2	單元測試 3	設計樣式 4	樣式導向設計原理 5	樣式導向設計個案研究 6	樣式語言 7	樣式語言個案研究 8	樣式導向軟體設計專題
description.en: Object-oriented programming languages such as C++ and Java have become the main stream in modern software development. Object-orientation makes flexibility and reuse possible through its characteristics of abstraction, encapsulation, delegation, inheritance, and polymorphism. However, as the scale of software increases, software engineers need an even more powerful tool of abstraction and reuse. Design patterns have been established as the main design techniques to achieve reusable object-oriented design. This course aims to establish this core capability. The student is expected to complete a term project that involves 150 to 200 hours of work off class.     The following topics are covered: 1	Principles of object-oriented programming 2	Unit testing3	Design patterns4	Principles of pattern-oriented design5	Case studies in pattern-oriented design6	Pattern languages7	Case studies in Pattern languages8	Term project in pattern-oriented design

description.zh: 本課程旨在教授學生瞭解雲端環境及物聯網系統架構並進一步教授雲端環境及物聯網安全需求，課程內容除介紹雲端環境及物聯網系統的基本概念外，亦將由 OWASP 的雲端安全及物聯網安全重點進行說明，培養學生有能力分析雲端及物聯網環境中的各式潛在安全威脅，並具備設計與實作具安全防護能力的雲端及物聯網系統。課程內容包含：●雲服務技術簡介●雲服務安全●雲服務資安標準●物聯網技術簡介●工業物聯網潛在威脅●工控資安●物聯網資安檢測●物聯網資安標準●資安安全與隱私保護
description.en: This course aims to guide students understanding cloud environments and IoT systems and their corresponding security requirements. In addition to introducing basic concepts of cloud environment and IoT system, the course contents will focus on OWASP's cloud security and IoT security. All practical techniques will be explained. Students are able to analyze various potential security threats in the cloud and Internet of Things environments, and to learn security protection capabilities for cloud and IoT systems. Course contents including:●Introduction to cloud technologies●Introduction to cloud security●Security standards for cloud services ●Introduction to IoT technologies●Potential threats of industrial IoT systems●Industrial Cyber Security introduction●IoT security detection●IoT security standards●Information security and privacy protection

The topics include: nanoparticles, carbon nanotube, nanowire, nanostructure coating, bulk materials, etc. Part 2: fabrication of nanomaterials. The topics include: self-assembled, scanning probe microscope. The measurement of nanomaterials include scanning probe microscope, scanning tunneling microscope, Raman spectroscopy, etc. Part 3: the state-of-the art review the application of nanomateria.

description.zh: 學生與教授討論擬定之研究題目，在教授個別指導下，進行實驗之研究，以培養學生尋找相關資料，文獻及獨立研究的訓練，並將其研究成果撰寫成博士論文及發表於國際期刊。
description.en: To make students able to carry out independent study in master level. Students will be assigned a research topic. An independent experimental design, data analysis, doctoral thesis writing, and paper publication are necessary for this course.

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫：選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . . 等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程 "論文" 這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh: 研究生在教授的指導下，針對工業設計相關特定研究主題進行研究，並將研究成果寫成論文。其內容包括研究方法、理論分析及研究結果﹙含結論與建議﹚。本課程主要目的在提供學生開啟個人對於工業設計領域相關議題的獨立研究能力。因此，本課程將包含如何建構研究設計、寫作與參考文獻的能力。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete specific research topic under the restriction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis. The thesis focuses on the fields in "industrial design", and includes research methodology, theory background and conclusive result or findings. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. Therefore, the course includes a training of developing research, writing and bibliographic skills.

description.zh: 研究生在第一年必須選定指導教授，以決定設計創作或論文寫作的方向，從事設計創作的研究生必須發展創作理念、創作過程與實作說明，最後彙整創作報告形同於研究論文；從事論文寫作的研究生針對互動媒體設計的相關主題進行研究，並將研究成果撰寫成為論文，其內容包含緒論、文獻探討、研究設計與實施、研究結果與討論、結論與建議等。本課程目的旨在培養獨立企劃研究能力，建構研究設計與研究寫作的能力，對設計創作組而言，過程中培養協同合作的能力是必須具備的要項。
description.en: In the first year graduate students are requested to determine design creation and research topic under the supervision of their advisor. Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and practical work. The results of design creation are considered as research thesis. Graduate students who are focus on the research of interactive media design should be undertaken the results of research as a thesis. The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and approaches, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

description.zh: 全球化製造體系的形成，使得合約製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種電腦與網路的技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造數位化工廠。數位化製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明數位製造的應用現況與相關技術。本課程的內容包括：數位化製造概論、數位化製造實例說明、商業模型分析、知識管理、企業知識入口網站、產品資料管理、交易系統、資料倉儲、企業資訊入口網站、工作流程管理、最新數位化相關技術介紹。
description.en: Globalization has lead contract manufactures more active on seeking new strategies to survive. To increase competition, new technologies, such as computer and network technology, have applied. Computer and network technology can integrate internal and external information to establish a so-called "e-factory." This course covers different issues related to e-Manufacturing, such as Concept of e-Manufacturing, Case Study, Business Model Analysis, Knowledge Management, Enterprise Knowledge Portal (EKP), Product Data Management (PDM), Concept of Trading Systems, Concept of Data Warehousing, Enterprise Information Portal (EIP), Workflow Management, State of the Art Technologies, etc.

notes: 製科◎；限 30 人

description.zh: 本課程將深入的討論材料之光電及表面性質，並經由實習實驗量測各種相關特性。尤其是在材料電子理論的應用方面。所涵蓋的主題包括有：電子理論、光學特性、繞射理論、表面科學、以及材料之磁性與熱力學性質。
description.en: After successfully completing this subject a student should be able to: (i) explain the fundamental aspects of electrical properties of materials, (ii) describe and understand energy method, (iii) describe and discuss nanoscale properties of materials, (iv) apply advanced properties of materials to engineering design problems, and (v) execute related measurements.

name.zh: 高等材料性質學與實習
name.en: Advanced Properties of Materials and Related Practice

They are including :1. Introduction to VB programming language. 2. The application of VB in automation design area. 3. Introduction and application for computer-aid circuit design software(spice & pspice). 4. Introduction and application for design automatic software of circuit layout. 5. Final project.

description.zh: 地球自生成以來，其組成與結構一直在改變。今日的岩體即是這種長期改變的結果。地質學是研究岩體組成與結構變化的科學，目的在於掌握這種變化的軌跡，而構造地質學是地質學裡專門研究岩體結構變化的一分科。所謂的岩體結構（即地質構造）是指一個岩體的形狀、尺寸及其內部組成顆粒的排列情形。要了解結構的變化，無論是定性或定量，先要了解岩體的原始結構，從而才能了解現在所觀察到的岩體結構是否發生過變化。雖然構造地質學的目的是由現在既成的結構去了解地球的結構變化，但是就現在地球的結構，我們所能觀察到的岩體結構，大多被植生或土壤所覆蓋，即使偶有露出，也僅是其立體結構的某一表面而已，因此如何利用這些零星有限且是平面的岩體結構去推論地殼整體的結構，是必須首先解決的問題。面對這樣的問題，研究構造地質學應從大處著眼、小處著手，先從了解一個地區某一個露頭的現在結構開始，並由理論及實驗所得的結果推論這個岩體的結構變化過程，再由這些零星露頭的結構及其結構變化過程的資料，去推論、去拼湊涵蓋這些露頭地區的結構，由點而線、由線而面，終而包括整個地殼。
description.en: Structural geology is a branch of earth science. It has developed rapidly over the past decade. The reason for the recent advances in structural geology has been the realization that naturally deformed rocks seen in field outcrops contain a fantastic range of small-scale features which relate directly to large-scale orogenic deformation systems. The other reason has been the realization that rock deformation, like any other form of deformation, obeys well-defined physical and chemical laws. Base on this situation, this course is intended to serve as an accompaniment to techniques-based courses in structural geology or as an accompaniment to the laboratory portion of a postgraduate course. Systematic study of this advanced structural geology course includes several topics: mechanic proporties and deformation behaviors of rocks, strain analysis, ductile geologic structures, brittle geologic structures, and applied structural geology.

notes: 1 週【停開】

description.zh: 教育學生瞭解各種寶石鑑定方法與原理，並能加以融會貫通與實際操作，以期充分發揮於各類寶石之鑑定。內容涵蓋：寶石鑑定之要領及方法概論，夾子、放大鏡、尺寸量度、秤重、螢光燈操作，偏光鏡之操作、比重之量測，查氏濾色鏡之使用、折光儀之操作，多色性與二色鏡、分光鏡之鑑定方法，熱導儀、鑽石筆之使用、鑽石之比色，顯微鏡之觀測，以及綜合操作與鑑定等。
description.en: To educate students to understand various gems identification methods and their principle, and can make a comprehensive realization and practical operations. The content contains: method outline, the clip, magnifying glass, measurement of size, the balance, fluorescent light, polarization lens, Specific gravity, color filter, refractometer, dispersion, thermal meter, the observation of the microscope, etc.

notes: 兼任教師，需先修習過寶石學

description.zh: 先修課程： 無。本實習內容為汽車底盤實習，包含底盤綜合保養檢修、轉向懸吊及煞車系統元件拆裝調整檢修、檢修調整汽車前輪定位、拆裝輪胎總成及校正平衡、操作使用底盤動力計、煞車及偏滑實驗儀器。
description.en: Automobile Chassis Service Shop Practice , the basic inspection, adjustment and repair of Automobile Chassis System, Include the Automobile Suspension systems, Steering systems and Braking systems, Tire Repair and Balance practice, Wheel-Alignment practice , Chassis dynamometer Experiment , Brake performance and Slide Test .

notes: 實習實驗課 車輛實習工廠

description.zh: 本華語課程規劃為三年制教學，共分三個階段。第一年以基礎華語教學為主，重點包括：發音訓練、基礎字彙、句型與語法，以及日常生活會話。第二年在延續第一年內容的基礎上，強化段落閱讀與書寫能力，並擴展識字量。第三年則著重提升學生的聽力理解、口語表達與語境掌握能力，並融入華人社會與文化的相關內容。
description.en: This Chinese language courde is designed as a three-year curriculum, structured into three progressive stages. In the first year, the focus is on foundational Chinese instruction, including pronunciation training, basic vocabulary, sentence patterns and grammar, as well as daily conversational skills. The second year builds upon the first by strengthening paragraph reading and writing skills, and expanding character recognition. In the third year, the emphasis shifts to enhancing students’ listening comprehension, oral communication, and contextual understanding, while integrating topics related to Chinese society and culture.

description.zh: 本課程提供外籍生所需之商用華語學習，內容聚焦於職場與商務情境，涵蓋求職、面試、會議、書信、人際互動及商業溝通等主題。學生將學習與這些情境相關的常用詞彙、短語與慣用表達，並透過課堂中的實際練習與模擬互動，深化對台灣職場文化與人際關係的理解，培養在職場中有效溝通所需的語言能力與寫作技巧。
description.en: This course is designed to provide international students with essential training in Business Chinese. The content focuses on workplace and business-related scenarios, covering topics such as job searching, interviews, meetings, correspondence, interpersonal interactions, and business communication. Students will learn commonly used vocabulary, phrases, and expressions relevant to these contexts. Through practical classroom exercises and simulated interactions, the course aims to deepen students’ understanding of workplace culture and interpersonal dynamics in Taiwan, while developing the language skills and writing techniques necessary for effective professional communication.

description.zh: 電腦模擬是解決現今工程問題不可或缺之工具，但常用的商業模擬軟體不但價格昂貴，其功能常不足以應付前瞻研究所需。本課程旨在培養學生設計專業領域之模擬程式與分析工具的能力，強化軟體開發工程實務的素養。課程訓練分兩階段進行：第一階段確認學生具備基本程式設計能力。首先使其熟悉 Linux 平台及開源軟體的使用，運行不須理論基礎的簡易粒子模擬，針對收集到的數據進行統計分析，資料視覺化，資料定量分析及洞察等任務。以任務導向的學習方式，刺激同學針對特定問題和需求而快速擬定演算法，系統性地解決問題。第二階段將模擬工具開發的能力應用在各科系的專業上。在進行短暫的文獻回顧後，與修課學生討論其專業領域中可用模擬解決或加速的學術研究及產業問題。針對主題制定計畫內容後，以選定的程式語言撰寫相關的應用程式，並以開發成開源軟體為最終目標。註一、課程函授上以 GNU Fortran 和 Python3 為主要程式語言選擇，但學生可自由選擇所熟悉的語言作為工具。註二、修課基本條件為修畢工程學院各系一年級程式設計相關之基礎課程，且具基本撰寫程式的能力。
description.en: This course aims to provide complete training for developing modeling and simulation tools in engineering applications. Students will obtain the ability to analyze problems, formulate algorithms, write code, and implement the developed open-source programs in their fields of study. The first part of the training focuses on task-oriented coding experiences. Students will get familiar with the Linux platform and open-source programs. They will perform simple, particle-based simulations. The collected data will be analyzed, visualized, and interpreted based on the programs written by students.The second part of the training applies the coding knowledge to students’ fields of study. After the literature survey, students will select the topic based on theirexpertise, where research or industrial problems can be accelerated by computer modeling. The final goal is to create software based on the course project.

name.en: Development of Simulation Tools  for Engineering

notes: 計網電腦教室，總整課程

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養工程領域學生對數值方法的基本概念與實作能力，並透過 MATLAB 軟體實際應用數值計算技術，為後續工程模擬與專業計算奠定基礎。課程內容涵蓋單變數與聯立方程組之數值解法、內插與曲線擬合、數值微分與積分，以及常微分方程與邊界值問題的數值方法。學生將學習如何運用計算機解決工程上的數值分析問題，並建立數值方法與工程應用的連結，提升對模擬計算的理解與應用能力。本課程適合作為工程數學後的延伸，適用於未來進行專業計算、研究或產業應用。
description.en: This course introduces numerical solution techniques for nonlinear equations, systems of equations, curve fitting, calculus, and differential equations, which are essential for solving engineering problems. The MATLAB software serves as a platform for implementing numerical methods, enabling students to develop computational skills applicable to engineering analysis and simulation.Students will gain hands-on experience in applying numerical techniques to real-world problems, bridging the gap between theoretical mathematics and practical engineering applications. This course provides a foundation for advanced computational methods used in engineering research and industry.

notes: 計網電腦教室，大研合開，核心課程

description.zh: 本課程探討人工智慧 (AI) 與工程應用相關議題，並討論其解決方案與技術發展趨勢。內容由淺入深，包含基礎 python 程式設計、資料預處理、資料探索、機器學習、深度學習、AI 工程應用介紹 (分子性質預測、設備預測性維護、混凝土強度預測，PM2.5 預測、房價預測等案例應用分析) 及專題製作。在本課程中，學生可了解 AI 之基本原理及 AI 在工程上的應用，本課程也藉由 AI 程式撰寫的實作實習，提昇工程背景學生撰寫與理解 AI 應用程式設計的技能，以幫助學生將人工智慧導入產業應用實務中。
description.en: This course will introduce artificial intelligence (AI) and its applications in engineering fields. Topics covered include basic python programming, data prepossessing, data exploration, machine learning, deep learning, AI applications in engineering fields (e.g. predicting molecular properties, predictive maintenance predicting compressive strength of concrete, prediction of PM2.5, and prediction of house price, etc.) and final project. Students can learn about the basic principles and engineering applications of AI. Coding will be required to improve their programming competence in AI. The course intends to help the students implement AI concepts in their industrial practices.

name.zh: 人工智慧與工程應用實作

notes: 計網電腦教室，大研合開，核心課程

This course will use Google Colab and the Anaconda Python program installed on the PC.

name.en: AI Advanced Machine Learning Practical Course

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生了解 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 組合的網頁運作原理，課程以熟悉 JavaScript 與 JQuery 基本語法為主要目的，並能靈活運用現有插件增加網頁的動態效果，評量方式則以實作演練為主。
description.en: This course aims to train students to understand how web pages work using a combination of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The primary purpose of the course is to become familiar with JavaScript programming and JQuery. The course will also utilize existing plugins to add dynamic effects to the page. Finally, the assessment will be based on practical exercises.

notes: 計網電腦教室，限本系生 40 人修

description.zh: 本課程以介紹資料庫之概念、技術與資訊安全的基礎知識為主，並介紹進階資料庫技術應用，包括下列主題：資料庫系統簡介、紀錄儲存與檔案組織、索引檔案結構、關聯性模型、關聯性幾何及演算法、SQL 查詢語言… 等。
description.en: This course provides an introduction to the concepts, techniques, and fundamentals of database and information security, along with advanced database technologies and applications, including a comprehensive review of the database system, storage and organization of records, index file structure, relational model, relational geometry, algorithms, and SQL query language.

name.zh: 工控資料庫系統與資訊安全
name.en: Industrial Control Database System and Information Security

notes: 計中電腦教室

description.zh: 本課程旨在教導學生瞭解各類化工程序模式的建立以及其求解的方法。內容包括：輸送動態方程式之建立，線性、非線性、矩陣、微分方程等之轉換及求解。
description.en: The goal of process simulation is to develop numerical analysis techniques that allow students to simulate the behavior of a chemical process. The contents involving：the development of dynamic equations of transport, the transformations and solutions of linear, nonlinear matrix, and differential equations.

class.name: 能源光電外國學生專班

notes: 網路預選限 40 人；計中電腦教室

description.zh: 無塵室之構成、恆溫恆溼控制、粉塵控制、過濾系統、環境測定、操作管理、針對電子工業之應用。
description.en: Clean room system, temperature and humidity control, particle control, filtering system, testing and measurement, operation and maintenance. This course focuses on the application in the electronic industry.

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋了基於各種檢測模式 (如化學修飾、電化學、光學與半導體科技) 的化學與生醫感測器的基礎知識以及利用電子元件感測生理訊號。 主題包括感測原理、常見的化學感測器、生物感測器、選擇策略、元件設計以及醫療保健、環境監測和工業等領域的應用。課程安排除了感測器文獻之相關課堂討論之外，也會安排學者講座。學生參加所有講座和參加課堂討論是課程的必修部分。
description.en: This course covers the fundamentals of chemical sensors and biosensors based on chemical modifications, electrochemistry, spectroscopy, semiconductor technologies, and physiological electrical signal measurements. Topics include sensing principles, commonly used sensors, strategies for achieving selectivity and adequate limits of detection, design of devices, and applications in health care, environmental monitoring, industry, and military areas. Articles from the current literature are discussed. We will also invite researchers to introduce current research. Active student participation is expected as an integral part of the course.

notes: 化工大四。化工。生化所和半導體碩班合開，請安排 PBL 教室

description.zh: 熱傳學主要內容是研究由於溫度梯度所造成能量傳遞之一門學問﹐為一般冷凍、空調、食品冷藏及各類型熱交換器設計之基本知識程，其他大如各類發電廠，小如電腦微晶片散熱亦有密切關係。本課程之安排以奠定學生在熱傳方面之智能，作為未來進入冷凍、空調與能源相關學門之踏腳石。

Fundamentals of turbulence, turbulent boundary layers, turbulent flow in ducts8.	Heat transfer with phase change: boiling and condensation9.	Introduction to heat-exchanger design

description.zh: 自動化應用基礎，自動化規劃設計︰1. 個體冷凍設備 2. 冷凍系統運轉操作 3. 冷凍倉儲管理自動化 4. 低溫冷凍應用自動化
description.en: Fundamentals and design of automation applications include:1. Unitary refrigeration equipment.2. Refrigerating system operation.3. Refrigerated warehousing management.4. Low temperature refrigeration application.

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹專業英文論文的寫作格式，以及文件編修的技巧，且用深入淺出的例子作為示範，並輔以實際寫作練習與錯誤訂正。學員學習研究論文組織寫作，包含修改本身論文結構之基本技巧﹐正確組織文章的各個片段，避免口語用字寫字的陋習，使所作之文章能掌握其涵意，亦即能更有效率的利用英文寫出科技論文之佳作。
description.en: The goal of English Technical Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

notes: 博士班必修

description.zh: 邀請校內外學者專家至校針對某一專長領域進行專題演講，讓學生藉由聽講及心得報告之寫作，開展視野，並與時代之脈動相契合。
description.en: Invited speakers from different disciplines give speech in their specialized area. Thus students can broaden their eyesight and also keep updating the technology and its applications of the generation.

name.zh: 專題討論 - 化學工程組

notes: 限博士班化工組選課，和化工碩合開

notes: 限博士班生化組選課，和生化碩合開

description.zh: 研究生在教授之個別指導下，針對特定研究主題進行研究，並將研究成果寫成論文。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis.

notes: 限博士班選課；擬 114-2 畢業者，須累計加選 4 門 12 學分

description.zh: 物聯網應用介紹、電腦與感測器資訊擷取傳輸、通訊協定與資訊安全
description.en: Introduction to Internet of Things applications, computer and sensor information acquisition and transmission, communication protocols and information security

name.en: Introduction to Internet of Things Applications

description.zh: 基礎知識與定義、大氣汙染、空氣汙染物、水文循環、水質處理、水汙染、固體廢棄物、大地汙染、噪音汙染、工業廢氣處理。
description.en: Basics and definitions, atmospheric and land pollutions, air pollurants, hydrology, water pollution and treatment, solid waste, noise pollution, industrial exhaust air treatment.

description.zh: 衛星遙測應用與實作的課程主要介紹衛星遙測技術的基本原理、應用場景和實作方法。課程內容通常包括以下幾個方面：衛星遙測基礎知識，衛星遙測數據來源和平臺，衛星遙測數據處理與分析，衛星遙測應用案例，衛星遙測應用實作。本課程一半以上的時間將為實作，學生將熟習在遙測分析軟體上分析真正的衛星資料，並在學期末遞交對自選主題之一研究報告。
description.en: The course of "Applications of Satellite Remote Sensing" mainly introduces the basic principles, application scenarios, and practical methods of satellite remote sensing technology. The course content usually includes the following aspects: basic knowledge of satellite remote sensing, satellite remote sensing data sources and platforms, satellite remote sensing data processing and analysis, satellite remote sensing application cases, and satellite remote sensing application practices. More than half of the time in this course will be spent on practical exercises, where students will become proficient in analyzing real satellite data using remote sensing analysis software. At the end of the semester, students will submit a research report on one of their self-selected topics.

notes: 億光 405 教室

description.zh: 為培養土木工程系大學部學生瞭解設計圖中內容，本課程採用實務的教學方式，以工程師實際面對的建築設計圖、結構設計圖、土木設計圖及機電設計圖等，加以解說圖面內容並引導學生理解設計涵義及實作演練。並結合工程知識、營建工程實務操作及專案管理領域整合的能力，使學生畢業後與業界無縫接軌。本課程主要內容如下：1. 熟悉一個工程或建案中必備之完整圖面內容 2. 熟悉設計圖上各種符號、線條之用處及表示的意義 3. 結構標準圖、配筋圖與施工規範之解說 4. 如何依設計圖進行工程品質之查驗 5. 其他與勞工安全相關知識等
description.en: To improve undergraduate civil engineering students to understand the design drawings reading ability.  This course provides a set of design drawings, such as building, structural, civil and MEP design drawings, for instructors to explain the meaning of the design drawing, and guide the students to read the related drawings. The course also includes practical exercise for students to read the drawings, and to understand the information in the drawings. The course will also involves the knowledge of engineering to enhance the integration ability of all the design drawings for the students. The contents of this  course are listed as below:1.To familiar with the whole set design drawings.2.To familiar with the meaning of symbols, lines and expression in the design drawings.3.To understand general notes, general drawings, reinforcement and specification in structural design drawings.4.How to inspect the construction quality by the design drawings.5.Other topics about labor-safety

notes: 上限 40 人 / 土木二甲乙合開 土木館 500 電化教室

description.zh: 介紹工程成本運算的各種方法，藉由不同的數學分析技巧推估並了解不同工程資金運用方案的差異性，以為決策評估及成本控制的依據。
description.en: Economics can be said to be satisfaction of wants by the allocation of scarce factors. Construction economy introduces various methods of financial cash flow to analyze the priority of infrastructures. Moreover, it provides a systematic framework for evaluating the economic aspects of competing design solutions.

notes: 土木二甲乙合開

description.zh: 本課程旨在學習運用 AI 資料分析與生成技術，結合文化內容設計與產業案例研究，發展具策略性的文化創意提案。課程內容涵蓋文化議題研究、AI 應用方法與數據敘事技巧，並透過探討 AI 驅動的行銷活動，培養學生在文化產業與社群溝通中的影響力。
description.en: This course aims to develop students’ ability to apply AI-based data analysis and generative technologies in combination with cultural content design and industry case studies to create strategic cultural and creative proposals. The curriculum covers cultural issue research, AI application methods, and data storytelling techniques. By examining AI-driven marketing practices, the course fosters students’ capacity to enhance their influence in cultural industries and community communication.

notes: 計網電腦教室，上限 40 人

description.zh: 本課程講授內容兼顧理論與實務。促使學習土木工程學生瞭解施工安全及衛生的重要性，如何規劃推動各項安全管理實務工作。確認施工觀念，發揮全面防災功能，確保施工安全與衛生。
description.en: The objective of this course is to introduce the protection of fire engineering， It will cover: Safety and disaster preclusion of opencast ground、foundation construction、hypothesis engineering、structure engineering、fitment engineering etc.

notes: 土木三 & 防災所合開 / 大學 15 人 / 土木 205

description.zh: 基礎地盤若是軟弱土壤 (例軟粘土，泥炭土，鬆砂土填土等) 所構成時，則無法安全承載其上面建築物結構物，土堤等之載重，並且受交通車輛，機械振動地震等之動力作用亦最容易發生剪力破壞，滑動破壤及過大沈陷等安全問題。因此，對於這些軟弱土壤之工程性質要加以改善的必要. 1. 軟弱地盤之定義，種類與影響 2. 軟弱地盤之調查目的及調查種類 3. 軟弱地盤之調查方法與步驟 4. 軟弱土壤性質之測定 5. 軟弱地盤之改良方法 (包括夯實工法，排水工法，預載重方法，動力壓 密工法，爆破工法，振動揚實工法，注入工法，石灰穩定工法及其他穩定工法).
description.en: Soil Improvement is very important for embankments and foundations in construction engineering.This course deals with the following subjects:1.definition of soft ground 2.types of soft soil.3.investigation methods of soft soils. 4.improvement methods of soft ground(include compaction method,dewatering method,preloading method,dynamic consolidation method,vibrofloation method,injection method and soil-lime stabilization method.)

notes: 上限 40 人 / 土木三甲乙合開

description.zh: 土木營造工程範圍廣泛，各種法營造工法更是不計其數，本課程教授學生幾種常見之施工法：一、土方工程：1. 土壤調查 2. 挖方 3. 填方 4. 搬運 5. 軟弱地盤之處理 6. 土方作業計劃 7. 作業能力估算。二、混凝土工程：1. 混凝土材料及其性質 2. 配比設計 3. 混凝土之攪料、灌置與搗實 4. 混凝土之養護與品質控制。三、基礎工程：1. 基礎之種類 2. 淺基礎 3. 樁基礎 4. 沈箱 5. 深開挖及擋土工程 6. 圍堰 7. 灌漿。四、專項工程：1. 河川工程 2. 海岸工程 3. 堰埧工程 4. 發電工程 5. 隊道工程 6. 橋梁工程 7. 港灣工程 8. 道路工程 9. 衛生下水道工程 10. 鐵路工程 11. 地下構造物工程 12. 建築工程 13. 機場工程。
description.en: public work,improving the land and the enviorment,and preventing the harricoms.Construction Methods includes elementary and applied methods.The purposes of this course are for students understanding the steps of various construction methods.

notes: 上限 40 人 / 土木三甲乙合開

description.zh: 給水及污水工程介紹自來水及汙水工程及其操作系統所需之原理、設計工具。其主要應用到流體力學、水文學、水處理及相關之設計及計算。主要的議題包含水質參數、地表水及地下水處理、自來水處理過程、汙染物移除、管網設計、汙水處理、生物處理、下水道建設、自來水及下水道操作及維護。
description.en: The Water Supply and Sewerage provides students with engineering principles and tools for designing and operating water and sewerage systems. It facilitates application of knowledge acquired in fluid mechanics, hydrology, water quality, design and computing. Key topics include water quality parameters; groundwater and surface water treatment; water treatment process technologies; nutrient removal; simplified sewerage; decentralised water and sanitation systems; biosolids management; and operation and maintenance of water supply and sanitation infrastructure.

notes: 上限 40 人 / 土木三甲乙合開

description.zh: 由於重大工程建設陸續開發，對環境之衝擊也日益明顯，因此環境影響評估制度之建立與執行也極為迫切，環境影響評估確能有效抑制開發工程中所可能形成的污染行為，本課程之目的即在介紹環境影響評估制度的演進、各國相關之評估法制、環境影響評估之應用、評估方法（專家委員法、圖形重疊法、矩陣法及網路法）、評估流程及環境影響評估之追蹤考核等單元，期使選修者，對環境影響評估建立正確和科學的認知。
description.en: EIA (Environmental Impact Assessment) is interdisciplinary and involves large numbers of different practicals.In this course the theory will be firstly introduced,then the case studies will also be discussed.

notes: 上限 40 人 / 土木三甲乙合開

description.zh: 配合化學課程之進展，教導學生學習各項基本實驗操作及儀器設備之技巧，進行各項實驗課程，如 COD 的測定，氮莫耳體積之測定，錯合物之生成，氧化還原滴定，以訓練學生養成手腦並用的務實科學素養。
description.en: Following the progress of the course of chemistry, introduce students to learn basically operations and techniques for several kinds of devices in a semester. The variety of scheduling laboratory experiments can be exercised for students. Including the determination of COD, the determination of molar nitrogen volume, the synthesis of complex, the determination of redox titration. This course is designed to train students how to use their brain and hands simultaneously.

description.zh: 在本課程中，同學將學習到計算機程式語言 Python 基礎與應用，建立 Python 程式設計的基本概念。透過做中學、學中做，建構程式設計的基礎，以及基本程式運算邏輯，以培養運算思維、動手做的能力。期末以分組方式完成一個與學生專業領域相關應用的專題，學習如何運用程式解決與自身相關領域運用上的問題。
description.en: In this course, students will learn the basics and applications of the Python programming language and establish the basic concepts of Python programming design. Through the continuous practice, student will construct the basic logic of the program design, and the ability of computation think and practice application. At the final, a topic related to the application of students' professional subjects will be completed in groups, and student will learn how to use the program to solve problems in the relevant fields.

name.zh: Python 程式設計概論與應用

notes: 自然與科學向度

description.zh: 在本課程中，同學將學習到計算機程式語言 Python 基礎與應用，建立 Python 程式設計的基本概念。透過做中學、學中做，建構程式設計的基礎，以及基本程式運算邏輯，以培養運算思維、動手做的能力。期末以分組方式完成一個與學生專業領域相關應用的專題，學習如何運用程式解決與自身相關領域運用上的問題。
description.en: In this course, students will learn the basics and applications of the Python programming language and establish the basic concepts of Python programming design. Through the continuous practice, student will construct the basic logic of the program design, and the ability of computation think and practice application. At the final, a topic related to the application of students' professional subjects will be completed in groups, and student will learn how to use the program to solve problems in the relevant fields.

name.zh: Python 程式設計概論與應用

notes: 自然與科學向度

description.zh: 學習相似於 Microsoft Power Point 的「拖 - 拉 - 點 - 選」操作方式，再加上一小部份的 Low Code 程式編碼，即可以設計與製作出:「專業級的 APP」 ! 本課程運用學校內的雲端平台: AgilePoint NX，改變了以往撰寫 APP 的模式，不再需要撰寫複雜的程式碼，讓學生專注於 APP 的邏輯流程與 UI (使用者介面)，進而發展貼近市場裡的商業模式，設計出精彩的 APP! 課程的教學，採用傳統臺北工專的黑手工程師訓練模式:「由經入史」: 先講解理論架構，進而延伸到產業的實務運用。嚴格要求上課同學動手實做，達成每週的設定目標。課堂上講師所示範的範例非常豐富，下課後會有一定份量的 Homework (實作型作業)。經此系統化訓練，在 APP 的設計與製作上，將擁有踏實的內涵與技術，增強在校學生，未來在職場上的競爭力。「讓不懂 IT (資訊工程)、非理工背景的學生，更能設計出高人氣的 APP! 」
description.en: Learn the "Click and Drag" operation method, as like Microsoft Power Point, and adds some Low-Code, you can design and create: "Professional APP"!This course uses the cloud platform in the school: AgilePoint NX, which changes the mode of writing APP in the past, no longer needs to write complex code, let students focus on the logic flow of the APP and UI (user interface), and then close to the market requirement. This course uses the Taipei Tech Practical-Engineer training method:"From Theory to Practical": First explain the theoretical structure, and then extend to the practical application of the industry. Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

name.en: Start to APP Design and Application

notes: 創新與創業向度

description.zh: 本課程之目標為：充實生活技能、提升科技素養、豐富生活內涵、培養繼續進修之興趣與能力，以奠定終身學習及生涯發展之基礎。本課程之內容為：一、電腦基本概念，二、電腦功能與應用，三、資料處理，四、資訊管理，五、資訊網路，六、電腦的聲光世界，七、電腦的安全問題與防治，八、未來的資訊社會。
description.en: This course is designed to help student to learn another skill, better understand technology, enrich there live and inspire their interests for further study. The course includes: 1.basic knowledge of computer; 2.the application of computer; 3.data procession; 4.data control; 5.internet; 6.multimedia; 7.computer virus; 8. the world of information.

notes: 自然與科學向度

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

notes: 自然與科學向度

description.zh: 透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en: The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

notes: 創新與創業向度

description.zh: 人類在從事數學演算、推理交談、觀察等各類動作時，均展現出 "智慧" 的現象。人工智慧即是利用電腦結合基本理論在有限度的範圍內從事上述各項工作，其中涵蓋了－自然語言了解、機器人學、電腦視覺、類神經網路、專家系統、自動化定理證明等，而本課程則主要在於提供必要之基礎，主要內容包括：1. 搜尋法則，2. 命題與敘述邏輯，3. 定理證明，4. 知識系統與知識表達， 5. 機器學習， 6. 基因與演化計算，7. 智慧型代理人。
description.en: Artificial intelligence seeks to introduce the elements of intelligence into programs and systems in application domain. Topics will include 1. Searching methods 2. Propositional and Predicate logic 3. Theorem Proving 4. Knowledge-based systems and representation of knowledge 5. Machine learning, 6. Genetic algorithms and evolutionary computing, 7. Intelligent agents.

description.zh: 本課程將帶領同學從兒童詩、繪本、小說、電影來品味兒童文學的真、善與美，藉此喚醒被世俗蒙塵的沉睡心靈，以重返純真的赤子心境。 教學方式以互動為主，期待藉由討論兒童文學名著，閱讀相關論文，來帶領同學進入兒童文學的殿堂。 除了閱讀與討論之外，還會教導同學創作；創作的內容含括了兒童詩及手工繪本製作。希望透過作品的完成，來喚起學生的創作興趣，並建立學生創作的信心。
description.en: This course will lead the students to read the poems, picture books, novels and films of children literature, and hope to find out the beauty of the children's world. Wish in this way can help the sleeping soul to wake up, and return to pure childhood state. This course will try to lead the classmates to appreciate the children's literature by discussing and questioning the masterpieces, hope in this happy way to help the students to get enter the children's literature. Besides reading and discussing, the course will also teach students how to write. The content of writing course would include the poem and the story which would ask the students to finish the work by themselves. Hope through the works, can arouse students' creation interest, and build up students' confidence of creation.

notes: 上限 18 人

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。使學生瞭解科學研究的特性、研究的類型、測量的程序與工具、資料的收集、資料的分析、撰寫研究計畫的方法，在從事管理問題之研究與探討時，知道如何正確選用適當方法，並取得所需資訊。
description.en: This course will introduce the selection of a research topic, construction of a bibliography, literature survey and data collection, and preparation of a research proposal.

description.zh: 這門課程主要的目的為提供學生們有關於資料庫系統的進階內容，包含：1.	最佳化查詢 2.	資料庫回復技術 3.	資料庫安全與權限 4.	物件式與物件關連式資料庫 5.	分散式資料庫與主從式架構 6.	主動式資料庫 7.	時間資料庫 8.	演譯式資料庫 9.	多媒體資料庫 10.	行動式資料庫 11.	XML 與網際網路資料庫 12.	資料倉儲與資料探勘
description.en: The purpose of this course is to provide students with the advanced concepts in current database systems, including: 1.	Query Processing and Optimization2.	Database Recovery Techniques3.	Security and Authorization4.	Object and Object-Relational Databases5.	Distributed Databases and Client-Server Architecture 6.	Active Databases 7.	Temporal Databases 8.	Deductive Databases 9.	Multimedia Databases 10.	Mobile Databases11.	XML and Internet Databases12.	Data Warehousing and Data Mining

notes: 電機所和創新 AI 合開，計網電腦教室

description.zh: 本課程以實踐機器人和人工智慧應用為核心，採用美國麻省理工學院 (MIT) 的專案任務導向學習模式。透過結合講授、討論、實際應用和案分析，課程將會幫助學生深入理解人工智慧和機器人技術。學生有機會積極參與小組專案，透過情境思考實際應用所學知識，並親自操作機器學習工具和機器人平臺，以培養實際技能。
description.en: This course is designed for practical application of robotics and artificial intelligence (AI). It adopts the project-based learning model inspired by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). The course combines lectures, discussions, practical applications, and case studies to provide students with an in-depth understanding of AI and robotics technology. Students will have the opportunity to engage in group projects, apply their knowledge in real-world scenarios, and gain hands-on experience with machine learning tools and robot platforms.

name.zh: 機器人智慧：AI 應用與發展

notes: 密集授課，先鋒 1 樓 城市科學實驗室，2 週【停開】

description.zh: 本課程目標旨在介紹計算智能、軟性計算與演化計算的相關演算法與進階應用。內容包括：爬山法與模擬退火、基因演算法、粒子群優演算法、蜂群演算法等相關內容。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the computational intelligence, soft computing, evolutionary algorithm, relative algorithms and their applications. The course covers the subjects on Hill-Climbing Algorithm, Simulated Annealing, Genetic Algorithm, Particle Swarm Optimization, Artificial Bee Colony and so on.

description.zh: 為保障著作人著作權益，調和社會公共利益，促進國家文化發展，國家特制定著作權法；本課程重心在於介紹我國著作權法之內涵，包含該法所保護之「著作」範圍、權利人及著作權範圍、著作權管理及權利侵害之救濟等，除講授理論外，同時搭配案例解析，以期讓同學對著作權法有最完整之了解。
description.en: Copyright Act is specifically enacted for the purposes of protecting the rights and interests of authors with respect to their works, balancing different interests for the common good of society, and promoting the development of national culture. This course introduces the main meanings, concepts and contents of the Copyright Law. Including the scope for copyright protection, the kinds of works that qualify for copyright protection, the rights granted to copyright owners, the management of copyright, and remedies for right infringement. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples, to enhance a deeper understanding of Copyright for the students.

description.zh: 本所與美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院，已於 112 年 5 月 10 日簽署國際學術交流 MOU，而本所為響應學校推動國際化之政策，特別增開 1 門 1 學分之國際雙師課程。本課程乃由美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院院長 Megan Carpenter 教授、該學院智慧財產權中心主任 Micky Minhas 教授親自來台密集授課，主要提供給欲深入了解美國法律制度、美國智慧財產權法律體系之本所學生、校外實務界人士或欲對赴美留學有興趣人士來選修。而本課程之內容，共分成兩個部分，前半部將以美國法律 (包括法院、普通法、各部門法律等) 之介紹為主，至於後半部則詳細介紹美國智慧財產權各部門法律 (包含著作權法、專利法、營業秘密法、資料保護、商標法等)。而本課程之開課時間，以每學年度上學期之 10 月上旬，並為期 1 週為原則。當然，本課程開設之目的，乃以增強學生實際應用英語之能力，並以加強學生美國智慧財產權法律之知能為主，除了強化本所與美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院之學術交流關係外，更能夠擴展休課學生之國際人脈及視野。
description.en: Graduate Institute of Intellectual Property, National Taipei University of Technology (hereafter called this institute) had made a MOU of international academic cooperation with Franklin Pierce School of Law, University of New Hampshire on May 10, 2023. This institute wants to promote the international policy from the University, so this institute will open a one unit course for international double professional teachers. This course is personally and intensively taught by Professor/Dean Megan Carpenter and Professor/Director Micky Minhas of Franklin Pierce School of Law, University of New Hampshire, and it is mainly provided for this institute’s students, legal practitioners, or someone who are interested in studying in the U.S. for further understanding the U.S. legal and intellectual property law systems. Moreover, contents of this course are divided into two parts: the former part is introductions of the U.S. laws, including courts, common laws, and all aspects of laws, etc. But,

name.zh: 美國智慧財產權法律專題
name.en: Seminar on the U.S. Intellectual Property Law

description.zh: 以案例解析為主的方式，探究我國著作權法的重要課題，藉以協助同學了解審判實務適用法律的依據、判準或論證等，並適時補充國外相關學理、判決及著名案例等，以增進同學對國內外相關重要著作權案例之思辨及評析的能力。
description.en: This is a course focused on case analyses, in studying important issues relating to Taiwanese Copyright Act. Graduate students joining this course may find help on comprehension of the basis, rules or argumentation to the laws applied in trial practice.  Together with timely supplementation of relevant foreign academic interpretations, adjudications and noted cases, students may improve their ability of contemplation and analysis on related and significant copyright cases home and abroad.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹在計算機科學中常見或基本的資料結構，探討的主題包括: ADT (抽像資料型態) 及複雜度，靜態結構與儲存表示，陣列，堆疊，佇列，串列，樹狀結構，遞迴，排序，搜尋。
description.en: This course is mainly aimed at introducing the data structures commonly used in programming languages which include ADT (abstract data type) and complexity, static structures and their storage representations, arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, recursion, sorting, and searching.

description.zh: 本課程主要係以「與貿易有關之智慧財產權協定 (Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights，TRIPS) 」的內容為基準，分別再以比較法的觀點，探討我國專利法除罪化的問題；商標法、著作權法及營業秘密法如何以刑事罰適切保護智慧財產的課題，藉以釐清及調和違反智慧財產權的刑、民事責任。
description.en: Conducted on the basis of “Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights, TRIPS,” the course will probe into the issue of exemption of punishment among the Patent Act of Taiwan from different viewpoints of Trademark Act, Copyright Act, and Trade Secret Act. To clarify and mediate the criminal and civil liabilities originated from the violation of intellectual property right, the proper method to protect intellectual property with criminal punishment will be further discussed.

name.en: The Study of Intellectual Property Crime

description.zh: 區塊鏈和數位資產是未來金融和科技領域的重要趨勢之一，本課程將介紹區塊鏈以及數位資產的基本知識與原理，並探討如何利用區塊鏈以及比特幣技術搭建新型態的金融基礎設施與永續的生態系統，內容包含 (1) 區塊鏈基礎；(2) 比特幣運作原理；(3) 穩定幣等數位資產；(4) 比特幣進階，含閃電網路、側鏈、智能合約層、永續挖礦… 等；(5) 實體世界資產 (RWA，Real World Asset)；(6) 區塊鏈分析；(7) 法規與監管… 等，為參與課程的學生建立正確的區塊鏈與數位資產的觀念。
description.en: Blockchain and Digital Asset are one of the important trends in the future of finance and technology. This course will introduce the basic knowledge and principles of blockchain and digital assets, as well as explore how to use blockchain and Bitcoin technology to build a new type of financial infrastructure and sustainable ecosystem, the content includes (1) Blockchain basics; (2) Bitcoin operating principles; (3) Digital assets such as stable coins; (4) Bitcoin advanced including Lightning Network, Rootstock, Stacks, sustainable mining...etc. (5) Real World Asset (RWA); (6) Blockchain analysis; (7) Regulations and supervision... etc., to establish a correct concept of blockchain and digital assets for students participating in the course.

notes: 哈佛講堂 / 資財四甲、資財所合開

description.zh: 資訊安全保險相關事故的理賠調查，使得數位鑑識在金融或資訊領域的重要性日益提升。數位鑑識與調查課程主要說明如何找到入侵或犯罪留下的可能的足跡，並介紹如何在合法與符合鑑識程序規範的前提下蒐集足夠的證據並保護這些有用的證據，以做為未來訴訟有效的佐證。在課程的設計上將以數位鑑識相關國際證照的領域與內容為主，除了教授學生數位鑑識的專業知識外，期能輔導學生取得數位鑑識相關證照。
description.en: The cyber security incident investigation for the cyber insurance has made digital forensics more and more important in the financial or information industry. This course focuses on identifying possible footprints of intrusions or crimes and collecting sufficient evidence and protect such useful evidence in order to be effective in future litigation. In the design of the course, the domain and content of the digital forensics international certification licenses will be mainly used. In addition to teaching the professional knowledge of digital forensics, it can also help the students obtain digital forensics certification in the future.

notes: 資財所和創新資安合開

description.zh: 文化研究以文學，社會批評，通俗文化，人類學、科學、女性主義和種族批評等觀點，對文化現象做深入的觀察、思考、及批判。本課程著重應用文化研究之豐碩成果，啟發學生認識文化問題，並培養其觀察，思考，及批判能力。不僅能因之促成社會進步，更重要的是能藉由對本國及異國文化差異及價值觀的深入瞭解，將知識應用在跨文化溝通上，協助本國企業成功地國際化。
description.en: Cultural studies is emerging as one of the most inspiring and exciting fields in and out of the academy.  Drawing its energies from literary and social criticism, popular culture, anthropology and the sciences, feminism and critiques of race, cultural studies involves an infinite number of ingenious, politically contingent, and often popularly amusing subjects.  Hopefully, students taking this course are trained to become independent, critical thinkers who are able to observe, analyze, criticize, and ameliorate culture.  By addressing diverse cultural issues, students can not only deepen their understanding of different cultural values but also apply this knowledge to improve cross-cultural communication.  One of the practical purposes of this course is to enable students to help local enterprises boost their business on the global stage of commerce.

name.zh: 文化研究與跨文化溝通

description.zh: 本課程將對公司治理做系統性的介紹。公司治理係指公司可以透過一系列的內部和外部公司治理機制設計來降低公司代理問題、提升公司價值。修課同學可以藉由閱讀指定參考文獻及教材並且在課堂上進行口頭報告，可以培養同學撰寫碩士論文及口頭報告的能力。
description.en: This course aims to present the concept of corporate governance. Corporate governance involves a series of mechanisms designed to mitigate agency problems within a corporation and enhance its value. We will cover both internal and external aspects of corporate governance. Students in the class are required to present a journal article and other assigned readings. All the training is intended to help students learn how to conduct their master thesis and improve their confidence in oral presentations.

description.zh: 本課程之主要目的在於教授都市設計的基本分析理論與方法，除透過課堂案例的介紹與討論外，學生還將以分組方式進行觀察研究與運算分析。案例介紹與討論之重點在於認識影響都市空間環境品質的關鍵要素，而分組研究之目的則在於讓學生藉由各種現場觀察與數位分析工具的應用，進一步探索這些關鍵要素在都市空間形構過程的交互影響過程。
description.en: This course aims to introduce students to key theoretical and methodological approaches in urban design. The main content will be delivered through a series of case study discussion and project-based research practice. In specific, the case study is to review and identify key factors shaping the physical environment of cities; while through collaborative research projects, students are expected to engage in a step-by-step process of on-site observation and computational analysis, examining how the factors are interacting with each other.

notes: 建都所和設計博班合開

description.zh: 循環型建築專題旨在深入探討循環經濟理念如何融入建築領域，結合搖籃到搖籃（cradle to cradle) 的理論和「以終為始」的設計方法，學習分析國內外成功的循環型建築案例，掌握再生建材選用、模組化設計等相關技術應用，系統性地探討如何在建築設計、材料選擇與建築全生命周期管理中，實現資源的高效利用與廢棄物的最小化，並運用環境評估工具量化建築的環境效益，引導學生多元領域學習，在建築設計中提出兼具環境、社會與經濟平衡之構想，以及創新的建築設計解決方案，最終培養其在循環經濟框架下的永續建築設計能力。
description.en: The course aims to explore in depth how the principles of the circular economy can be integrated into the field of architecture. By combining the *Cradle to Cradle* theory with the "designing from the end" approach, students will analyze successful cases of circular architecture from both domestic and international contexts. They will gain proficiency in key technical applications, such as the selection of recycled materials and modular design. The course systematically examines how to achieve efficient resource utilization and minimize waste across architectural design, material selection, and building lifecycle management. Students will also learn to apply environmental assessment tools to quantify the environmental benefits of buildings. By fostering interdisciplinary learning, the course encourages students to propose architectural concepts that balance environmental, social, and economic considerations.

notes: 建都所和設計博班合開

description.zh: 本課程的目的是研究人與環境互動的關係，介紹環境心理學發展的過程及相關的理論。並藉由觀察與評估現有生活環境中的行為，增進我們對環境心理學中在理論與經驗上不同取向的瞭解。課程內容包括 1. 緒論 2. 研究方法及理論架構 3. 建成環境，由家環境到城市空間 4. 社會行為及實質環境 5. 自然環境與行為 6. 使用者用後評估 7. 結論
description.en: The purpose of this course is to explore the interaction relationships between human and environment, introducing the development and theory of environmental psychology. Via observing and evaluating the behavior of present living environment, enhance our knowledge about environmental psychology through various approaches to theories and experiences. The course includes:1. Introduction  2. Research methods and theory framework 3. The built environment from home environment to city space 4. Social behavior and the physical environment 5. The natural environment and behavior 6. Post-occupancy evaluation 7. Conclusion

notes: 建都所和設計博班合開

description.zh: 課程分為兩主軸，技術成面上討論與人互動之設計領域研究的理論與操作。在研究理論方面則介紹人機互動相關之研究工具、研究方法、人機互動實驗設計、統計與假說驗證，以及受試者保護規範之實驗計畫書撰寫。
description.en: Technologically, this course reviews the recent developments on research-based interaction design. Theoretically, this course introduces the theories and methodologies of the research applications in the field of human-computer interaction and teaches how to design a HCI experiment.

notes: 互動日碩一 (限研究組)、外碩一和設計博班合開

description.zh: 服務設計的方法乃是透過相關資源做適當的規劃與組織，已提昇使用者與服務提供者間之服務及互動的品質。其主要的架構與方法乃在於了解使用者的行為、需求及動機後，創造具友善性、競爭性、及相關性的使用者經驗。本課程將以服務設計的概念與方法為核心，以使用者需求及經驗的創造為基礎，探討並分析不同的互動技術的適用情境及其發展與應用領域。
description.en: Service design is the activity of planning and organizing related resources of service in order to improve its quality and the interaction between service provider and users. The backbone of service design methodologies is to understand the behavior of the users, their needs and motivations, so that to create user-friendly, competitive and relevant service to the users. The service design concepts and methodologies and user experience analysis are used in this course for discussing the developments and applications of interactive technologies in the aspects of various scenarios and application fields.

notes: 互動日碩、設計博班合開，PBL 教室，限 30 人

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹人機介面設計過程中所需了解之相關專業知識，俾使學生能在進行互動介面設計中，具備充分之理論基礎，同時了解人機介面設計之相關研究與應用，始其具有能進行人機使用者介面實務製作與企劃之能力。課程內容包含介面設計概念模式、介面使用性、人機介面設計程序、使用者需求、介面原型設計、介面設計原則以及使用者測試與評估等。教學將以課堂講授、個案研討以及實作等方式進行，並以報告繳交與課堂發表及作品為評量依據。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the knowledge for human-computer interaction (HCI) design. Students can understand the basic knowledge, application and research relevant to HCI design, which make them to be capable of practical interface design and planning. This course is set up under the structure of Human-Machine-Scenario theory and case study. The contents include concept model of interface design, interface usability, HCI process, user requirements, interface prototyping, principles of interface design and user testing. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, case study and practical work, and evaluated by students' reports, oral presentation and desi

notes: 互動日碩 / 外碩 / 創新所 / 設計博班合開，一般教室 (45 人)

description.zh: 「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo 未來思考與趨勢前瞻，有助於讓每一位同學思索未來社會可能轉變得新趨勢和新的需求。無論同學希望學習或專精的技能為何，如何應用 該技能，提前 選擇一個在未來對社會或個人更可能有所助益的方向練習、實作，不斷繼續前進，才能夠將個人的意義進一步投射至未來的社會價值中；如此一來，未 來社會也將會給給予你應有的報酬。未來思考的課程，將師承奇點大學客座教授，同時也是美國史丹佛大學設計學院特聘助理教授 Paul Saffo 的 Forecasting 課程，內容將有 - 現況觀察、趨勢分析、未來事件辯論、未來趨勢矩陣圖、前瞻思考經典賞析（包含文章與電影） 等。
description.en: 「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul SaffoFuture Studies & Forecasting will be more and more important skill for every young generation students. What will the future look alike? What is the driving forces pushing us from current to the future? How many pace layers of future arrivals?In this class, we will discuss Stanford consulting prof. Paul Saffo’s Future Studies & Forecasting methods, by – Observing current trends, future event debate, Matrices and Axes of Uncertainty, future mindset developing, etc.

notes: 互動日碩、外碩和設計博班合開，PBL 教室，1 週【停開】

description.zh: UX（User Experience）使用者經驗設計師，是一種特別需要橫向與縱向技能的設計師。本課程從物件 (objects) 、流程 (processes)、體驗 (experiences)、敘事 (narratives) 四個不同的脈絡切面，讓學生了解使用者經驗設計師的必備知識、技能與工具。學生將學會結合使用者研究的質性和量化方法及其工具來塑造實體與數位產品或服務的資訊架構。另一方面，本課程也深入探討 UX 於學術研究上的趨勢，讓學術與實務層面兼備。此外，學生將掌握如何利用簡報和視覺化溝通來促進組織內的設計決策，並學習 Prototype 設計規劃與實施易用性測試，使用實體與遠端工具。課程中也將介紹如何運用生成式 AI 輔助 UX 研究與設計。
description.en: User experience designers are designers who particularly require horizontal and vertical skills. This course allows students to understand the necessary knowledge, skills, and tools of user experience designers from four different aspects: objects, processes, experiences, and narratives. Students will learn to combine qualitative and quantitative methods and tools of user research to shape the information architecture of physical and digital products or services. In addition, students will master how to use briefings and visual communication to promote design decisions within the organization and learn to prototype design planning and implement usability testing using physical and remote tools. The course will also introduce how to use generative AI to assist UX research and design. On the other hand, this course also profoundly explores the trends of UX in academic research, integrating both academic and practical aspects.

description.zh: 數據無處不在。隨著真實世界和數位世界交互影響，越來越多的設計決策有望得到數據分析的支持。本課程旨在培養設計師的數據素養技能。首先介紹對個性化產品和服務的需求，是如何從認知及情感面來創造更好的使用者經驗，並將數據資訊轉換為產品知識 / 服務設計 / 系統決策。大部分課堂時間將以研究導向的設計專題方式進行。完成本課程後，您將能夠：1. 區分批量生產及個性化設計 2. 了解如何將數據科學納入設計流程 3. 描述由不同來源（例如人類、機器或環境）生成的數據特徵和形式 4. 應用合適的工具 / 軟體來解釋小型或大型數據集 5. 了解在設計過程中使用數據的倫理與關鍵原則
description.en: Data is everywhere. As the physical and digital worlds have become intertwined, more and more design decisions are expected to be supported by data analytics. Hence, this course aims to build your data literacy skills as a designer. The course will begin by introducing the need for personalized products and services to create a better user experience. description.zh: 產品企劃對於一家公司來說非常重要，因為如果做得好，它可以減少資源支出，增加收入並創造利潤。新產品開發時，產品企劃的嚴謹與洞見為影響產品成敗的重要因素，本課程將介紹產品企劃的基本觀念、產品開發流程、產品策略、產品生命週期、市場區隔與企畫書的撰寫等。本課程以實際產品企劃案例作為教材，導入情境式教學，讓學生融入產品企劃個案之實境，於課堂上共同討論如何擬定個案的處理方式與企劃方法，達到理論與實務充分的對話。
description.en: Product planning is very important to a company because, when done properly, it can reduce resource expenditures, drive revenues, and generate profitability. In the development of new products, Product planning is an important factors affecting the success or failure of products. This course will introduce the basic concepts of product planning, product development process, product strategy, product life cycle, market segmentation, and Product planning book. This course takes real product planning cases as teaching materials, import situational teaching, and integrates students into the realities of product planning cases. We will discuss how to formulate the right decision-making and planning methods in class to achieve a dialogue between theory and practice.

description.zh: 本課程目的在瞭解國際金融科技的發展趨勢，並探討台灣目前金融科科技產業發展情形與因應作為。課程內容除了理論基礎介紹外，將邀請金融科技產業企業領袖與專業菁英演講，與學生交流互動，學生也須進行實作加深學習效果，希望藉此課程能讓學生掌握當前國際與台灣金融市場金融科技最新之實務脈動，分析並預測未來可能之發展。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to understand the development trends of international financial technology and to explore the current situation and responses of Taiwan's financial technology industry. In addition to introducing theoretical foundations, the course will invite leaders and professionals from the financial technology industry to give lectures and interact with students. Students will also engage in hands-on practice to deepen their learning. Through this course, it is hoped that students will gain insight into the latest practical trends in international and Taiwanese financial markets, and analyze and predict potential future developments in financial technology.

description.zh: UX（User Experience）使用者經驗設計師，是一種特別需要橫向與縱向技能的設計師。本課程從物件 (objects) 、流程 (processes)、體驗 (experiences)、敘事 (narratives) 四個不同的脈絡切面，讓學生了解使用者經驗設計師的必備知識、技能與工具。並隨著生成式 AI 的趨勢，介紹生成式 AI 如何輔助 UX 設計師進行使用者研究與設計。同時，培養學生未來能在特定專業領域持續發展使用者體驗設計師職能的視野和態度，以及 UX 設計師在職場上的角色定位。 學生將學會結合使用者研究的質性和量化方法及其工具來塑造實體與數位產品或服務的資訊架構。此外，他們將掌握如何利用簡報和視覺化溝通來促進組織內的設計決策。課程將涵蓋 UX、LEAN UX、Agile UX 與 Scrum 等不同設計開發流程的實踐。學生也會學習 Prototype 設計規劃與實施易用性測試，使用實體與遠端工具。課程中也將介紹如何運用生成式 AI 輔助 UX 研究與設計。
description.en: UX (User Experience) designers require both broad and specialized skills. This course provides students with a comprehensive understanding of the necessary knowledge, skills, and tools for UX designers through the context of four different aspects: objects, processes, experiences, and narratives. Students will learn to integrate qualitative and quantitative user research methods and tools to shape the information architecture of both physical and digital products or services. Additionally, they will master how to use presentations and visual communication to facilitate organizational design decisions. The course covers practical processes of various design development workflows, such as UX, LEAN UX, Agile UX, and Scrum. Students will also learn prototype design planning and how to conduct usability testing with both physical and remote tools. The course will also illustrate the use of generative AI in assisting UX research and design.

description.en: An introduction to furniture production and marketing systems. Emphasis is on the role of marketing in a managerial context. Areas studied include: Product development, marketing research and information systems, pricing, adverising, promotion, distribution and inventory management.

description.zh: 先修課程：4402014 或負責教授同意一維及多維穩定態熱傳導及非穩定態熱傳導；對流原理，強迫對流及自然對流經驗和實驗關係式；輻射熱傳遞；凝結與沸騰；熱交換器；熱傳遞中的特殊論題。
description.en: Steady-State Conduction-One Dimension, Steady-State Conduction- Multiple Dimensions, Unsteady-State Conduction, Principles of Convection, Empirical and Practical Relations for Forced-Convection Heat Transfer, Natural- Convection Systems, Radiation Heat Transfer, Condensation and Boiling Heat Transfer, Heat Exchangers, Special Topics in Heat Transfer.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹工程上、物理上系統解析的相關數學工具，內容包括：1. 向量幾何與分析：矩陣行列式及特徵問題。2. 傅立葉級數，積分及轉換。3. 偏微分方程及邊界值問題。
description.en: This course intends to introduce the mathematical principles and practices that today's engineers need to know. The course contents are 1. Vector Algebra and Vector Analysis: Matrices and Determinants, Eigenvalue problems. 2. Fourier Series, Integral and Transforms. 3. Partial Differential Equations and Boundary Value Problems.

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國 95 年 2 月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國 95 年 2 月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

description.zh: 半導體晶片封裝及微電子元件構裝技術是將積體電路和其它電元件，依設計聯結在一系統中，再以構裝材料將晶片、基座及釘架封包。本課程將介紹陶瓷構裝和高分子構裝、及其相關技術、與工業現況。
description.en: Semiconductor chip packaging and microelectronic packaging is the critical technology to allow the chips be incorporated into an individual protective package, mounted with other components in hybrid or multichip modules, or connected directly onto a printed circuit board. This course will introduce both ceramic packaging and polymer packaging and their corresponding technology.

description.zh: 設計方法隨著技術演進逐步發展。本課程將介紹從 Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) 到 Design for X (DFX) 的設計方法。在創造具有複雜幾何形狀的產品時，3D 列印 (又稱積體製造 additive manufacturing) 是具備潛力的設計工具，特別是對於定制符合人體工程學的設備。本課程將透過專題實作與討論，讓學生探索設計方法對於 3D 列印的影響。完成本課程後，您將能夠：1. 描述設計方法的演變 2. 討論藝術家、設計師和工程師之間的差異 3. 了解不同 3D 列印技術的製程優勢和限制 4. 分解從藝術到零件的 3D 工作流程 5. 使用數位設計工具來優化 3D 零件的應用要求
description.en: Design methodologies can evolve with the emergence of advanced technologies. This course will introduce a historical account of design methodologies from Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) to Design for X (DFX). In this regard, additive manufacturing (AM), also known as 3D printing, has great potential for creating products with complex geometric, particularly for custom-fit ergonomic devices. Project-based activities will be carried out for students to explore the effects of good and bad designs for 3D printing.Upon completing this course, you will be able to:1.Describe the evolution of design methodologies 2.Discuss the differences between an artist, a designer, and an engineer   3.Identify the key advantages and process-specific constraints of AM technology4.Breakdown the 3D workflow from art to part  5.Use computational design tools to optimal application requirements for 3D parts

description.zh: 《數位影像處理實務》是一門以基礎理論結合實作應用為核心的課程，內容涵蓋影像處理中最重要且最常用的技術。本課程從影像基本概念與系統介紹開始，依序講解點運算、鄰域運算、離散傅立葉轉換與頻率域分析。接續介紹影像增強、影像復原以及影像分割等核心主題。課程著重於以程式實作理解演算法原理，搭配 MATLAB 或 Python 完成影像處理任務，使學生能夠掌握空間域與頻率域的實作技巧。本課程特別適合修過《訊號與系統》與修過或正在修習《數位訊號處理》的學生，作為進入電腦視覺與人工智慧／機器學習影像領域的基礎。
description.en: Digital Image Processing Practice is a hands-on course focusing on fundamental techniques widely used in modern image processing systems. The course begins with an overview of digital imaging concepts, followed by point processing, neighborhood processing, and Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT)-based frequency-domain analysis. Students will also learn essential methods for image enhancement, image restoration, and image segmentation.The course emphasizes understanding algorithms and practical implementation through programming exercises using MATLAB or Python, covering both spatial-domain and frequency-domain processing techniques. This course is especially suitable for students who have taken Signals and Systems and who have taken or are currently taking Digital Signal Processing. It provides an essential foundation for entering the fields of computer vision and Artificial Intelligence/Machine-Learning-based image processing.

description.zh: 本課程將涵蓋討論光電學之基本應用原理並結合分子生物學之知識 （諸如 脫氧核糖核酸核糖核酸 蛋白質 或細胞的基本結構介紹） 希望能更拓展學員對光電學應用的眼界本課程目標將藉由了解光電探測儀器之操作應用，光源控制，與光源種類之差異（諸如 gamma 射線，X - 射線，UV 光，紅外線與可見光), 進而將之應用於生物分子的觀察，與生命科學應用上，範圍之廣無可界限.
description.en: This course covers optoelectronics combine with biomolecular of knowledge. We will focus on discussing how the DNA, RNA, protein or cells related with optoelectronic application.Optoelectronics is the study and application of electronic devices that source, detect and control light, usually considered a subfield of photonics. The light often includes invisible forms of radiation such as gamma rays, X-rays, ultraviolet and infrared, in addition to visible light, which is based on the quantum mechanical effects of light on semiconducting materials. A biomolecule is any organic molecule that is produced by a living organism, including large polymeric molecules such as proteins, polysaccharides, and nucleic acids as well as small molecules such as primary metabolites, secondary metabolites, and natural products. As organic molecules, biomolecules consist primarily of carbon and hydrogen, nitrogen, and oxygen, and, to a smaller extent, phosphorus and sulfur.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹企業進行國際化策略以及多國籍企業營運與其功能性（價值鏈活動）之議題。期使學生瞭解當代企業國際化營運的重要性與其內涵，並建立整體的概念。同時，藉由精選案例之探討，提供學習者了解企業進行國際化與國際營運管理相關的實務作法。如此，將使學習者得將國企理論與概念運用於實際案例，培養分析能力。
description.en: The course is mainly for the students to understand the importance of international business strategies of MNC (Multi-Nation Company) which includes the business models, value chain and the functionality. In the mean time, the students will have a clear picture of MNC's daily operation by well-selected case study. The ultimate goal is to apply the theory into the real business world and to have an advanced analysis capability at the end of the course.

description.zh: 本課程將閱讀並討論聯合國 2030 年持續發展議程的議題，主題和做法。 藉由對全球繁榮，社會平等和環境可持續性共同藍圖的認識，學生能進一步參加全球活動，並在本地和跨域發展共同夥伴關係，以參與持續發展目標的行動。 此外，學生將能夠通過批判性閱讀和討論來強化英語能力，並為與可持續發展目標有關的更深入的交流做好準備。
description.en: This course will read and discuss issues, topics, and practices of the UN’s 2030 agenda for sustainable development, adopted by all UN member states. With full insights and comprehensive views of the shared blueprint for global prosperity, social equality and environmental sustainability, students are expected to participate in global activities and form partnership locally and across borders to engage in SDGs actions. In addition, students will be able to enhance their English competence through critical reading and discussion, and will be prepared for more in-depth communication pertaining to the SDGs.

description.zh: 本課程將閱讀並討論聯合國 2030 年持續發展議程的議題，主題和做法。 藉由對全球繁榮，社會平等和環境可持續性共同藍圖的認識，學生能進一步參加全球活動，並在本地和跨域發展共同夥伴關係，以參與持續發展目標的行動。 此外，學生將能夠通過批判性閱讀和討論來強化英語能力，並為與可持續發展目標有關的更深入的交流做好準備。
description.en: This course will read and discuss issues, topics, and practices of the UN’s 2030 agenda for sustainable development, adopted by all UN member states. With full insights and comprehensive views of the shared blueprint for global prosperity, social equality and environmental sustainability, students are expected to participate in global activities and form partnership locally and across borders to engage in SDGs actions. In addition, students will be able to enhance their English competence through critical reading and discussion, and will be prepared for more in-depth communication pertaining to the SDGs.

description.zh: 伴隨全球資訊網 (Web) 普及應用，可讓不同裝置、系統運行相同網路服務的網頁平台儼然成為當下資訊系統的主要潮流，過去網頁系統的建構可區分成 1. 網頁前端 (Front-end)：主負責使用者看見的瀏覽器端，以及 2. 網頁後端 (Back-end)：主負責運算、儲存資源的伺服器端，不同面向的軟體人才必須熟悉不同軟體實作技巧，然而，面臨物聯網 (Internet of Things)、第 5 代行動通訊 (5G) 的挑戰，產業需要能夠同時精通前端與後端之軟體實作技術，並進一步延伸支援外部系統整合與介接的全端 (Full Stack) 軟體人才，本課程主旨為教授網頁前端、後端軟體實作技巧，並結合新一代網路協定，以及外部感測裝置，建構出全方位之網頁系統軟體。
description.en: With the growth of World Wide Web, the web platform can let different devices and systems operate the same network service. Thus, the web platform has become the key foundation of modern software implementation. In the past, it can be divided into (1) front-end, which represents the user-side browser, and (2) back-end, which represents the server of data processing and storage. Programmers need to learn different front-end or back-end techniques. However, regarding 5G and Internet of Things, industries need full-stack software programmers. The goal of this course is to teach the front-end and back-end software implementation. Furthermore, the course would introduce how to integrate new network protocols and connect embedded sensors. After learning in this course, students are expected to implement one comprehensive web software system.

description.zh: 本課程的目的在深入探討地面核心網路系統結構和 Open Radio Access Network (ORAN) 的實務應用。課程內容包括地面核心網路技術、架構設計原則，以及相關技術的實作。學生將透過理論探討和實際操作，深入瞭解地面核心網路在通信系統中的關鍵角色，並學會設計、建置和維護這些系統。同時，課程聚焦於 ORAN 的實際應用，提供學生實務操作的機會，使其能夠理解並應用 ORAN 標準於實際網路環境。學生將學習 ORAN 的基本原理、架構，以及與傳統基地台技術的比較。透過專題實作，學生有機會參與 ORAN 的設計和實施，強化他們的實務能力。藉由此課程，學生將建立堅實的理論基礎，同時習得實際應用的經驗，為他們未來在通信科技領域的職業發展打下穩固基礎。
description.en: This course explores the practical applications of ground network system architecture and Open Radio Access Network (ORAN). Topics include ground network technologies, design principles, and hands-on implementation. Students will gain a deep understanding of the vital role of ground networks in communication systems and develop skills in designing, building, and maintaining these systems. The course also focuses on practical ORAN applications, offering students hands-on experience to understand and apply ORAN standards in real network environments. Through projects, students will engage in the design and implementation of ORAN, enhancing their practical skills and establishing a strong foundation for future careers in communication technology.

description.zh: 本課程的目標在於使學生學習完整的系統級封裝 (SiP) 之雛型設計。介紹 SIP 生產中使用的系統設計技術，分割、整合、覆晶、線接合、多層堆疊、高密度黏著技術和量測方法；再介紹訊號與電源完整分析。使得 SiP 應用基材特性與電路佈局的概念能完成 SiP 設計。本課程之大綱如下所示：1.SiP 設計簡介 2. 晶片互連技術 3. 晶圓級堆疊封裝技術 4. 覆晶技術   5. 線接合技術 6. 多層堆疊技術 7. 高密度黏著技術量測方法 8. 訊號完整分析 9. 電源完整分析 10. 設計實例
description.en: The goal of this course is that the students will learn SiP prototyping design and Applications. This course will introduce the systematic design methodology of the SiP technologies, partitioning, integration, Flip-Chip, wire bonding, muti-stacks, high density sticking, measurement. Moreover, the signal and power integrity analysis will be introduced here. Therefore, the students can use the properties of SiP substrate and schematics layout concept to implement the SiP design. The outline of this course are shown as follows:1.Basic Principle of SiP Design2.Interconnection Technologies Between Chips3.Packing Technology of Die-level Stack4.Flip-Chip Technologies5.Wire Bonding Technologies6.Muti-stacks Technologies7.High density Sticking Technologies8.Measurement Methods9.Signal Integrity10.Power Integrity11.Design Case Study

name.zh: 系統級封裝之雛型設計與應用

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
