description.zh: 這門課程涵蓋應用微生物的理論與實作，基礎部分將由淺入深，著重在於微生物的基本知識的補強，包含分類、特性與代謝，同時能顧及非生物背景的學生對微生物基本生理與生態的理解。特論部分將分別討論微生物在現代生技、醫藥、農業與環保等領域的發展與應用，例如益生菌，益生原，益生質的差異以及各自的發展與應用，微生物發酵產物在醫學上的應用，微生物在土壤改良及病蟲害防治上的發展與應用，以及微生物在各種人造污染的清理上的發展與應用。實作方面，實務操作微生物基本操作及設備簡介，菌種分離，菌種鑑定，各種抑菌效果分析測試，以及產生抗生物質的微生物篩選。(中文 / 英文 上課)
description.en: This course covers both the theoretical and practical aspects of applied microbiology. The foundational section progresses from basic to advanced topics and emphasizes reinforcement of essential microbiological knowledge, including classification, characteristics, and metabolism. Instruction is designed to accommodate students without a biological background, ensuring understanding of basic microbial physiology and ecology. The advanced-topic section examines the development and applications of microbiology across modern biotechnology, medicine, agriculture, and environmental remediation. Examples include the differences in development and use of probiotics, prebiotics, and postbiotics; medical applications of microbial fermentation products; applications of microbes in soil improvement and pest/disease control; and the use of microorganisms for the remediation of various anthropogenic pollutants. The practical component covers hands-on microbiology techniques, an introduction to stand

name.zh: 應用微生物特論及實作
name.en: Advanced Topics and Practices in Applied Microbiology

notes: 生化所和化工所合開

description.zh: 各式數位科技已被廣泛應用在各產業，本課程主要是介紹數位轉型、智慧製造與永續生產相關之課題及其相關技術。
description.en: Many digital technologies have been widely used in various industries. This course mainly introduces topics related to digital transformation, smart manufacturing and sustainable production, as well as related technologies.

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在研習機器學習的基本概念、執行演算法、應用方法與其在工程與管理上之應用，課程內容包括：1. 機器學習基本概念與應用；2. 機器學習演算法概論 3. 歸納學習演算法 4. 決策樹演算法 5. 案例式學習演算法 6. 專家系統建立 7. 機器學習應用方法 8. 機器學習論文導讀 9. 機器學習專題製作
description.en: The Machine Learning course is to introduce and study the machine learning concepts, algorithms, application methodologies and its applications on engineering and management. The course encompasses the following topics.1. Machine learning concepts and applications.2. Machine learning algorithms. 3. Inductive learning algorithms. 4. Decision tree algorithms. 5. Case-based learning algorithms. 6. Construction of expert systems. 7. Applications of machine learning. 8. Paper readings on machine learning. 9. Projects on machine learning.

description.zh: 隨著網際網路的盛行，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，使得傳統的商店與行銷環境受到衝擊。資訊科技改變了消費習慣與行銷通路，電子商務的效應已經開始影響商業活動的每個層面，從新產品的開發、銷售、到售後服務均受影響，為企業帶來了無限商機。根據資策會的報告顯示，網際購物市場目前正進入高成長期。網際網路的消費觀念逐漸普及，消費者端的網路交易市集，亦成為未來重要的網路商機。不僅 B2C 市場（企業對消費者）極具潛力，網友個體戶的開店創業風潮（C2C）更是在蓬勃發中。在台灣，擁有十個以上員工的公司有 86% 有自屬的企業網站，而擁有自屬網站的頁有近七成聘僱網頁設計師進駐公司任職，面對網路商業的來臨，有著大量的網路商業的人才需求。只要有正確的網路商業經營獲利模式，網路是一個可以賺到大錢的管道，尤其低門檻、低成本的網路拍賣場更是最佳踏板。本課程講授網路創業及網路商業的必要實務經營能力，讓同學在本課程裡學得如何快速的以最少成本來 DIY 速成個人事業及就業的能力
description.en: Following the prevailing of the internet, the vigorous development e-commerce has given great impacts on traditional tangible stores and the whole marketing environments. Information Technology has not only changed our lives, but also changed consumers' behavior and marketing channels; and the e-commerce effect has already started to permeate into every stratum of business activities, including the exploitation, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, brings the industries infinite business chances. According to the reports of Institute for Information Industry, the market of internet shopping is going into its high development period, and there are a lot of chances to establish a new enterprise on the internet. So this course will teach about the internet entrepreneurial management.

notes: 配合 USR 計畫

description.zh: 本課程引入生活性的學習方法來誘發學生學習動機，並培養可在社會與職場運用的四項英文基本技能。課程目標在幫助學生在生活實境習得英文，為他們裝備可溝通表達於日常、社交活動，並提升職涯的整合性英文技能。每堂課程都注重在以學生為中心的學習活動中帶入全真、應用性高的英文技巧。課程設計涵蓋的功能包括課堂分享與作業、日常互動英文以及專業英文練習。主要課題包括溝通，簡報與談判技巧，應用閱讀與寫作，聽力技巧運用，語言與文化。
description.en: This course introduces real-world based learning approaches for students to raise their learning aspirations and to develop four essential English skills that are applicable in social and professional encounters. This course aims to help students practice English in most real-life settings and to equip them with integrated skills to advance their careers. Every class session focuses on bringing authentic and applied English in student-centered leaning activities. The class design covers the functions like information sharing and task-based activities, social interactions, and professional English practices. Essential topics include communication, techniques of negotiation and presentation, applied reading and writing, strategies for developing listening skills and language learning across cultures.

notes: 英語授課

description.zh: 臺灣建築史的發展大約可分成受到漢民族影響的傳統建築，以及日本和西方世界影響的近現代建築，本課程主要探究臺灣近現代建築發展的歷程。本課程係以時間為軸，將台灣近現代建築分為三個主題：(1) 臺灣近現代建築的背景、(2) 臺灣殖民時期、(3) 二次大戰之後的臺灣建築。
description.en: This course mainly discusses the development of modern Taiwanese architecture since the Japanese colonial period. The historical development of Taiwanese architecture could be divided into traditional Han architecture and modern architecture with Japanese and western influences. Based on the timeline, three themes will be introduced: (1) the background of Taiwanese modern architecture, (2) Taiwanese architecture during the colonial period, (3) Taiwanese architecture after the Second World War.

notes: 建都所和建築四合開

description.zh: 近年於規劃設計領域，因伴隨創新技術的發展，越來越多的決策與設計過程皆納入例如大數據分析、混成實境技術、生成式 AI 等技術，似乎降低了相關專業訓練的進入門檻，提升跨領域合作的可能性。然而若仔細觀察實務應用領域的情況，因為這些技術仍未普及，最終的操作還是容易掌握在特定專業人士手上，並且過度依賴抽象的數據和技術，與使用者產生隔閡，進一步影響設計成果。基於這個前提，本課程計畫藉由引進強調使用者為核心價值的「設計思考」方法作為橋樑，搭配創新科技的運用，於選定的社區針對特定議題進行參與規劃和空間設計操作，以此探索面向未來的社區設計方法。由於本課程之方法強調跨領域協作，並涉及創新創業及大學社會責任的內涵，故本課程除提供建築系大學部三、四年級選修外，也鼓勵校內其他科系同年級的學生選修。
description.en: Recent advances in planning and design have led to the integration of tools like big data, mixed reality, and generative AI into decision-making processes. While this trend lowers barriers for professional training and fosters interdisciplinary collaboration, these technologies remain limited in practical use, with final decisions often still in the hands of specific professionals. Moreover, over-reliance on abstract data can create a disconnect between designers and users. To address this, the course introduces "Design Thinking," a user-centered approach, alongside innovative technologies, to facilitate community design. Since this course emphasizes interdisciplinary collaboration and incorporates the concepts of innovation, entrepreneurship, and university social responsibility, it is offered as an elective for third- and fourth-year students in the Department of Architecture, while also encouraging students from other departments at the same level to enroll.

name.zh: 創新技術、設計思考、與社區設計
name.en: Innovative Techniques, Design Thinking, and Community Design

notes: 配合 USR 計畫 建築三和創創專區合開

description.zh: 本課程論述工業生產演進與全球綠色設計方法、趨勢，以及規範與法規需求，定義出創新、高品質和優秀的設計。引導學生多元領域學習，在建築設計中提出兼具環境、社會與經濟平衡之構想，藉以奠定我國未來勞動力市場的循環建築創新能量。
description.en: This course discusses the evolution of industrial production and global green design methods and trends, as well as the requirements of regulations and regulations, and defines innovation, high quality and excellent design. Guide students to study in multiple fields, and put forward the concept of environmental, social and economic balance in architectural design, so as to lay the energy of circular architectural innovation in China's future labor market.

description.zh: 設計的溝通扮演著如何將設計理念成功地傳達以及讓使用者清楚的理解設計本意的重要角色。本課程將透過設計思考過程藉由文字、口說、圖面等達到設計溝通之目的及訓練，經由了解設計領域應用之文字搭配口說及圖面進而增進設計者說明設計概念的溝通能力。課程內容包含設計溝通的基本原則、技巧及策略，以及如何利用不同的溝通媒介及工具來傳達設計理念。課程操作包含案例分析搭配實際的簡報演練及口說訓練讓同學們累積應用經驗。
description.en: Design Communication plays an important role in how to successfully deliver design concepts and have users understand the design intention clearly. This course will practice and reach the goal of design communication through design thinking by vocabulary uses, verbal speeches, and image presentations.  From understanding the proper application of design language including vocabularies and diagrams in various design fields, designers may improve their skills of concept presentation and communication.  The course content includes basic principles, techniques, and strategies in design communication as well as how to use different media and tools to deliver design concepts.Course activities include case studies with presentation practice and oral speech to help students have experiences in actual application.

description.zh: 目前建築工程營建產業多賴以圖文資料溝通，文件易有失誤，會提高成本、工期延長、甚至於爭議之狀況。BIM 工具之運用，可有效提升營建產業生產力。各國政府已紛紛推出 BIM 的審照制度，我國近年來於公共工程招標已要求 BIM 技術之整合運用。本課程針對 BIM 運用於建築生命週期中各產業間的介紹及效益、實例分享，並於課程中指導同學針對 BIM 軟體基礎工具使用。
description.en: Architectural engineering construction industry on which 2D graphic data communication, the file is easy to form mistakes, will increase the cost of the extension of time, even controversial situation. The use of Building Information Modeling (BIM) software tools, which can effectively enhance the productivity of the construction industry. Governments around the world have now launched the BIM audit system.In recent years, Taiwan has asked the public works bidding integrate and use of BIM technology. This course focuses on the introduction and effective life cycle of BIM for architectural industry, examples of sharing.  Guidance to students in courses based tool for BIM software.

name.zh: BIM 建築資訊系統概論

description.zh: 深耕趨勢學理論，以生活型態資訊為基礎，探討社會趨勢與科技發展趨勢，做為商品企畫的基礎。本課程旨在引導學習者運用學術研究的工具，以科學的方法定義市場需求，並以理性的思維進行商品企畫。
description.en: Current theories and practices of trend study are covered, including trends of living style, fashion and technology development followed by product planning practice. The aims of this course is to put emphasis on conducting research approach in the process of scientific marketing management and reasonable product planning.

notes: ★設計博核心選修，設計博與創新碩合開

description.zh: 本課程在研習數位電視，此課程包含 EDTV HDTV，SDTV。其課程目的在給予學習者了解數位電視分析與設計，並強調基礎與應用知識以符合工業界的需求，課程內容可包括下列主題。1. 影像簡介， 2. 顏色空間， 3. 類比影像介面， 4. 數位影像介面， 5. 數位影像處理， 6. NTSC,  PAL, 和 SECAM 系統， 7. H.261 和 H.263， 8. MPEG， 9. 數位電視。
description.en: This course is concerned with the digital television (DTV) design, which includes Enhanced Definition Television (EDTV), High Definition Television (HDTV), Standard Definition Television (SDTV). Its purpose is to deal with the analysis and design of DTV system, emphasizing fundamentals as well as new paradigms that students need to master in today's industry. The course covers the following topics. 1. Introduction to Video; 2. Color space; 3. Analog video interfaces; 4. Digital Video Interfaces; 5. Digital Video Processing; 6. NTSC, PAL, and SECAM system; 7. H.261 and H.263; 8. MPEG ; 9. Digital Television (DTV).

notes: 電子所和電資外生合開

description.zh: 1. 微帶線 2. 散射參數 3. 介電材料 4. 共振器 5. 平行耦合線 6. 耦合器 7. 分配器 8. 平面濾波器 9. 平面天線
description.en: 1.Microstrip line2.Scattering parameters3.Dielectric materials4.Resonators5.Parallel coupled lines 6.Couplers7.Dividers 8.Planar Filters9. Planar antennas

notes: 電子所和電資外生合開

description.zh: 本課程在介紹電腦視覺的基本概念與使用技術。課程內容包含: 1.introduction to computer vision 2.geometric camera calibration 3.illumination 4.geometry of multiple view 5.structure from motion 6.segmentation by clustering 7.tracking models 8.model-based vision 9.image-based rendering.
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce the basic concepts and techniques of computer vision. The outline of this course includes: 1.introduction to computer vision 2.geometric camera calibration 3.illumination 4.geometry of multiple view 5.structure from motion 6.segmentation by clustering 7.tracking models 8.model-based vision 9.image-based rendering.

notes: 資工所。創新 AI 和電資外生合開

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技四年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In first semester, Senior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit.  For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。介紹運轉中的機械系統其各部零件在運動必須遵守的準則及力在零件間的傳遞。範例含連桿組、凸輪、齒輪、純滾動系統、鏈輪、皮帶、滾筒式傳動組等的介紹。
description.en: Prerequisite: Consent of InstructorIntroduction of the principles that all the members of a mechanical system have to obey in motion as well as the forces transmitted between the members. Examples include linkages, cams, gears, pure rolling systems, chain drives, belt drives, friction drives, etc.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。本課程著重於 IC 製程技術之學習。課程內容包括：IC 絕緣技術、模組製程技術、導線技術、整合工程技術、SOC 技術及半導體奈米元件技術等。
description.en: A study on advanced IC process. The contents cover IC isolation technology, module process, interconnection line process, process integration, SOC applications and CMOS nano device engineering etc.

notes: 機電、製科、外生專班合開，限 40 人；製科◎、甲選修

description.zh: 本課程之教學目標在使學生瞭解數位訊號處理的理論基礎及其應用技巧。課程內容包含：(1) 離散傅立葉轉換及快速傅立葉轉換 (2) Z - 轉換在信號處理上之應用 (3) 相關函數，迴旋積分及其應用 (4) FIR 數位濾波器設計 (5) IIR 數位濾波器設計 (6) 適應性訊號處理介紹 (7) 工程應用及實例研討。
description.en: This course introduces the basic theory of digital signal processing and its application. The course outline includes: (1) Discrete-time Fourier Transform and Fast Fourier Transform (2) Z-Transform and its application (3) Correlation Fucntion, Convoluation Integral and its application (4) FIR digital filter design (5) IIR Digital Filter Desgin (6) Adaptive Signal Processing (7) Practical Application

notes: 預選限 40 人

description.zh: 探討各種電機特性及工作原理，內容包含：(1) 磁路分析 (2) 電機 - 機械能量轉換 (3) 繞組及氣隙磁動勢 (4) 繞組電感及電壓方程式 (5) 繞組因數 (6) 直流機 (7) 感應機 (8) 同步機。
description.en: Course Title:Electric Machinery Description:Principles, Construction and Application of transformer, DC motors, DC generators, induction motors, induction generators, synchronous motors and synchronous generators.

notes: 預選限 40 人

description.zh: 通訊系統簡介，類比調變技術（AM，FM），脈波調變技術，數位調變技術。
description.en: course title : communication systemdescription : this course is a first course in the area of communication . It primly contains the concept of communication system and the analogy communications .

notes: 預選限 40 人，3 選 2

description.zh: 操作化學相關的實驗
description.en: It covers the fundamental experiments in chemistry.

description.zh: 國內半導體資訊、自動化、化學、精密工業等與日本關係非常密切。日本為世界第二大經濟大國，日文方面科技資料甚多，如能培養學生閱讀科技日文資料，對國內未來科技與工業之發展有莫大助益。本課程內容在於如何收集與閱讀日文方面科技資料，學習時分兩段，基礎篇與應用篇。
description.en: This course has been designed to provide students essential Japanese language ability for reading technical information. The course covers: (1)Basic Japanese grammar (2)Japanese technical phrase(3)Technical terminology: semiconductor, information technology, automation, biotechnolpgy, and polymer chemistry.

description.zh: 數位電源為目前各大電源轉換電路公司研究的議題。本課程將介紹數位電源轉換器的動作模式、控制與實作考量，配合模擬軟體驗證理論，最後以數位電源設計實例進行探討。本課程藉由理論探討與模擬實作，加強學生的理論知識與實作能力。
description.en: Digital power supply design is a major industrial topic. This course introduces the operation and control of digital power converters, and discusses the design principles and their implementation considerations. Simulation is used to validate the theory learned in this course. Also, digital power supply design examples are discussed in detail. Students can strengthen their theoretical knowledge and practical ability through theoretical discussion and simulation practice from this course.

name.zh: 數位電源控制與電路設計
name.en: Digital Power Supply Control and Circuit Design

notes: 預選限 45 人

description.zh: 本課程將探討錯誤診斷系統理論與相關控制系統工程知識，將以馬達與鋰電池為例，實際應用錯誤診斷理論，並學習錯誤診斷的實現與應用技巧。本課程藉由理論推導與程式模擬實作，協助學生專精控制工程領域知識，並透過期刊文章研讀與討論，進一步加強學生創新思考與簡報專業論文之能力。
description.en: This course investigates fault diagnosis system algorithms and their relevant control system engineering knowledges. This course takes motors and lithium-ion batteries as examples to implement the fault diagnosis algorithms and to learn the implementation skills of fault diagnosis algorithms. The goal of this course is to improve students’ control engineering domain knowledge though algorithm derivation, coding and simulations; also, to enhance students’ innovative thinking capabilities and presentation skills through journal paper reviewing and discussions.

notes: 電機所和電資外生合開，預選限 25 人

description.zh: 讓學生學習容量、儀器分析及滴定（中和、沉澱、氧化還原、螯化）並運用在高分子，環保檢驗，並讓學生學習儀器的操作保養。
description.en: Included in this course are experiments in precipitation titrimetry, neutralization titrations, complex-formation titrations and oxidation/reduction titrations, and experiments of spectroscopy and chromatography related to polymers and enviroment are also provided.

notes: 限 30 人

description.zh: 由量子化學及結晶化學等理論為基礎，討論一些分析儀器的原理，構造及應用。特別是原子光譜法，電化學分析法及離子層析儀及質譜儀等，針對無機物之分析方法。
description.en: Considering the theories of quantum and crystal chemistry, discuss the theories, structure and applications of some instruments.  Those are used for chemical analysis, especially for inorganic materials: atomic spectroscopy, electrochemical analysis methods, ion-exchange chromatography and mass spectroscopy.

name.en: Special Topics of Instrumental Analytical Chemistry

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹專業英文論文的寫作格式，以及文件編修的技巧，且用深入淺出的例子作為示範，並輔以實際寫作練習與錯誤訂正。學員學習研究論文組織寫作，包含修改本身論文結構之基本技巧，正確組織文章的各個片段，避免口語用字寫字的陋習，使所作之文章能掌握其涵意，亦即能更有效率的利用英文寫出科技論文之佳作。
description.en: The goal of English Thesis Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

description.zh: 環境地質學是資源探採及地質工程的專業課程；透過環境地質的調查與研究，以了解自然資源之使用與工程相關之地質問題。內容包括：水、土壤、礦產資源、能源開發、認識地質作用對人類生存環境的影響、認識自然災害，瞭解人為破壞引起的災害、地質環境改變、人類衛生環境的影響及各種廢料處理等。並介紹環境地質圖、山崩潛感圖、土地利用潛力圖等環境地質學研究方法。
description.en: Environmental geology is a professional course of resource exploration, extraction and geological engineering; through investigation and study of the geological environment, in order to understand the use of natural resources and the engineering geological problems. The contents include: water, soil, mineral resources, energy development, understanding of the geological environment for human survival and understanding of natural disasters, understand the human damage caused by disasters, changes in the geological environment, the environmental impact of human health and the various waste processing. And introduce the environmental geology research method : environmental geological maps, landslide susceptibility map, land-use potential map.

description.zh: 電化學的領域包羅萬象，舉凡電泳作用與腐蝕現象的探討，電分析感測器或電池元件的製作，以及電鍍、拋光或鋁和氯氣的生產技術等均為電化學工程的範疇。本課程除了講述基本的電化學原理外，將著重於電化學分析方法在化學系統研究上的應用。
description.en: The field of electrochemistry includes many different phenomena (e.g., electrophoresis and corrosion), devices (electro analytical sensors and batteries), and technologies (the electroplating of metals and the large-scale production of aluminum and chlorine). In addition to an overview of the basic principles of electrochemistry, the main emphasis here is on the application of electrochemical methods to the study of chemical systems.

description.zh: 討論有機化學與環境、浮選及再生技術等方面有關的部份。主要在使用到的有機化學藥劑，如介面活性劑。
description.en: The organic chemicals, such as surfactants, which are used for environmental, floatation, and recycle techniques will be discussed in this course.

description.zh: 「地方創生」概念源自日本，目前已提升至日本國家戰略的政策層級。在臺灣，? 政院宣布 2019 年為「地方創生元？」，可？地方社區的經營再造亦已成為台灣未來重點發展趨勢。 本課程承接上學期【日本社會與文化】，著重介紹其中的文化產業發展如何進一步應用在地方創生。透過台日之間在地方創生的理論與實踐上的比較，讓學生能有效掌握社會脈動，貢獻所學。
description.en: The concept of “Place Making" originated from Japan and has been promoted to the policy level of Japan's national strategy. In Taiwan, the Executive Yuan announced that 2019 will be the "first year of placemaking," and the innovation of local communities has become a key development trend in the future. This course continues from the previous semester [Japanese society and culture], focusing on how the development of the cultural industry can be further applied to local innovation. By comparing the theory and practice of local creation between Taiwan and Japan, students can effectively grasp the social pulse and contribute what they have learned.

name.zh: 日本文化產業與地方創生
name.en: The Cultural Industry and Placemaking of Japan

notes: 上限 30 人

description.zh: 1. 可程式控制器 (PLC) 概論 2. PLC 指令說明與應用 3. PLC I/O 介面 4. A/D、D/A 介面 5. PLC 與電腦連線 6. 分散式控制系統 7. 中小型 PLC 網路系統 8. PLC 選用 9. PLC 網路監控系統 10. PLC 應用實習 5~7 個
description.en: 1. Introduction to PLC (Programmable Logic Controller)2. PLC Instructions and Applications3. PLC I/O Interfaces4. A/D and D/A Interfaces5. PLC and PC Communications6. Distributed Control System7. PLC Network8. PLC Selection9. Monitor Control System10. Laboratory work: 5~7 experiments

name.zh: 可程式控制器應用與實習
name.en: Programmable Logic Controller Applications and Lab.

notes: 預選限 30 人

description.zh: 課程從帶領學生解析書法之點畫、結構、體勢等書寫原理，並能鑑賞書法技法的內涵，進而運用書法藝術表達人文關懷及應用於文化創意產業領域。
description.en: The course leads students to analyze traditional calligraphy principles such as stippling, structure, and posture, and appreciate the connotation of calligraphy techniques. Enable students to use calligraphy art to express humanistic care and apply it to the field of cultural and creative industries.

description.zh: 先修課程：物理、化學。1. 醫學工程的領域與定義 2. 生醫訊號的介紹 3. 量測用醫療儀器的介紹 4. 生醫系統的介紹 5. 生醫材料的介紹 6. 臨床工程應用的介紹 7. 生醫感測器的介紹
description.en: 1. What is biomedical engineering? 2. Introduction of biosignals 3. Introduction of bioinstrumentation  4. Introduction of biomechanical systems 5. Introduction of biomaterials 6. Introduction of clinical engineering7. Introduction of biosensor

notes: 機械三甲和機械三乙合開

description.zh: 本課程介紹任務導向自主決策 AI 的概念與開發流程，涵蓋決策理論、強化學習、環境建模、多模態感知與策略優化，透過實作專案培養學生自主分析、設計與實現 AI 解決方案的能力。
description.en: This course introduces task-oriented autonomous decision-making AI concepts and development processes, covering decision theory, reinforcement learning, environment modeling, multimodal perception, and policy optimization. Through hands-on projects, students develop skills to analyze, design, and implement AI solutions independently.

notes: 機電所和製科所合開

description.zh: 1. 半導體: 5 種模組介紹 - 真空、機器手臂、射頻 / 電漿、真空吸盤 / 加熱體、氣體儀表盤 - 從理論到應用。8 種半導體機台介紹 Epi/RTP, Implant, MDP, DDP, Etch, CMP, PDC and ECD. 2. 期末海報展
description.en: 1.Semiconductor:5 Modules – Vacuum, Robot, Plasma/RF, Electric Static Chuck (ESC)/Heater and Gas Panel.8 Equipment - Epi/RTP, Implant, MDP, DDP, Etch, CMP, PDC and ECD.2.Factory Touring: Global Technical Learning Center (GTLC) Lab Touring at Hsinchu.3.Top Executive Sharing: Worthy Horng – Cust Services & Supt, VP of AMAT.4.Final Exam – Poster Exhibition.

notes: 機電所。製科所和半導體碩班合開，綜三演講廳

description.zh: 本課程旨在透過專題導向之設計實踐，引導學生培養獨立企劃、文獻探究與創新發展之執行能力，進而構思並實現具文化內涵之專題。學生須以分組方式完成，並於學期末進行公開發表與審查。
description.en: This course is designed to cultivate students’ capacity for independent project planning, literature inquiry, and innovative development through project-oriented design practice. Emphasis is placed on guiding students to conceptualize and realize projects with substantial cultural content. Students are required to work in groups to complete their projects and present them in a public forum with formal evaluation at the end of the semester.

notes: 115-1 學期大四畢業專題先修科目，共科 606-1 分組教學

description.zh: 這門課程深入探討將 AI 技術直接整合至硬體的過程。課程從 AI 晶片的基本概念開始，進一步探討各種 AI 的數位、類比及混合訊號架構。課程內容涵蓋了對神經網路模型映射到晶片硬體的過程及優化。重要的一環是神經網路編譯器的設計與優化，並輔以實務工具和考量以實現高效的 AI 晶片設計。課程還探討了 AI 晶片的當前應用及 AI 硬體發展的未來趨勢。課程以學生專題為導向，將所學知識應用於創新的 AI 晶片解決方案。此課程旨在為學生提供在不斷進化的 AI 硬體領域中取得成功所需的技能和知識。
description.en: This course, titled "AI-on-Chip Design: Architectures and Applications," offers a deep dive into how AI technologies are integrated directly onto hardware. It begins with fundamental concepts of AI-on-Chip, moving into the intricacies of digital, analog, and mixed-signal architectures tailored for AI applications. The curriculum includes a thorough examination of neural network models, focusing on their optimization and the critical process of mapping these models onto hardware. A significant portion is dedicated to the design and optimization of neural network compilers, supplemented by practical insights into the tools and considerations necessary for efficient AI chip design. The course also explores current applications of AI-on-Chip and anticipates future trends that could reshape AI hardware development. It culminates in a project presentation where students apply what they've learned to create innovative AI-on-Chip solutions. This course equips students with the skills and knowl

name.zh: 人工智慧晶片設計與應用

description.zh: 有關建築歷史、理論、批評、構造、營建管理等相關主題討論。
description.en: A theme topic discussion on the field of architecture history, theory, criticism, structure, construction and management, etc.

notes: 建都所和建築四合開

description.zh: 色彩在藝術史的發展過程中，一直以其獨特的內在感覺邏輯與外在現實世界不停的交互進行運動，因而織就一門豐富的內在視覺感知語彙。本學期課程除延續上學期色彩調和論的介紹外，亦藉由對色彩原理、感覺與運用方式循序漸進的課堂操作，以及作品色彩操作形式的分析，讓同學能夠活用色彩成為一種造形語彙。
description.en: In the history of art, color science has made its unique The course is designed as an introduction to color harmonies following last semester and examines colors from as many ways as possible. Through progressive training and the case analysis of artworks, students learn to add colors to have their own design style.

notes: 創意一、工設一、互動外生一合開 (排 60 人以上 PBL 教室)

description.zh: 創新往往是集體大腦的產物、文化理念和知識隨著時間的推移透過社會互動進行重組和改進。個人創新能力得益於接觸不同的想法和社會關係，從而為創新創造「準備好的頭腦」。創新率受到社會性 (個人如何連結)、傳播準確性 (文化傳播的準確性) 和文化差異 (思想多樣性) 的影響。這個集體大腦概念解釋了創新如何快速擴散並建立在先前知識的基礎上，從而導致歷史上創新率的提高。
description.en: Innovation is often the product of collective brains, where cultural ideas and knowledge are recombined and improved over time through social interactions. Individual innovativeness benefits from exposure to diverse ideas and social connections, which create a “prepared mind” for innovation. The rate of innovation is influenced by sociality (how individuals connect), transmission fidelity(accuracy of cultural transmission), and cultural variance (diversity of ideas). This collective brain concept explains how innovations can rapidly diffuse and build upon previous knowledge, leading to increasing innovation rates historically.

description.zh: 以國內外設計競賽為主軸，輔導與協助學生積極的參與國內外設計競賽，訓練學生獨立思考與問題解決能力。
description.en: This course aims to focus on domestic and international design competitions, guide and help students' active, and let students have independent thinking and problem-solving skills.

notes: 上限 30 人

description.zh: 教導學生認識色彩之成因及視覺現象、色彩系統之認識及色彩心理之種種現象。
description.en: Basic understanding about color. Including light, visual perception, color names, color order systems.

notes: 創意一、工設一、互動外生一合開，上限 20 人

description.zh: 本課程為線性代數的深化與廣化。以理論的深化而言，本課程由高斯消去法談起，解釋四個向量空間，進而說明矩陣的正交性與投影。接著，本課程闡述行列式、特徵值與特徵向量、矩陣的乘冪與指數、頻譜分解，最終收尾於奇異值分解，以此定理統整這一學期的所有內容。以應用的廣化而言，本課程在上述理論說明之外，還會特別介紹科學、工程的應用實例，例如迴歸分析、線性規劃、圖論與網路、主成份分析。
description.en: 1. Introduction - Importance of Linear Algebra2. Ax=b, Matrix, Gaussian Elimination and Application3. Vector Spaces and Linear Equation4. Applications: Graphs and Networks5. Orthogonality and Least Squares6. Applications: Multiple Regression7. Application: Linear Programming 8. Determinant and its Applications9. Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors10. Ak and Difference Equations11. eA and Differential Equations12. Similarity Transformation and Spectral Theorem13. Positive Definite Matrices and Minimum Principles14. Applications: Multivariate Analysis and Principal Component Analysis15. Singular Value Decomposition and its Applications

description.zh: 博士學位論文寫作
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis.

description.zh: 專題報告專題演講 研究小組討論
description.en: Case Study.Seminar.Group meeting.

notes: 博士班

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討供應鏈管理相關之基本議題。供應鏈管理係從供應商、製造商到最終顧客，對整個製造與配銷通路的整合性管理策略。本課程內容包含供應鏈管理之策略發展、供應鏈管理之相關功能、及供應鏈管理之主要困難點。本課程將同時探討與供應鏈管理相關之議題，如存貨理論、資訊系統整合、及供應契約等。本課程理論與實務並重、案例研討也將為本課程重要之一環。
description.en: This course intends to introduce fundamental issues regarding supply chain management. Supply chain management is an integrated approach to manage the total flow of manufacturing and distribution channel from supplier to ultimate customer. The contents of this course include the development of supply chain management strategies, supply chain management functions, and major challenges of supply chain management. Certain topics related to supply chain management, such as inventory policy, information system integration, and supply contract will also be addresses. This course focuses on both theoretical and practical issues. Real world case study will be an important part of this course.

notes: 工管四甲乙丙合開

description.zh: 資料庫應用實務課程的目的在研習資料庫管理技術及其在企業的應用。本課程方向包括：熟悉資料庫基本指令及操作方法，以實務性方式，開發一套簡易應用軟體。培養學生對資料庫軟體設計開發之能力。
description.en: Database system application course is to study the database management techniques and its applications on enterprises. The course includes ：The students can understand the operation process in order to develop the data file. The opportunity to do the practical project independently.

notes: 工管三甲乙丙合開，計中電腦教室

description.zh: 零售業包含百貨業、連鎖店、超市、超商等，與人們的關係極切・本課程主在探討如何經由零賣出使顧客滿意的商品・內容：零售業概論、配銷通路、行銷研究、產品管理策略、定價策略、促銷策略、賣場規劃、零售業經營策略、顧客滿意
description.en: Retail management is mainly to discuss to sell goods through channels and satisfy them. The content of the course: Retail concept, physical distribution, market research, product management strategy, pricing strategy, promotion strategy, retail strategy and customer satisfaction.

notes: 工管一甲乙合開

description.zh: 研究生在教授之個別指導下，針對特定研究主題進行研究，並將研究成果寫成論文。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor.  The results should be written as a dissertation.

notes: 博士班必修

description.zh: 高分子流變學本課程以講述高分子流體之黏性及彈性為主。內容包括：(1) 黏彈性簡介 (2) 時間溫度轉換 (3) 非結晶區之玻璃轉移點 (4) 橡膠理論 (5) 黏彈模型 (6) 介電鬆弛等專題。
description.en: This course will extensively study the viscosity and elasticity of polymeric materials. The main contents include(1) Phenomenalogical Treatment of Viscoelasticity(2) Time-Temperature Correspondence(3) Transitions and Relaxation in Amorphous Polymers(4) Rubber Elasticity(5) Viscoelastic Models(6) Dielectric Relaxation

description.zh: 本課程介紹複合材料的原理，包括複合材料的高分子化學、複合材料的加工方法、複合材料的力學分析與設計、以及複合材料在高科技上的應用。加工方法包括真空袋成型法、壓力釜成形法、樹脂移送成型、編織法、纏繞成形法、拉擠成型法、模壓法… 等，本課程詳述這些加工方法的原理及應用，同時介紹力學分析及設計，應力和應變之關係，複材之彎曲、靜態和動態之強度、脫層、耐久性、及以力學觀點設計複合材料，最後討論複合材料如何應用於高科技及民生工業上。
description.en: This course is to elucidate the principle and potential application of composite materials. It includes polymer chemistry, design and analysis of composite, and processing methods. The composite processings include autoclaves,vacuum vags, resin transform molding, braiding, filament winding, pultrusions, sheet molding compound,…etc. The principles and application of the methods will be elucidated. The analysis and design, strain-stress relationships, extension and bending, static and dynamic strengths, and delamination, will also be discussed. Finally, the potential application of the composite in high-tech industries will be elucidated.

class.name: 能源光電外國學生專班

notes: 高分所和 EOMP 合開 / 新老師

description.zh: X 光已經成為材料結構鑑定上一項很有用的技術。這門課將介紹如何應用 X 光粉末繞射與吸收光譜於材料結構鑑定，以及數據分析。
description.en: X-ray has become a powerful technique on the characterization of material structures. The course will teach how to apply the x-ray diffraction and absorption on structural characterization and even analysis.

name.zh: X 光在材料分析上的應用

notes: 自備電腦、需三小時連

description.zh: 本課程之授課目標為培養學生具備特用化學品基本知識、合成方法及應用原理。特用化學品種類包括：電子用特化品、塑膠用特化品、紡織用特化品及其他工業之特化品（如界面活性劑）。
description.en: An introductory course focuses on chemicals which are sold at high prices in relatively limited volumes. The scope of fine chemicals includes surfactants, plastic additives, catalysts, pesticides, flavors & fragrances, dyes & pigments, bulk medicines, etc. Topics concerning about the manufacturing processes, application principles and recent developments of fine chemicals are also discussed in this course.

description.zh: 操作與高分子物理相關的實驗
description.en: It covers the fundamental experiments in polymer physics.

description.zh: 本課程將透過每週專題演講方式，讓學生了解有機材料之最新開發成品或最先進之研究成果。演講者之安排將以校外知名專家學者及校內各計畫執行者為主。
description.en: This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application on the organic materials. Speakers being invited are well-known scholars in organic area.  Graduate students or thesis advisors will also be invited to report any in interesting result from their graduate studies.

notes: 雙號選課 (新老師）

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹微生物及其應用，學生將可習得何謂微生物，微生物如何運作，以及微生物的應用。課程內容包括: (1) 微生物的分類、型態、結構及一般特性；(2) 微生物的生長與控制；(3) 微生物的生理與代謝；(4) 微生物的應用，例如生物轉換、一次及二次代謝產物的生產、基因重組蛋白的生產、核酸藥物的生產等。
description.en: The objective of the course is to introduce the major concepts, principles and applications of microbiology. Students will learn about what microorganisms are, how they function, and their industrial applications. The course include the following topics: (1) Classification and structures; (2) Microbial growth and control; (3) Microbial physiology and metabolism; (4) Applications, such as biotransformation, production of primary and secondary metabolites, production of recombinant proteins, etc.

description.zh: 本課程以個案研究和文獻探討方式讓學生了解總體經濟的環境（包括 GDP、GNP、失業率、景氣循環、通貨膨脹、政府的財政政策和貨幣政策的規劃與制定、匯率制度、總合供給與需求等課題）。
description.en: This course is to analyze the macroeconomic policy, international economy, business cycles, government policy, exchange rate and other macroeconomic-related issues. The course will be taught with case studies and journal literature. Group discussions are needed.

notes: 經管所和 IMBA 合開 / 哈佛

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹各類有機材料在光電工業上之應用。包括感光性有機材料用於電子構裝及微刻蝕影、絕緣及低介電材料、光碟染料、電變色、非線性光學、LB 薄膜、發光二極體材料，導電及半導電有機材料。
description.en: This course is an introduction course to introduce varied organic materials in the application of optoelectronics. It includes light sensible organic materials for electron package, photoresist, photoimaging. The advanced material of optics disc, electronic chromic, nonlinear optics, LB film, organic photodiode, and conducting polymer.

description.zh: 機器學習探討如何能由觀測到的資料中自我學習，自我進化，而能自動增進其處理效能。例如進行預測，特徵擷取，分類，模式辨認，決策，各種訊號處理，甚至建立人工智慧等等。本課程將介紹機器學習的基礎演算法、理論及工具。並讓學生嘗試在各種領域中實際實踐這些技術。課程內容包括：(a) 監督式學習（例如參數和非參數演算法、支持向量機和類神經網路等），(b) 無監督學習（例如群聚、降維和深度學習等）與 (c) 機器學習應用實例（例如語音信號處理，影像訊號處理，音訊訊號處理與自然語言處理，資訊擷取與資料搜尋等）。
description.en: Machine learning studies how to automatically learn from observed data to improve the performance of prediction, information extraction, clustering, pattern recognition, decision making, signal processing and even artificial intelligence. This course will introduce fundamental algorithms, theories and their practical applications. The content will cover (a) supervised learning, such as parametric and non-parametric algorithms, super vector machines and neural networks, (b) unsupervised learning, for example, data clustering, dimension reduction and deep learning and (c) practical applications on speech, image, audio signal and natural language processing or information retrieval and search, etc.

notes: 電子大三合開

description.zh: 本課程旨在使學生深入了解當前最新科技發展下各類顯示器之運作原理與技術趨勢，同時探討相關產業的發展動向。課程內容自色彩科學與工程基礎出發，系統性介紹薄膜電晶體 (TFT)、液晶顯示器 (LCD)、有機發光二極體 (OLED)、反射式顯示器、頭戴式 AR/VR 顯示器，以及觸控面板等相關顯示技術。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the operating principles and technological trends of modern display systems under the latest advancements in science and technology. It also explores the development and perspectives of the display industry. Starting from the fundamentals of color science and engineering, the course systematically introduces various display technologies, including thin-film transistors (TFT), liquid crystal displays (LCD), organic light-emitting diodes (OLED), reflective displays, headmounted AR/VR displays, and touch panels, enabling students to build a well-rounded knowledge base and insight into display technology applications.

name.en: Introduction to novel flat panel display technology

description.zh: 本課程介紹 OpenGL 與 OpenGL for Embedded Systems (OpenGL ES)。講授電腦圖學基本原理：幾何圖形、互動介面、幾何轉換、透視投影、明暗度計算、紋理貼圖、色彩原理等。接著介紹 3D 繪圖引擎、建模引擎、創作實例經驗談。修課學生必須熟悉 C 語言。課程並介紹近年來在多媒體產業應用非常多的擴增實境 (Augmented Reality, AR) 繪圖技術。本課訓練學生具備使用 OpenGL/OpenGL ES 程式庫、瞭解 3D 繪圖引擎、及運用擴增實境技術之能力，並能整合以上技術進行 3D 繪圖程式開發創作。
description.en: This course introduces 3D computer graphics. Topics include OpenGL, shading language, graphics pipeline, geometric, interactive interface, transformation, projection, hidden surfaces, shading, texture mapping, and color. This course introduces 3D rendering, modeling, and graphics engine. The student will be required to write computer programs using C language and OpenGL API. Topics of augmented reality (AR) will be covered in the class. The students will be able to develop 3D modeling, rendering, graphics, and augmented reality tools.

description.zh: 噪音基礎，噪音分析實驗法，汽車噪音法規與標準，基本噪音控制程序，車輛噪音與噪音控制基本，引擎噪音與控制，車輛噪音源，車輛噪音與改良，心理聲學與最佳化
description.en: Fundamentals of Acoustics, Experimental Methods of Acoustic Analysis, Automotive Noise Legislation and Standards, Basic Noise Control Procedure, Basics of Vehicle Noise and Noise Control, Engine Noise and Its Control, Vehicle Noise Sources, Vehicle Noise and Its Refinement, Psychoacoustic Analysis and Optimizations.

description.zh: 就主要的染料和顏料之化學結構、製造方式和基本化性予以闡述，以便對色料的相關應用有較為明晰的瞭解。
description.en: Chemical structure, manufacturing and properties of main dyes and pigments are studied. Further applications of the colourstuff are explained.

notes: 分四＋高分所合開

description.zh: 光電材料具備將光轉換為電能的能力，因此在當前的再生能源研究中中引起了廣泛與極大的關注。本課程著重介紹光電材料應用在光伏元件、發光二極體、光電感測器和薄膜電晶體。課程內容也包括半導體物理基礎知識、材料的分子結構、光吸收能力、載流子遷移率以及元件的穩定性和衰退的探討。
description.en: Optoelectronic materials have attracted much attention on a wide range of applications in renewable energy systems due to their ability to convert light into electricity. This course focus on introducing optoelectronic materials utilized in such kind of devices, photovoltaics, light-emitting diodes, photodetectors, and thin-film-transistors. This course also includes the fundamentals of semiconductor physics, materials’ molecular structures, light absorption capacity, carrier mobility and device’s stability and degradation.

name.zh: 光電材料於再生能源之應用
name.en: Optoelectronic Materials in Renewable Energy Applications

description.zh: 係利用物理機械整理及化學處理方式，改善紡織品之吸引性、服務性和最終用途之機能性。整理加工技術包括結構穩定性 (諸如壓縮、煮呢、蒸呢、熱定型)；表面特性改質 (諸如平滑性、粗糙性、光澤性及其他美觀性質) 與功能性改質 (諸如防縐、防縮、防火、防污、防水、防微生物與昆蟲、耐光、耐冷熱、耐污染質及化學藥劑、耐氣候、耐摩擦、抗起球、抗靜電)。
description.en: The attractiveness, serriceability and end-use performance of textiles are imporved by the application of physical mechanical and chemical processes.  Finishing techniques include dismensional stabilization(such as, sanforization, crabbing, decatizing, heat-setting),modification of surface characteristics(such as, smoothness, roughness, luster, other esthetic fabric qualities) and functional property modification (such as, resistance to wrinkle shrinkage, fire, soils and stains, water, microorganisms and insect, light, heat and cold, air pollutants and chemical agents, weathering, abrasion, pilling and static change).

description.zh: 本課程旨在探索人工智能機器人對城市發展的正面影響。學生將掌握機器人技術的基礎，並通過實作、實驗與團隊合作，定義都市所面臨的挑戰並設計出解決方案的機器人原型，並學會如何運用所學知識解決實際問題。
description.en: This course is designed to delve into the transformative role of artificial intelligence (AI) robots in shaping the future of urban development. Participants will gain foundational knowledge in robotics, engaging in hands-on projects, experiments, and collaborative efforts to pinpoint and tackle urban challenges. Through the creation of robotic prototypes, students will not only devise innovative solutions but also learn the practical application of their theoretical knowledge to real-world problems. This curriculum encourages a deep understanding of how AI can contribute positively to urban environments, equipping students with the skills to make impactful changes in the field of urban development.

notes: 先鋒 1 樓 城市科學實驗室

description.zh: 本課程規劃透過專業之人格特質分析方式，提供學生瞭解自我屬性於未來職場上之可能角色定位與認知感受，並針對學生畢業後進入職場將面臨的挑戰，提供應對進退之教戰策略與技巧傳授，包括壓力調適方式、溝通協調技巧、團隊合作注意事項、履歷撰寫方式、面試臨場技巧、以及職場倫理規範等，以提升學生爭取工作機會與進入職場後之適應能力與競爭實力。課程最後並安排整體課程之履歷健檢與模擬面試實作教育訓練，提供學生檢視學習成效並對未來職涯規劃預作準備。
description.en: This course is designed to provide students with a professional personality analysis to understand the possible roles and perceptions of their attributes in the future workplace, and to teach them strategies and skills to cope with the challenges they will face when they enter the workplace after graduation, include stress adjustment, communication, and coordination skills, teamwork, resume writing, interviewing skills, and workplace ethics, etc. This course will also help students to enhance their adaptability and competitiveness when they enter the workplace. At the end of the course, a resume review and a mock interview will be provided to prepare students for their future career planning.

notes: 密集授課 9 週課程，上課時間四 34 節，大四生優先

description.zh: 最小迴轉半徑測試，轉向力測試，運轉測試，燃料消耗測試，煞車測試，加速測試，滑行測試，最高速率測試，爬坡測試，牽引測試，行駛測試，排氣污染量測試，水箱散熱測試，冷卻劑沸點測試，小客車及貨車規範。
description.en: Minimum Turning Radius Test, Steering Effort Test, Running Test, Fuel Consumption Test, Brake Test, Acceleration Test, Coasting Test, Maximum Speed Test, Steep Hill Climbing Test, Traction Test, Driving Test, Exhaust Pollution Test, Heat Dissipation Test of Radiators, Test for Boiling Point of Coolants, Standard Form of Specification for Passenger Cars and Motor Trucks.

notes: 1 週【停開】

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意包括 10 個數值問題 1. 簡單熱傳導 2. 穩態圓柱熱傳問題 3. 完全展開管流 4. 翼片對流展開管流 5. 理想流體 6. 突然膨脹壓縮流 7. 自由對流完全展開流 8. 軸對稱流 9. 無限反應燃燒流場 10. 亂流流場
description.en: Including ten problems1. Simple pure conduction problem2. cylindrical conduction for steady non uniform k3. fully develop duct4. fin conduction convection for fully develop5. ideal flow6. sudden expansion compressible7. Free convective flow for fully develop8. Axial symmetry flow9. Infinitely combustion reaction10. Turbulent flow

notes: 1 週【停開】

description.zh: 基本或然率，可靠度概念與定義，不確定性分析，可靠度分析之方法，可靠度導向設計，系統可靠度。
description.en: The analyses of structure reliability   Basic,the concept and definition of reliability uncertain analyses, the method of reliable analyses , reliability -orient design , system reliability.

notes: 土木 205

description.zh: 以結構工程、大地工程、防災科學、運輸交通、營建管理、營建材料及營建技術為專題討論主題之主要範疇。
description.en: Seminar Special subject discussion of structure engineering , geography engineering pretecting calamity science, transportation, construction management , construction material and construction technique.

notes: 碩一丙丁戊組 / 土木 500

description.zh: 認識科技文章及科技學術論文語法、文體、結構組織等特質，並探討技術報告及論文撰寫方式。
description.en: This course helps the learners recognize the syntax, style, and organization as far as the papers on technology and technical writings are concerned. Discussions include specific ways to technical presentation and technical writings.

notes: 上限 15 人

description.zh: 1. 光纖感測介紹，2. 光纖感測元件，3. 光纖感測系統，4. 光纖感測多工技術，5. 光纖雷射感測系統，6. 長距離光纖感測系統，7. 大範圍多點光纖感測系統，8. 光纖感測網路。
description.en: 1. Introduction to fiber optic sensor, 2. Fiber sensor devices, 3. Fiber sensor systems, 4. Fiber sensor multiplexing techniques, 5. Fiber-laser-based sensor systems, 6. Long-distance fiber sensor systems, 7. Large-scale multipoint fiber sensor systems, 8. Fiber sensor networks.

notes: 光電四、光電所和電資外生合開

description.zh: 本課程包括 (一) 光的調變，內容包括：半導體雷射的調變及光的電與聲調變 (二) 光的偵測，內容包括：光偵測器。
description.en: This course includes (I) modulation of light, including modulation of semiconductor lasers, electro-optical and accoustooptic modulators, (II) detection of light, including photodetectors.

notes: 光電四、光電所

description.zh: (1) 生醫與光學基礎 (2) 電子膠囊、內視鏡 (3) 顯微鏡相關 (4) 光學單離 (5) 光學嵌住 (6) 雷射美容治療相關 (7) 光譜分析 (8) 光動力治療、光觸媒法 (9) 光學斷層掃描 (10) 表面電漿子技術 (11) 螢光光電檢測 (12) 生物晶片 (13) 放射線影像
description.en: (1) Basics of bio-optics (2) Optical measurement in Medical engineering(3) Microscopy (4) Micro and nano technology in Laser capture microdissection (5) Laser trapping (6) Laser and skin effects(7) Spectral technology (8) Photodynamic Therapy(PDT) and Photodynamic diagnosis(PDD) (9)Optical Coherence tomography(10) Surface plasmons (11) Fluorescence sensing technology, spectroscopy and pharmacy analysis (12) Biochip Technology(13) Bio-imaging

description.zh: 本課程將介紹使用於智慧家庭、智慧製造與智慧醫療應用的感測器結構與基本工作原理，包含光學感測原理、半導體感測原理、機械感測原理、化學感測原理、生物感測原理、各種感測器之測量系統及轉換界面電路設計與近期的感測技術基礎科學發展與議題。
description.en: This course introduces the sensor structure and basic working principles used in smart home, smart manufacturing and smart medical applications, including optical sensors, semiconductor sensors, mechanical sensors, electrochemical sensors, biosensors. Moreover, we will discuss various sensor measurement systems, conversion interface circuit design, and recent scientific development."

description.zh: 隨著網際網路的迅速發展，網路電子商務已經成為傳統行銷通路以外的一個新興通路。再加上網路全年無休、成本低廉、以全球為市場的優勢，以及可符合消費者的需求的特色，使得電子商務明顯的成為未來商業發展的主流，因此國外廠商紛紛上網卡位，網路商業化已成為一股不可抵擋的趨勢。本課程中將介紹對電子商務作理論與實務上的探討。1. 電子商務與商業模式 2. 電子商務策略發展 3. B to C 電子商務 4. C to C 電子商務 5. B to B 電子商務 6. 無線網路 7. 企業電子化 8. 企業資源規劃 9. 供應鏈管理 10. 顧客關係管理 11 知識管理與 e-Learning12. 網路行銷 14. 網路廣告與關鍵字廣告 15. 網路安全性
description.en: E-business (electronic business) is the conducting of business on the Internet, not only buying and selling but also servicing customers and collaborating with business partners.The outline of electronic business is as following:1. Introduction to Electronic Commerce.2. Technology Infrastructure: The Internet and the World Wide Web.3. Selling on the Web: Revenue Models and Building a Web Presence.4. Marketing on the Web.5. Business-to-Business Online Strategies6. Online Auctions, Virtual Communities, and Web Portals.7. The Environment of Electronic Commerce: Legal, Ethical, and Tax Issues.8. Web Server Hardware and Software.9: Electronic Commerce Software.10. Electronic Commerce Security.11. Payment Systems for Electronic Commerce.12. Planning for Electronic Commerce

description.zh: 使電腦系統具有解決問題的能力、智慧的表現及儲存的型態、理解及辨識的能力、及視覺、聽覺、觸覺及表達的能力、並有學習、認知、分析理解等能力。
description.en: Made computer the power of problem solving, intelligent behavior and storage type, comprehension and distinguish abilities. The abilities of vision, hearing, touching, learning, identifying, analyzing are also the target of the course.

notes: 工管所和管理博合開

description.zh: 超快雷射由於其脈衝寬度在皮秒 (10-12) 之下，它在軍事科技、工業應用、生醫檢測與學術研究所扮演的角色日益重要，本課程將介紹超短脈衝雷射的種類，尤其著重在光纖短脈衝雷產生的原理、脈衝壓縮的技術與超短脈衝寬度與相位量測的技術，此外也將介紹超快雷射的各種應用包括光譜量測、泵 - 探量測與非線性光學量測等技術。
description.en: Due to relative short pulse below one picosecond, ultrafast lasers have been widely used in various fields including military, industry, biomedical diagnosis and scientific research.  In this course, it will introduce various kinds of the ultrafast lases, especially on the principle of mode-locked fiber generation, pulse compression technique and the method of the ultrashort pulsewidth measurement as well as phase retrieval.  Various applications of ultrafast laser including fluorescence, pump-probe and nonlinear optical measurement have also been introduced in this course.

description.zh: 本課程之要旨在於建構產業分析之思維架構及洞悉市場預測擴展之研究能力。課程中引用各種研究方法及預測手法並以個案探討方式配合。
description.en: The objective of this course is to construct the infrastructure of industry analysis and to build up the research capability. By introducing the methodologies and forecasting tools, the case study is implied in this class.

description.zh: 中文概述 Chinese Description 	(1). 本課程將介紹人工智慧在各種經營管理領域的科技應用，包括：預測分析、客戶關係管理、資源優化、行銷和廣告、智慧客服、決策支援。(2). 學生能夠學到正確學習商業智能與資料科學的 3 個步驟：A. 使用 pandas 模組裡進行商業數據分析與視覺化。B. 用 numpy，sklearn 模組來處理迴歸分析等機器學習問題。C. 用 keras 深度學模組進行商業預測。(3). 本課程將讓著重在培養學生具有基礎的資料科學與數據分析能力，有能力使用 python 來做商業分析與視覺化，精通包括 pandas 與 matplotlib 模組。(4). 訓練學生精通商業數據程式分析，有能力處理資料的一體化分析，包括：數據採集、清洗、查詢與計算、分析與挖掘、可視化。(5). 訓練學生有能力處理採集各種大數據資料，包括：網頁爬取，json，xml，csv, excel，mySQL，noSQL (6). 本課程將探討各種案例，例如『業務銷售分析，淘寶電商數據分析，市場佔有率分析，系所生源分析，股票市場分析，問卷資料分析』。
description.en: (1). This course will introduce the technological application of artificial intelligence in various business management fields.(2). Students can learn 3 steps to correctly learn business intelligence and data science: A. data analysis and visualization. B. machine learning. C. deep learning business forecasting applications.(3). This course will focus on basic data science and data analysis in modules including pandas and matplotlib.(4). Train students  have the ability to process integrated analysis of data, including: data collection, data cleaning, data query and calculation, data analysis and mining, and data visualization.(5). Train students to be able to process and collect various big data, including: web crawling, json, xml, csv, excel, mySQL, noSQL

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域經營管理之應用
name.en: Application of artificial intelligence in cross-domain management

description.zh: 本課程以 R 語言介紹資料科學和數據可視化。本課程注重於資料科學的實際應用，學生將學習到如何整理、探索、轉換和數據可視化。 學生以作業練習和獨立項目來獲得實數據科學的基本技能。
description.en: This course introduces data science and data visualization through the R language. Focusing on applied data science skills, students will be introduced to the methods to tidy, explore, transform, and visualize data. Students will practice them with real data in exercises and projects.

description.zh: 中文概述：專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: Case study. Seminar. Group meeting.

notes: 碩一

description.zh: 讀書報告、專題討論、製造科技相關技術及產品介紹與討論、Seminar 心得等，可重覆修習。
description.en: Case Study, Workshop, Group discussion, Seminars, Manufacturing Technology in Modern Industries.

notes: 綜二演講廳，博士班必修

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意介紹運轉中的機械系統其各部零件在運動必須遵守的準則及力在零件間的傳遞。範例含連桿組，凸輪，齒輪，純滾動系統，鏈輪，皮帶，滾筒式傳動組等的介紹。
description.en: Introduction of the principles which all the members of a mechanical system have to obey in motion as well as the forces transmitted between the members． Examples include linkages, Cams, Gears, Pure rolling system, Chain drives, Belt drives, Friction drives, etc.

notes: 合班 (車二、機電二、機械二甲)，週一 12

description.zh: 本課程藉由不同情境之英語錄影帶，以及專題的語彙題目來提供一個英語談話的情境使學生能學習合宜的詞句。小組討論、角色演練、口頭報告皆為主要教學技巧，俾能增強學生之聽說能力。
description.en: This course aims at providing an English-speaking environment to allow students learn about the speaking strategies and common expressions used in different situations through viewing video films and oral practice. Small-group/pair discussion and role-playing are also parts of the methodologies.

notes: C 組 - 學號尾號 3 的倍數，03/06/09 等，僅限英文系學生修

description.zh: 設計方法，材料性質，構件受壓行為，構件受拉行為，構件受撓行為，軸力和彎矩之聯合作用，構件受剪行為，構件受扭行為。
description.en: Behavior of Reinforced Concrete Frame   1.Method of Design2.Properties of Materials3.Compressed Behavior of Frame4.Tension Behavior of Frame5.Flexing Behavior of Frame6.Impact of Axial Force And Moment7.Shear Behavior of Frame8.Torsion Behavior of Frame

name.zh: 鋼筋混凝土構件行為學

notes: 土木 505

description.zh: 物件導向程式設計以類別與物件為核心概念，輔以靜態的屬性及動態的方法，能夠直覺並且系統化地描述真實世界的事物，再輔以封裝、繼承、多型、介面等機制，能夠有效率地達到程式碼的共享及再利用，因此物件導向程式設計的功能不但被各式各樣的程式語言所廣泛支援，亦已形成了一門獨立的學問。而資料庫是重要、普遍且實用的資訊管理核心技術。但在另一方面，資料庫的開發與實作過程對於理解物件導向程式設計更是一個良好的契機與範例。本課程將以土木營建領域的範例出發，教導修課同學開發輔助工程資訊管理之資料庫系統，並在資料的分析處理及使用者介面的實作上導入物件導向程式設計的概念。
description.en: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) is a programming paradigm based on the concept of class and objects. With properties and methods that can describe the features of classes, a programmer can model the real world objects in an systematical way. In addition, the three important mechanisms of OOP, which are encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism, also enable a programmer to reuse and share their code easily and efficiently. Base on the Architecture/Engineering/Construction applications, this course aims to train the enrolled student for developing the basic OOP concepts, analyzing the database schemas, as well as implementing the OOP skills on information systems developments.

name.zh: 物件導向程式設計與資料庫應用

notes: 土木 106

description.zh: 本課程探討 Web 3.0 技術對商業模式的深遠影響，重點涵蓋區塊鏈、數位資產、去中心化應用（DApps）與非同質化代幣（NFTs）的實際應用。課程以理論與實務並重，協助學生掌握 Web 3.0 技術的基本概念、技術原理與商業策略，並探索數位轉型下的創新商業模式。透過案例分析與專案實作，學生將學習如何設計區塊鏈應用方案、管理數位資產、分析市場趨勢及制定商業策略，理解如何運用這些技術來重塑企業價值鏈。課程強調實作與創新思維的培養，學生將組成專案團隊，模擬現實中的應用場景，完成一項具體的 Web 3.0 商業應用專案，並於期末向業界專家進行提案展示。學生將透過此過程，培養跨領域的合作能力、問題解決能力與創新設計思維，為未來在數位轉型與科技創新的職涯發展奠定堅實基礎。
description.en: This course analyzes the impact of Web 3.0 technologies (blockchain, DApps, NFTs, digital assets) on business models. It balances theory and practice, helping students understand technical principles and business strategies for digital transformation. Students will use case studies and hands-on projects to design blockchain solutions, manage digital assets, analyze market trends, and reshape value chains. The curriculum emphasizes practical application and innovative thinking, requiring students to form teams and complete a real-world Web 3.0 project for an industry presentation. This process builds cross-disciplinary collaboration, problem-solving skills, and innovative design thinking, preparing students for careers in digital transformation and technological innovation.

name.zh: Web 3.0 商業策略與數位資產應用
name.en: Business Strategies and Digital Asset Applications in the Web 3.0 Era

notes: 1 週【停開】

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹強化學習（Reinforcement Learning, RL）的核心概念、數學基礎與主要演算法，並結合財務與投資管理的應用實例。內容涵蓋馬可夫決策過程（MDP）、動態規劃（DP）、蒙地卡羅（MC）方法、時序差分（TD）學習、策略梯度（Policy Gradient）、深度強化學習等主題，同時透過金融市場的真實案例，引導學生理解 RL 在投資組合最佳化、資產配置、避險策略、交易策略自動化等領域中的應用方式。課程採用理論與實作並重的方式，搭配 Python 程式實作與金融資料分析，協助學生逐步累積建構 RL 模型的能力。學生將學習如何定義財務問題中的狀態空間、動作空間與報酬函數，並訓練智能代理人於市場模擬環境中進行策略學習、決策與改善。本課程亦將討論強化學習在金融應用上的挑戰，例如市場隨機性、風險控管、環境非平穩性、評估困難等問題，並介紹最新的研究方向與業界實務。修讀本課程後，學生能具備基礎的強化學習能力，了解 RL 模型在 FinTech、量化投資與數位財務決策上的角色，並能在課堂專題中打造具體的 RL 金融應用原型。
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Reinforcement Learning (RL) and its applications in finance. Topics include Markov Decision Processes (MDP), Dynamic Programming, Monte Carlo methods, Temporal-Difference learning, Policy Gradient approaches, and Deep Reinforcement Learning. Through lectures and coding exercises, students will learn how to formulate financial problems within the RL framework—defining states, actions, and reward functions—and how to train agents to make sequential investment decisions.The course integrates theory with practical applications such as portfolio optimization, asset allocation, hedging strategies, and algorithmic trading. Students will gain hands-on experience implementing RL algorithms in Python and applying them to real-world financial datasets. Challenges unique to financial markets, including stochasticity, risk constraints, non-stationarity, and evaluation difficulties, will also be discussed.

name.en: Foundations of Reinforcement Learning with Applications in Finance

notes: 新聘專任教師

description.zh: 此課程在介紹 Optimal Control 的理論基礎與其應用﹐範圍從古典的早期發展到最新的進展都包括在內，其目的在使同學能具有最佳控制器設計能力。 內容包括：最佳化問題求解、線性二次調整器設計、線性二次高斯觀測器設計。此外，現代控制中常用的 loop shaping 及 loop transfer recovery 技術亦將在課程中介紹。預修課程 ： 線性控制系統 (可同時修)、工程數學
description.en: 1.	Introduction.2.	Mathematical preliminaries for optimal control.3.	Classical linear quadratic optimal control, including regulation & tracking control.4.	Observer based optimal control (LQG control). 5.	Loop shaping and LTR control.  This is a course designed for graduate students which will provide techniques that can help you to design an optimal controller for linear systems with a specific performance index. Concepts such as optimality condition, linear quadratic regulation (LQR), and linear quadratic gaussian (LQG) problem are introduced in the course. In addition, the course also includes the loop shaping concept and the loop transfer recovery (LTR) technique which are frequently used in the modern control.

description.zh: 介紹電子零組件之組成，特性以及其應用，使學生具有實用電路之分析模擬與設計應用之能力，內容涵蓋：1. 半導體物理，2. 基本主動元件 (二極體，雙極性電晶體，場效電晶體)，3. 放大器電路，4. 邏輯 (數位) 電路，5. 積體電路。
description.en: This course introduces the composition, characteristics, and applications of electronic components, enabling students to develop the ability to analyze, simulate, and design practical circuits. 1.Semiconductor physics 2.Diode, Bipolar Junction transistor, Field-effect 3.Operational amplifier 4.Digital logic circuit 5.Integrated circuit

description.zh: (1) 半導體二極體特性曲線；(2) 半導體二極體之應用：整流器，濾波器，剪波器，箝位器，倍壓器；(3) 發光二極體驅動電路；(4) 齊納二極體穩壓電路；(5) 雙極接合面電晶體之辨別與參數量測；(6) 雙極接合面電晶體輸入及輸出特性曲線；(7) 雙極接合面電晶體直流偏壓電路；(8) 共射極放大電路；(9) 射極隨耦電路；(10) 共基極定電流源電路；(11) 場效電晶體之辨別與參數量測；(12) 場效電晶體轉移及輸出特性曲線；(13) 場效電晶體直流偏壓電路；(14) 場效電晶體放大電路；(15) 整流及濾波電路；(16) 偏壓分析與設計；(17) 基本放大器 (共射，共基，共集模式，共源，共汲，共閘等); (18) 串級放大器；(19) 差動放大器。
description.en: (1)The characteristic curve of PN diode; (2)The applications of PN diode : Rectifier, Filter, Clipper, Clamper, and Voltage-doubler; (3)Light Emitting Diode drivers; (4)Zener diode for voltage regulation; (5)The identification of BJT's leads and the measurement of b parameter; (6)The input and output characteristic curves of BJTs; (7)DC biasing circuits for BJTs; (8)Common-Emitter(CE) amplifiers; (9)Emitter-follower(EF) circuits; (10)Common-Base(CB) constant current sources; (11)The identification of FET's leads and the measurement of device parameters; (12)The transfer and output characteristic curves of FETs; (13)DC biasing circuits for FETs; (14)The amplifying circuits of FETs; (15)Retifier circuit and Filter; (16)Bias analysis and design; (17)Common Emitter amplifier, Common base amplifier, Common collector amplifier; (18)Differential amplifier.

description.zh: 冷凍空調概論、基礎知識與定義、空氣熱力學、基本冷凍循環與應用分析、壓縮理論及壓縮機性能分析、冷凍空調系統組成 - 壓縮機、冷凝器、冷媒控制器、蒸發器、冷凍介質－冷媒、二次冷媒吸收劑及冷凍油、冷媒管路及配件、空調處理過程及空調維護分析。
description.en: Refrigeration & air conditioning Introduction Fundamentals & definitions Psychrometrics Basic refrigeration cycles & application analysis Compression cycle theory & performance of compressors Compression system compositions- compressor, condenser, refrigerant controls Cooling mediums- refrigerants, secondary refrigerants, absorbents, refrigeration oils. Refrigerant piping & assessories. Air conditioning processes & cycles analysis.

description.zh: 世界各區域經濟快速發展，面對高度競爭的趨勢，數位轉型是項關鍵議題。本課程的目的是使學生了解數位轉型的方法論與工具，並介紹成功案使學生可以將案例經驗及所學應用於所屬公司或企業。
description.en: With the expeditious development in regional economic activities and more competition across countries, enterprise digital transformation is an important topic. The aim of this course is to introduce students the methodology and tools for digital transformation. Case studies and experience sharing are provided in this course.

description.zh: 本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。目的二，進一步教授 ESG 及聯合國 SDGs 指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。最後，透過對於 ESG 與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en: The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

notes: 工管碩、博和管理博合開，博士班請選此課號

description.zh: 本課程主要邀請學術界或企業界的學者專家，從理論或實務的角度，經由演講介紹近代的服務與科技管理專題，促使學生更深入及廣面瞭解管理現狀或趨勢。
description.en: This seminar course invites guest speakers from well known companies to share their experiences of service and technology management and provide students the updated practices and management trends in the field.

description.zh: 自由度、(平面與空間) 運動幾何分析、彈簧、避震器、力傳遞分析、撓性、電腦輔助懸吊系統分析與設計。
description.en: Degree of Freedom, (2D and 3D) Kinematic Analysis, Springs, Dampers, Force Analysis, Compliance, Computer Aided Analysis and Design of Suspension Systems.

description.zh: 本課程將以車輛之傳動系統設計與分析為主要內容，傳動系統之定義為從動力源至驅動輪間之各項組合，其中包括離合器、加力箱、變速箱、差速箱、傳動軸與最終傳動等組合，由於每種車輛行車特性之不同，因此前述之各項組合有不同之排列方式，傳動系統設計之優劣往往影響到車輛之行車性能。本課程將從車輛行駛阻力推演出傳統系統設計之理念及方法，並針對如何發揮動力源之最佳特性，搭配良好之傳動系統設計以達到較佳之行車性能為主要教學之目的。
description.en: Introduction to the vehicle drive-train design and analysis. Topics include definition for drive-train system、clutches、transfer case、manual transmission、automatic transmission、differential gear、transmission shaft  and final driver.  Fundamentals of vehicle tractive resistance will deduce the methodology of drive-train design.  The good drive-train design will result in optimal vehicle tractive performance.

description.zh: 本課程開授之目標，在讓修習之學生能將無人機之工程技術與跨領域應用 相互融合，在工程分析面能配合跨領域應用之需求，並在應用面瞭解工程 之規範與要求。本課程內容包括無人機之飛行原理、無人機法規、無人機 飛控程控、無人機基本結構及動態、無人機通訊導航之基本工程分析技術、 及無人機應用；本課程並配合無人機業界單位之校外參訪，讓課堂所學能 與實務技術融合。本課程是以跨院合授的方式，由鐵道車輛技術研發中心、 車輛系、電子系、文化事業發展系之師資共同參與授課。
description.en: This course aims to provide students the knowledge of engineering technology and interdisciplinary application for drones. Design of drone should consider both the engineering and interdisciplinary application at the same time. A designer should consider not only engineering regulations and requirements, but also concepts of application. This course covers basic introduction of drone flight concept, regulations, manual and programmed flight operation, basic analysis of drone structures and dynamics, basic drone communication and navigation, and drone application. The industrial tour in this course helps students to realize the theoretical and practical parts of drones. This course is a joint lecture instructed by professional faculties from Railway Vehicle Research Center, Department of Vehicle Engineering, Department of Electronic Engineering, and Department of Cultural Vocation Development.

name.zh: 無人機技術與跨領域應用
name.en: Engineering Technology and Interdisciplinary Application for Drone

description.zh: 世界各區域經濟快速發展，面對高度競爭的趨勢，數位轉型是項關鍵議題。本課程將使學生了解數位轉型與優化相關趨勢與技術，並透過一些成功案例探討數位轉型對企業產生之效益。

This course will help students understand the trends and technologies related to digital transformation and optimization, and explore the benefits it brings to enterprises through successful case studies.

description.zh: 第三次數位革命中的數位構築引發了設計革命，產生了大量的建築發明和創新。設計如何使用數位製造和材料技術來校準虛擬模型和實體製品是設計領域的關鍵主題（Iwamoto，2009）。因此，該課程為學生提供了基於數位技術的明確的基於技能的指導，用於提取、開發和分析複雜幾何形狀的數據，同時促進產生合理化和可施工性的系統工作流程。該課程將透過講座和實踐教程來組織，以擴大學生的材料經驗，並透過小組專案開發獨特和具創造性的構造系統。
description.en: Digital fabrication, in the third digital revolution, has spurred a design revolution, yielding a wealth of architectural invention and innovation. How designs use digital fabrication and material techniques to calibrate between virtual model and physical artifact is the crucial theme in the design field（Iwamoto, 2009）.Thus, the course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in digital technologies for extracting, developing, and analyzing data of complex geometries while facilitating the production of a systematic workflow for rationalization and constructability. The course will be organized via lectures and hand-on tutorials to enlarge students' material experience and to develop unique and creative tectonic systems via group projects.

description.zh: 本課程之開設旨再協助學生了解質化研究典範之特質，熟悉質化訪談的相關技巧與資料分析之方法。其內容包括：質化研究之特質 、研究設計與樣本選擇、質化研究之信度、效度與研究倫理、質化訪談法與訪談經驗分享、資料分析之技巧、質化研究實例介紹，以及質化研究之寫作。
description.en: The course is designed to make a brief introduction about qualitative research. The contents include: (a) the characteristics of qualitative research ; (b)  its research design and sampling; (c) the validity, reliability and ethics; (d) the techniques  of qualitative research; and(e) the writing and evaluation of qualitative research  proposal and thesis.

notes: 開學第一周上課未出席不得加選

description.zh: 本課程名稱為 “環境與自然保育” 。它包括二大範疇：(1) 自然環境和自然資源的保育，(2) 自然環境的保存、維護、利用、復原及改良。它將教導學生下列主題：自然保育的基本概念（自然保育的定義、自然保育觀念的發展）、保育生物學（物種形成和滅絕、生物多樣性、物種保護的優先原則、生物入侵）、生態經濟學簡介（生態經濟學的原則、能量流與物質流分析）、自然保護區（自然保護區之概念、自然保護區的保護對象）、自然保育政策（國際自然保育策略、台灣的自然保育機構及相關法規）與自然保育運動（自然保育運動之發展、當前自然保育運動所關心的事）。整體而言，本課程期盼提升公民生態意識和環境覺知，使大家對環境保育做出更多貢獻。
description.en: The title of this course is “Environment and Nature Conservation”. It includes two categories: (1) conservation of the natural environment and natural resources, and (2) the preservation, maintenance, restoration and improvement of the natural environment. It will introduce to students the following themes: basic concepts of nature conservation, conservation biology, introduction to ecological economics, nature reservation, nature conservation policy, and nature conservation movement. As a whole, it aims to raise our citizens’ ecological consciousness and environmental awareness and thus enable them to make more contribution to the conservation of our environment.

notes: 自然與科學向度

description.zh: 「生活美學」是現代人依據東西方文化及各方美學的定義所推論出來的名詞，指應用於「生活」中食、衣、住、行、育、樂所體現美的內容及活動。依循相異的生活型態、社會環境，人類試圖重構生活藝術化與藝術生活化的當代美學。
description.en: “Aesthetics of living " will address the East-West cultural and aesthetic experience through series of questions that drive the discourse in contemporary life’s content and activities. Following the different lifestyles, social environment, human tries to reconstruct everyday life into contemporary aesthetics of living. This course aims to encourage students to think what is aesthetic of living, through the real life and spiritual life and concerned itself with the aesthetic problems in the lives of others.

notes: 人文與藝術向度

description.zh: 人類從尚未有文字的歷史以來，就有各種不同規模的戰爭，戰爭很吊詭的以你死或我亡，相互毀滅之態勢，爭奪「活著」的條件。古今中外，爆發戰爭的因素或為爭奪領土、權位、或為族群之戰、為意識形態之戰、或為物質資源之爭奪。在視覺影像發達的今日社會，有關戰爭的歷史影像的紀錄片與劇情片數量龐大、並有許多可觀之處。本課程將利用這些描寫戰爭影像資料，帶領同學瞭解相關戰爭與戰役爆發的歷史及其經過。
description.en: Throughout human history, even prior to written record, various types of warfare and scales of battles have existed for various purposes of domination or survival by all means of cruelty and destruction. The arousal of violent conflicts might be an attempt at fighting for territorial dominion or material resources economically or altering another species ideologically. In today's modern societies, bountiful documentaries and films concerning historical warfare have been accumulated. This course will aim at giving students a broad understanding and profound knowledge of the causes, process, and effects of significant warfare in human history with the aid of visual images in different media.

notes: 人文與藝術向度

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

notes: 社會與法治向度

description.zh: 本課程目標如下：（一）以心理學為基礎，探討人類生活各面向的知識；（二）建立學生生活行為的技能；（三）促使學生建立自己積極的價值體系。  本課程內容涵蓋人類的個體發展、學習方式、動機、情緒、態度、人格、兩性、愛情、家庭、育兒、健康管理、社會行為等生活面的相關行為。  本課程採學生中心教學法，以啟發法、小組討論、創造式發表等方式授課，藉以活潑學生的思考並增加學生上台練習的機會。
description.en: The objectives of this course are : (1)By basing on the psychology   to guide our students to discuss the variant facets of their lives. (2)To establish the students' good skills to deal with their own lives. (3)To found the students' positive value systems .  This course includes the human behaviors of individual development , learning strategies, motivations, emotion, attitudes, personality, social interaction, religious lives, love, bisexual interaction, family lives, children cultivation , and etc. This course uses the learner-centered instructing strategies. The methods of discovery learning, teams discussion, creative teaching , and etc. will be adopted, in order to excite the students to do deep thought and give them the opportunities to show their efforts and achievements themselves.

notes: 社會與法治向度

description.zh: 透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en: The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

description.zh: 研究生在教授之個別指導下，針對特定研究主題進行研究 ，並將研究成果寫成論文。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis.

description.zh: 「生活美學」是現代人依據東西方文化及各方美學的定義所推論出來的名詞，指應用於「生活」中食、衣、住、行、育、樂所體現美的內容及活動。依循相異的生活型態、社會環境，人類試圖重構生活藝術化與藝術生活化的當代美學。
description.en: “Aesthetics of living " will address the East-West cultural and aesthetic experience through series of questions that drive the discourse in contemporary life’s content and activities. Following the different lifestyles, social environment, human tries to reconstruct everyday life into contemporary aesthetics of living. This course aims to encourage students to think what is aesthetic of living, through the real life and spiritual life and concerned itself with the aesthetic problems in the lives of others.

notes: 人文與藝術向度

description.zh: 近代以降，由於戰爭的影響，臺灣歷經不同的政權和政體，諸如大清帝國、日本帝國及中華民國等。國際局勢、殖民統治、捍衛國土等緣由引發各式各樣的戰爭，戰爭促進臺灣的政治、社會、經濟、文化等層面的變革。因此以戰爭為主軸，認知臺灣在世界地緣位置的重要性，及其引起的各種戰爭類型，呈現戰爭在近現代臺灣各時期的各種風貌。臺灣是個位於西太平洋海陸交接地區的島嶼，在世界局勢變動的潮流之中，塑造其特有的戰爭型式及內涵。再者，臺灣各地有諸多戰爭遺址，不乏國定古蹟，可以藉由戰爭史的脈絡得知戰爭遺址的歷史空間及其文化資產的重要性。
description.en: Since modern times, due to the influence of wars, Taiwan has experienced different regimes and political systems, such as the Qing Empire, the Japanese Empire, and the Republic of China. The international situation, colonial rule, and defense of the country have triggered various wars. Wars have promoted changes in Taiwan’s politics, society, economy, and culture. Therefore, taking war as the main core, understanding the importance of Taiwan's geopolitics in the world, and the types of wars it caused, presents the various features of wars. Taiwan is an island located in the land-sea junction of the Western Pacific Ocean. In the changing tide of the world situation, Taiwan has shaped its unique war style and connotation. Furthermore, there are many military relics throughout Taiwan, and there are many national historical sites. Students can learn about the historical space of military relics and the importance of their cultural assets through the context of war history.

description.zh: 這 e 世紀時代的資訊交流是一個廣泛、多樣化與複雜的；究竟人們如何透過溝通表達意識與行為，卻變成非常重要。有效的溝通程度常視為學習溝通的指標，須視事實、竟見、感覺、嗜好和經驗進行徹底地交融與分享的結果。因此，本課程重視現代社會學習「溝通管理」的二項關鍵技術包括：有效溝通結合自我學習技巧和方法：商業知識與科技結合促成人的系統互動能力，配合多媒體傳輸工具完成學習個人與團體溝通效益。課程涵概主題：1. 溝通管理定義與本質元素。2. 溝通管理內涵分析。3. 學習個人溝通能力。4. 學習溝通程序。5.e 化自我學習技巧、方法與表達能力。6. 學習全球化溝通科技工具。7. 團隊溝通的策略與協同戰術。8. 塑造整體溝通文化。
description.en: The information exchange is wide, variety, and complicated in the e-era; how do people express their consciousness and behavior turn to become very important. Effective communication degrees usually are seen as the index of learning communication. It depends on thoroughly melting and sharing with fact, opinion, feeling, interesting and experience. Therefore, "Communication Management," in this course we emphasize on two key techniques of modern society learning including: effective communication with self-learning skill and method; Business knowledge and technology with interactive ability of human system. By using multimedia transmitting tools to complete self and group learning communication and get benefit.

notes: 社會與法治向度

description.zh: 每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en: Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

notes: 社會與法治向度

description.zh: 工業化導致人口從鄉村往都市遷徙，其後果不只是在人類生活環境的改變或者是流行病學問題。都市化過程也造成自然環境改變，生物棲地減少的問題。該課程希望透過了解都市中生態棲地的改變，如何影響鳥類以及其他生物的生存，使學生意識到人類的都市化，對其他物種的衝擊。並從中思考，在便利的都會社會生活之外，該如何在都市生活中建設生態友善的校園。
description.en: Industrialization brings about domestic migration from rural areas to cities. The consequences include not only environmental changes for human life or related epidemiological issues. The process of urbanization also causes changes of natural environment, reducing habitat for wildlife. This course aims to provide students a scope to aware how habitat changes in urban areas impact birds and other wildlife and to design environment-friendly campus in additional to convenient urban social life.

notes: 自然與科學向度
