description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹中華民國憲法、探討憲政體制的運作、人民權利義務的規範及相關法律的適用等問題。期能使學生認知國家民主法治的實施狀況，維護社會秩序與個人基本權利，進而體現人性尊嚴的價值。
description.en: This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

notes: 社會與法治向度

description.zh: 本課程與台北市勞動局合作，以歷年來勞動金像獎獲獎作品以及勞動局推出的勞動紀錄片為主要影像教材，從勞動社會學的觀點出發，對當代台灣社會的勞動相關議題進行介紹。課程涵蓋範圍兼顧理論與實務，除了以影片來進行課程講授與集體討論外，並指導同學以拍攝短片的方式，於學期末呈現他們對於日常生活裡的勞動議題觀察。
description.en: This course is intended to employ the award-winning works of the "Labor Awards" and the "Labor Documentary" launched by the Department of Labor, Taipei City Government over the years to introduce labor-related issues in Taiwan society from the perspectives of labor sociology. In cooperation with the Department of Labor, teaching with film and collective discussion constitute the main methods in this course which covers both the theory and the practice dimensions. In addition, students will be instructed to make a short film to present their observation on labor issues in daily life.

name.zh: 勞動影像與當代台灣社會
name.en: Labor Images in Contemporary Taiwan Society

notes: 社會與法治向度

description.zh: 本課程之目標為：充實生活技能、提升科技素養、豐富生活內涵、培養繼續進修之興趣與能力，以奠定終身學習及生涯發展之基礎。本課程之內容為：一、電腦基本概念，二、電腦功能與應用，三、資料處理，四、資訊管理，五、資訊網路，六、電腦的聲光世界，七、電腦的安全問題與防治，八、未來的資訊社會。
description.en: This course is designed to help student to learn another skill, better understand technology, enrich there live and inspire their interests for further study. The course includes: 1.basic knowledge of computer; 2.the application of computer; 3.data procession; 4.data control; 5.internet; 6.multimedia; 7.computer virus; 8. the world of information.

notes: 自然與科學向度

description.zh: 本課程旨在提供學生對創業過程中智慧財產應用與商業模式設計的基礎理解。內容涵蓋創新研發與智慧財產權的關聯、商業模式構成要素、價值主張設計、以及智財行銷與授權策略。課程結合理論講授與案例討論，引導學生認識如何將創意構想轉化為具競爭力與保護力的營運模式，適合有志於創業、智慧財產管理或高科技產業實務應用的學生修習。
description.en: This course provides a foundational understanding of how intellectual property (IP) plays a strategic role in entrepreneurship and business model design. Students will explore key concepts such as innovation commercialization, IP protection and valuation, and the structure of business models that leverage IP assets. Through lectures, case studies, and project-based learning, students will gain insights into how to transform technical ideas into competitive and sustainable business strategies. The course is ideal for students interested in entrepreneurship, IP management, and innovation-driven industries.

name.zh: 智慧財產導向創業模式概論
name.en: Introduction to Intellectual Property-Oriented Entrepreneurship Models

notes: 創新與創業向度

description.zh: 本課程主要說明國內外營建自動化之發展內容，並學習與自動化有關之各種專業技能，使學生具備從事自動化研發工作之能力，進而提升土木與營建業之社會形象。
description.en: This course will introduce the development situations of foreigner and Taiwan's construction automations. The purpose of this course is planning to let students understanding all kinds of automation techniques in construction industry, and creates the R & D capabilities for each student. Such purpose can increase the society reputation of construction industry.

notes: 土木三甲乙合開

description.zh: 土木專論乃透過國際學者的講課，讓學生學習土木相關領域的重要知識及了解最先進之研究成果或最新開發成品。
description.en: This course will provide important knowledge and information regarding to the latest development or application on the field of civil engineering. Speakers being invited are well-known international scholars in the related area.

name.en: Civil Engineering Colloquy on Special Topics b

notes: 土木一甲乙合開  土木 5F 電化教室

description.zh: 性、性別是人類與生俱來的課題，其與各時代之政治體系、法律規範及社會變遷有密不可分的關係法律中的性別議題，既是法律問題也是社會問題，需要結合法律領域與社會領域的知識，作跨領域教學與學習。本課程配合性別平等教育政策趨勢，分就不同面向的法律規範中的相關性別議題，來讓學生了解近年來性別平等之相關法律意涵希望能在認知、情意、行動等層面，讓學生習得正確的性別權利意識，進而在國家公私領域中運用相關知識落實性別平等，以促進多元文化之下兩性平權發展。
description.en: Sex and gender are inherent issues of human beings, and they are inseparable from the political system, legal norms and social changes of all ages. Gender issues in the law are both legal and social issues and need to be combined with the legal field and society Domain knowledge for cross-domain teaching and learning.This course is in line with the gender equality education policy trend, and divides the relevant gender issues in different aspects of legal norms to let students understand the relevant legal implications of gender equality in recent years. Hopefully, students can learn from the levels of cognition, affection, and action. Correct awareness of gender rights, and then apply relevant knowledge to implement gender equality in the public and private sectors of the country, so as to promote the development of gender equality under multiculturalism.

notes: 社會與法治向度

description.zh: 中國的崛起正在改變全球的政治、經濟和文化，而台灣與港澳都是已然成型的大中華經濟圈成員，吾人必須要趁早了解中國市場崛起的原因，並開始作好準備。 本課程帶領學生深入瞭解中國崛起的背景、所代表的意義、以及如何去面對隨之而來的新挑戰。課程中並將描繪出世界的未來走向、美國霸權的逐日衰退、和各種產業即將面臨的威脅 / 挑戰 / 機遇。 中國已經成為世界最大的經濟體，未來台灣的企業、經濟前景、甚至個人生活都會感受到巨大的衝擊。中國的經濟成長何以會影響到所有的全球性產業和消費者，並分析許多工作即將面臨的威脅。 本課程由總體宏觀角度出發，逐步進入細部剖析，期末再以全球觀點回顧大中華經濟圈的發展，並對未來趨勢提出分析。
description.en: This is an introductory level course on the rise of China as a major power and the emergence of the Greater China Economic Circle. Through intensive reading and in-class discussion, the students are expected to gain an in-depth understanding of the developmental causes, path, and trajectory of the GCEC.Both positive and negative factors will be critically examined in the assigned readings. The role of Taiwan in the development of GCEC will also be reviewed.

notes: 社會與法治向度

description.zh: 民主政治為法治政治，凡政府各項施政均需有法令依據。行政法，乃是國家各行政機關所適用之各種法令規章之總稱，其內容含蓋國家行政機關之組織、職權、作用、程序及爭訟等事項之法規，範圍至為廣泛，且與人民之權利、義務息息相關。本課程將以系統化、生動化，並輔以實例之方式講授，以啟發同學學習興趣。同學修習本課程，除可增進法治知能與素養外，並可對日常生活之權益維護有重大裨益。
description.en: Democracy is regarded as rule by law nowadays. All official policies that are implemented by government must be based on law. Administrative law is a general term of all kinds of regulations and laws that are suitable for administrative organizations. The content includes of administrative organization in this country. The course serves as extensive rules that are related to people is rights and obligations. The principle emphasis of the course is on the systematic instruction with specific examples enlighten students learning interest, furthermore not only promoting knowledge and professional training in law but also effective in daily life.

description.zh: 「民事訴訟法」第一個部分，此部分旨在向修課同學作民事訴訟法之概括介紹，而此一介紹包含下列三個重點： 一、民事訴訟法之立法背景 二、民事訴訟法之理論 三、民事訴訟法之解釋方法 參與此部分乃理解民事訴訟法之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。第二個部分，此部分會聚焦在民事訴訟法之細節上，尤其是下列三個重點：一、對於民事訴訟法之進一步闡述二、民事訴訟法於案例事實之適用三、民法與民事訴訟法之結合於此部分課程結束時，修課同學應有能力依據民事訴訟法來處理常見之民事法律問題。
description.en: “Civil Procedure Law” the first part of this course, is aiming to give participants a general introduction to the Civil Procedure Law, and the introduction contains the following three points: 1. The legislative background of the Civil Procedure Law. 2. The theories of the Civil Procedure Law. 3. The interpretive methods of the Civil Procedure Law. Attending the part is the critical step to understanding the Civil Procedure Law and benefits participants a lot.The second part of this course, is focusing on the details of the Civil Proce-dure Law, especially the following three points: 1. Further elucidation of the Civil Procedure Law.2. Application of the Civil Procedure Law to the facts.3. Combination of the Civil Law and the Civil Procedure Law.At the end of the part, participants are supposed to be able to deal with common civil legal problems according to the Civil Procedure Law.

description.zh: 本課主要講授民法第三編物權篇的規定。相關的法律理論都會被介紹。學生將被指定閱讀教科書和法院判決。課堂參與是必要的。
description.en: This course teaches the rules of the third chapter of Civil Code. The third chapter defines property rights of our civil law system. Students will be assigned to read a textbook and several court decisions. Class participation is required.

description.zh: 本課程在使學生瞭解與企業 (工業) 相關之法律，以為未來就業時能具備基本之法律基礎。課程大綱如下：商事法之套特質、民法概述、商業登記法、公司法、票據法、保險法。
description.en: This course is set to make the students understand the concepts of laws dealing with related industrial and business, and being the base of working in the futures. It includes: 1.The Characters of business laws. 2.The presentment of civil code. 3.The business registration laws and business laws. 4.The insurance laws.

description.zh: 以講授刑法基本概念的犯罪論、罪數論及刑罰論為主軸；並輔以相關案例的檢討、分析，以使同學對於抽象的概念及學理，得以理解及適用。目的除在強化同學對維護個人、社會、國家等法益的體認外，亦在奠定學習刑法各論的基礎。
description.en: The course focuses on the introduction to the fundamental ideas of the criminal law such as the criminal theory, crime arithmetic and punishment theory. Many relevant cases are presented in the class for further discussion and analysis. The ultimate objective of the course is not only to enhance the students a deeper understanding of the rights granted to individuals, society and nations, but also to equip them with a wider knowledge base ready for a further studying on each specific section of the Criminal Law.

description.zh: 商標法係為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展所制定之法律。商標得以文字、圖形、記號、顏色、聲音、 立體形狀或其聯合式所組成，並應足以使商品或服務之相關消費者認識其為表彰商品或服務之標識，藉以與他人之商品或服務相區別。凡因表 彰自己之商品或服務，欲取得商標權者，應依該法申請註冊。本課程將兼顧實例與理論進行探討，來深化同學對於商標法的瞭解。
description.en: Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and consumers' interest, maintain fair competitions of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce.A trademark may be composed of a word, design, symbol, color, sound, three-dimensional shape or a combination thereof.A trademark as defined above shall be distinctive enough for relevant consumers of the goods or services to recognize it as identification to those goods or services and to differentiate such goods or services from those offered by others.A person who wishes to obtain trademark rights in order to distinguish its goods or services shall apply for trademark registration as provided under this Act.The discussion in the course covers theory and examples，to enhance a deeper understanding of Trademark Act for the students.

description.zh: 導引學生了解現今社會不同的科技公司所可能面對的智慧財產權訴訟相關議題，以此提高各公司對於智慧財產權之保護與運用，進而讓各科技公司在這全球化競爭的市場下，能夠更了解自己的優勢與權益。本課程將由不同的智慧財產權法律基礎開始介紹，內容包括權利取得要件與申請過程程序。透過了解基礎概念後，將此知識應用到訴訟實務上，包括各類智慧財產權法的訴訟程序問題與訴訟技巧。
description.en: To educate students about intellectual property rights litigation issues that may be faced by different technology companies in today's society in order to improve the protection and use of intellectual property rights by companies, thereby enabling technology companies to compete in a globalized marketplace. Understand their own advantages and interests. This course will start with a different legal basis for intellectual property rights, including elements of rights acquisition and application process procedures. By understanding the basic concepts, this knowledge will be applied to litigation practice, including various types of intellectual property law litigation procedures and litigation skills.

description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。
description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

name.zh: 創業 0 到 2 的思維與實作

description.zh: 課程將以體驗式教學訓練，提升學員表達技巧、舞台技巧、臨場反應。本課程主要目的在教授學生以設計思考思維與策略，運用主題式課程實戰小組簡報及個人簡報，快速釐清簡報製作及表達過程中重點，提升修課學員個人簡報製作能力及表達能力，幫助學生在未來創業及就業上以出色之個人簡報能力獲得面試者及投資者的青睞，領先於起跑點取得優勢。
description.en: The course will use experiential teaching training to improve students' expression skills, stage skills, and on-the-spot reactions. The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

name.zh: 企業最愛：高質感簡報溝通力
name.en: Corporate's Favorite: High-quality Communication and Presentation Ability

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在教授學生創新創業的實務，讓學生實際組成團隊進行創業，並有老師全程指導實踐創業，學校並提供基本創業基金與創業場地，輔導學生實際體會創業的過程。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、經營模式建立、創業財務、創業專題進行、創業競賽等。
description.en: This course is to instruct students to practice the entrepreneurship and innovation. Students will form an entrepreneurship team. Teacher will guide the students throughout the entrepreneurship processes. University will offer students initial funds and incubation assistances. Students will gain practical experiences on how to establish entrepreneurship. The contents include entrepreneurial thoughts and actions, design thinking, self-understanding, team formation, business model development, entrepreneurship finance, entrepreneurship practices, entrepreneurship contests, and so on.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為培養學生將點子成功轉化為可行性募資提案，以柏克萊新創加速營模式，培養學生新創募資相關知識及提案簡報技能。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、顧客導向產品設計、提案規劃、簡報表達、募資、行銷、創業相關法律知識等。
description.en: The primary goal of this course is to equip students with the ability to successfully transform ideas into feasible crowdfunding proposals. Using the Berkeley startup accelerator model, the course helps students develop knowledge related to startup fundraising and presentation skills for proposals. Course content includes topics such as entrepreneurial spirit, innovative thinking, self-awareness, team formation, customer-oriented product design, proposal planning, presentation skills, fundraising, marketing, and legal knowledge related to entrepreneurship.

name.zh: 矽谷新創都在用的一分鐘電梯簡報
name.en: One-minute elevator pitches used by startups in Silicon Valley

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

notes: 六週密集授課、科技大樓國際會議廳。

description.zh: 本校為強化學生的就業能力，加強學生的職場競爭力，開設「職涯講座課程」，藉由業界主管與人員介紹不同種類的工作模式，如派遣、公職、舒活族、獵人頭公司、國外企業等，提升學生對於國內外職場的認識，並進一步提升學生的就業率與競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance student’s competitive ability in the workplace. The course contents include tips of interview, self-marketing in the workplace and the planning of the career life etc. By the topics, students will be equipped with a variety of presentation skills that needed in the workplace to raise the employment rate.

notes: 六週密集授課，星期三 789 節課程。

description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。

The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

name.zh: 企業最愛：高質感簡報溝通力
name.en: Corporate's Favorite: High-quality Communication and Presentation Ability

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在教授學生創新創業的實務，讓學生實際組成團隊進行創業，並有老師全程指導實踐創業，學校並提供基本創業基金與創業場地，輔導學生實際體會創業的過程。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、經營模式建立、創業財務、創業專題進行、創業競賽等。
description.en: This course is to instruct students to practice the entrepreneurship and innovation. Students will form an entrepreneurship team. Teacher will guide the students throughout the entrepreneurship processes. University will offer students initial funds and incubation assistances. Students will gain practical experiences on how to establish entrepreneurship. The contents include entrepreneurial thoughts and actions, design thinking, self-understanding, team formation, business model development, entrepreneurship finance, entrepreneurship practices, entrepreneurship contests, and so on.

description.zh: 本校為強化學生的就業能力，加強學生的職場競爭力，開設「職涯講座課程」，藉由業界主管與人員介紹不同種類的工作模式，如派遣、公職、舒活族、獵人頭公司、國外企業等，提升學生對於國內外職場的認識，並進一步提升學生的就業率與競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance student’s competitive ability in the workplace. The course contents include tips of interview, self-marketing in the workplace and the planning of the career life etc. By the topics, students will be equipped with a variety of presentation skills that needed in the workplace to raise the employment rate.

notes: 六週密集授課，星期三 789 節課程。

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為培養學生將點子成功轉化為可行性募資提案，以柏克萊新創加速營模式，培養學生新創募資相關知識及提案簡報技能。課程內容包括：創新創業精神、創新思考、自我了解、團隊組成、顧客導向產品設計、提案規劃、簡報表達、募資、行銷、創業相關法律知識等。
description.en: The primary goal of this course is to equip students with the ability to successfully transform ideas into feasible crowdfunding proposals. Using the Berkeley startup accelerator model, the course helps students develop knowledge related to startup fundraising and presentation skills for proposals. Course content includes topics such as entrepreneurial spirit, innovative thinking, self-awareness, team formation, customer-oriented product design, proposal planning, presentation skills, fundraising, marketing, and legal knowledge related to entrepreneurship.

name.zh: 矽谷新創都在用的一分鐘電梯簡報
name.en: One-minute elevator pitches used by startups in Silicon Valley

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

notes: 六週密集授課、科技大樓國際會議廳。

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹統計分析方法於營建管理之應用，協助學生培養數據導向思維，以提升專案決策與管理效能。課程內容涵蓋問卷調查設計與信效度分析、變異數分析、複迴歸分析、因素分析及品管七大手法，並配合統計軟體進行資料處理與分析。透過案例研討與實務操作，學生將具備辨識與解決營建管理問題的能力，進而強化專案規劃、執行與控制之專業素養。
description.en: This course introduces the application of statistical analysis methods in construction management, aiming to cultivate students’ data-driven thinking and enhance their project decision-making and management effectiveness. The course covers survey design and reliability/validity analysis, analysis of variance (ANOVA), multiple regression analysis, factor analysis, and the seven quality control tools. Statistical software will be used for data processing and analysis. Through case studies and practical exercises, students will develop the ability to identify and solve problems in construction management, thereby strengthening their professional competence in project planning, execution, and control.

name.zh: 統計在營建管理之應用
name.en: Applications of Statistics in Construction Management

notes: 土木 201

description.zh: 隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各 20 位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各 20 位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 本課程將教導學生韓文字母結構、發音方法及基礎詞彙、文法與句型、韓國現況及文化等，透過文化與語言的習得，培養學生與韓籍人士溝通或在韓國生活所需要的最基本的溝通能力。
description.en: This course aims to introduce beginners to basic spoken and written skills in Korean. Students will develop basic skills with a focus on effective communication and enjoyment through listening, speaking, reading and writing. By the end of the course, students will be able to hold a simple conversation in Korean, comprehend basic Korean texts and write about their everyday lives.

name.en: Development of global perspective:  Korean II

notes: 限 30 人

description.zh: 本課程專為初學西班牙文之學生設計，毋需任何西班牙文基礎。本課程著重在學習西班牙文發音及了解基礎文法架構。課程結束前，學生將可以閱讀基本的西班牙文文句、自我介紹及西班牙文的基礎對話。
description.en: This is course is designed for first time students of Spanish. No previous knowledge is required to enroll this course. The focus of this course is to provide a basic knowledge of the pronunciation and grammatical structures of Spanish at the beginner level. By the end of this course, the student will be able to read basic texts in Spanish, self-introduce himself and start a basic conversation.

name.zh: 國際觀培養：基礎西班牙語 2 (A1 下)

notes: 限 30 人

description.zh: 本課程為日語與文化 (一) 之進階課程，提供學生養成進階日語聽說讀寫技能，並能夠面對在各種情境下，表達出適當的日語，足以應付日常生活簡單狀況。此外，並運用多媒體等工具，介紹日本文化，歷史，人文等多種面向，讓學生能更多元地了解日本，有效提升學習興趣及效率。
description.en: This course is designed for students who has basic Japanese knowledge or who passed the language course: Japanese (I) in the previous term. This course provides a comprehensive approach to developing the four basic language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) in order to cultivate your overall Japanese language ability to a level sufficient for various occasions and everyday life. In addition, using multimedia to introduce a variety of Japanese culture, history , and humanities. The students can learn more about Japan in many different perspectives, and effectively enhance interest in the learning process.

name.zh: 國際觀培養：日語與文化 (二)
name.en: Development of global perspective: Japanese Ⅱ

notes: 限 30 人，已經學過五十音 (平假名，片假名)、簡單會話

description.zh: 本課程使學生具有進階德語能力，並加強會話及閱讀能力訓練。
description.en: The focus of this course is to enable students to have intermediate German abilities and to strengthen the training or drilling of conversation and reading comprehension of the German language.

name.en: Feast for the global perspective: German II

notes: ０週【停開】

description.zh: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論
description.en: Paper Presentation of special topics on education, giving lectures, and group meeting.

notes: 博一

description.zh: 課程目標在於教授 CG 軟體於多媒體產業上的應用， 並使學生具備建置素材庫 (Game-Ready Models) 之能力。透過專案式教學，讓學生了解建模、材質、綁定、渲染的進階應用及銜接遊戲引擎的工作流程，並搭配 Unity Animator、UML、C#， 去完善模型素材在遊戲引擎中的控制呈現，讓學生具備銜接設計端與程式端的技術，並為後續客製化虛擬實境應用的素材做出準備。  CG 軟體教學將著重在視覺化程式工具的使用，讓學生利用程式思維、節點編程加速專案的進行；程式教學部分將使用 Unity Animator、C# 以完成遊戲 Assets 的設置。最終評量將以期末的專案呈現為主要評分方式。
description.en: The course objective is to teach the application of CG software in the multimedia industry and equip students with the ability to build a material library (Game-Ready Models). Through project-based learning, students will understand advanced modeling, texturing, rigging, rendering, and the workflow of integrating with game engines. Together with Unity Animator, UML, and C#, they will refine the control and presentation of model materials in game engines, enabling students to connect design and programming skills and prepare for customizing virtual reality applications.The CG software instruction will focus on the use of visual programming tools, enabling students to accelerate project progress using programming thinking and node programming. The programming instruction will use Unity Animator and C# to configure game assets. The final assessment will primarily be based on the presentation of the end-of-term project.

notes: 核心課程

description.zh: 校務研究是教育數據分析在教育場域的應用，在真實的教育場域中應用所學的教育數據分析技術，並針對所服務的教育機構，提供有科學意義且淺顯易懂的數據分析報告，以支持教育機構進行校務運作與教學活動的改善。本門課程首先讓學生認識各職能部門的核心項目及衍伸的校務研究議題；其次瞭解教育場域中因應各項校務與教學活動所出現的數據結構類型；接著教授學生使用教育場域中的真實數據，執行包括數據清理、數據調處、數據水平與垂直整併等步驟，以獨立生成有意義的數據結構；最後則聚焦在教育方案的效果分析，以及將數據分析資料視覺化，輔以淺顯易懂的數據解讀報告，增加學員對於數據分析結果的瞭解。
description.en: Institutional research is the field where the data science can apply in the education. In the educational field, institutional researchers must use their knowledge and techniques in the educational data analytics, providing the scientific report in a friendly manner to their affiliation. Those scientific report is aimed to improve the institutional operation and the teaching activities. This course would first introduce the function of each office at the university and the institution research topic those offices have interest. Then, the data structure which is commonly seen in the educational field would be introduced followed by a series of training on the data manipulation. Last, this course will teach the students how to conduct the educational program evaluation, data visualization, data analysis and the result interpretation.

name.zh: 校務研究：教育場域數據分析實作
name.en: Institutional research: the application of data science in education

notes: 核心課程

description.zh: 本課程主要透過人工智慧相關技術主題的介紹與業界實例之分享，包括：知識表達、機器學習、深度學習等，並實際運用機器學習工具如: TensorFlow、Keras、PyTorch 等，並整合校務研究資料於專題課程，參與校務分析研究：考量資安的個資議題，擬將校內部份去識別化後之資料，經過編碼變造處理後於課堂使用，以教育相關大數據進行專題實作與分析。透過分組討論以及專題實作競賽，讓學生實際應用人工智慧工具與方法於教育資料分析。
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce the technical topics and share industrial examples related to artificial intelligence, including: knowledge representation, machine learning, and deep learning. The students are required to utilize machine learning tools such as: TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch, to participate in the institutional repository research and analysis of related data in term projects. In consideration of privacy issues of personal information, the data will go through de-identification process for the usage purpose of educational big data analytics in term projects. With group discussions and project competition, students will be able to apply artificial intelligence tools and methods in educational data anlaysis.

name.zh: 應用人工智慧於教育專題製作
name.en: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Educational Data Analysis Projects

notes: 總整課程

description.zh: 本課程主要在讓學生了解鐵道號誌系統的基本原理，同時藉由此課程了解現代通訊技術的概念，以此建立對於鐵道列車的控制基本觀念。
description.en: This course mainly allows students to understand the basic principles of the railway signaling system, and at the same time understand the concepts of modern communication technology through this course, so as to establish the basic concepts of railway train control.

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生具備建築設備節能設計的專業知識與實務能力，涵蓋冷凍空調、照明、給排水、能源管理與智慧建築等領域。透過案例分析、設計計算與實務專題，學生將學習如何評估建築能效、應用節能技術與設計低碳永續建築設備系統。
description.en: This course aims to equip students with professional knowledge and practical skills in energy-efficient design for building systems. It covers areas such as HVAC, lighting, plumbing, energy management, and smart buildings. Through case studies, design calculations, and hands-on projects, students will learn how to assess building energy performance, apply energy-saving technologies, and design low-carbon, sustainable building systems.

name.en: Design of building equipment energy conservation

description.zh: 指導學生進行微學程相關研究，以培育其研發能力。每一位學生必須經指導教授選定微學程相關題目，獨立或數位同學成一組完成專題，並書寫印製。
description.en: Supervise students in conducting research related to micro-curricula to cultivate their research and development capabilities. Each student must select a topic related to the micro-curriculum under the guidance of a faculty advisor and complete the project either individually or in groups with a few classmates, followed by writing and printing a final report.

notes: 可選老師：能源系或機械系汪家昌、阮于軒

description.zh: 本課程著重於環境污染物之微量監測與分析內容，此包括有機有毒物、重金屬之儀器分析原理、化學理論及分析方法。修習本課程宜有化學基礎。
description.en: The course introduces monitoring and analysis for environment pollutants. It focuses the micro quantity analysis based on chemical theory. Modern instruments with high sensitivity will be also discussed.

name.en: Monitoring and Analysis for Environmental Pollutants

description.zh: 課程旨在引導學生在就學期間提前規劃未來的學習與發展方向，透過跨領域的專題演講與交流，學生將接觸最新的科技應用、理解永續發展的重要性，並在多元人文視野中培養創新與社會責任感。課程涵蓋： 1. 永續願景：與國際接軌，使永續成為大學社會責任的行動。 2. 科技與人文並進：透過跨領域講座，深化學生在科技與創新、智慧與文化間的連結度。 3. 深耕跨領域人才培育：課程類型將包含，講座、工作坊、企業參訪、博物館走讀、合作研究等建構跨領域人才之行動策略。
description.en: This course equips students to shape their academic and professional careers by exploring the vital intersection of technology, humanities, and sustainable development. Through an interdisciplinary framework, students will be exposed to the latest technological applications, cultivate a strong sense of innovation, and integrate social responsibility grounded in diverse humanistic perspectives. Practical aspects, such as expert speeches, company visits, workshops, and projects, are included to cultivate workplace-ready, interdisciplinary talents.

name.zh: 拓凱永續科技人文專題講座
name.en: Topkey Lecture Series on Sustainability, Technology, and the Humanities

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹高科技產業（含半導體、面板、生技與精密製造）廠房之設施管理原理與實務，涵蓋潔淨室、HVAC（暖通空調）系統、超純水與化學品供應、氣體與電力公用設施、能源效率與碳管理，以及安全與韌性設計等關鍵領域。
description.en: This course introduces the principles and practices of facility management for high-tech industries, including semiconductor, display, biotechnology, and precision manufacturing plants. It covers key areas such as cleanrooms, HVAC systems, ultrapure water and chemical supply, gas and electrical utilities, energy efficiency and carbon management, as well as safety and resilience design.

notes: 土木 208

description.zh: 課程為可程式控制基礎課程之延伸，著重於 PLC 進階應用與自動化控制系統整合。內容涵蓋電控系統設計、I/O 規劃、先進梯形圖程式撰寫、感測器與致動元件整合、氣壓控制應用、以及設備除錯與優化。透過實務導向的專題製作，使學生能利用 PLC、人機界面、工業配線與控制邏輯等技術，完成小型自動化控制系統之開發。課程強調 學、做合一，以考取勞動部機電整合丙級技術士技能檢定為主要訓練目標。
description.en: This course is an extension of the introductory programmable control course and focuses on advanced PLC applications and automation system integration. The course content includes electrical control system design, I/O planning, advanced ladder logic programming, integration of sensors and actuators, pneumatic control applications, as well as troubleshooting and optimization of equipment. Through practice-oriented project implementation, students will apply PLC programming, HMI development, industrial wiring, and control logic techniques to develop small-scale automated control systems. The course emphasizes learning by doing and aims to prepare students for passing the Level C Mechatronics Integration Technician Skill Certification administered by the Ministry of Labor.

description.zh: 本課程整合微軟 Azure Open AI 雲端服務資源，運用問題分析能力進行實作與相關應用，以企業出題學生解題 PBL 模式導入人工智慧跨域專題實作，目的在幫助學生瞭解如何運用人工智慧技術來解決現實世界中的問題。本課程透過導入人工智慧在企業管理和決策、金融、數據分析、智慧製造等領域等應用案例，並以通用人工智慧跨域應用學習模式來跨域應用至數據分析、智慧運算、智慧製造及物流、商情預測、經營管理、金融等領域。透過本課程的修習，學生將獲得實際的跨學科專題實作能力，掌握人工智慧技術的應用和發展趨勢，養成專業職能和研發實力，並培育具有創業與創新精神人才，了解產業在數位轉型中，所面臨的困難與挑戰。
description.en: This course integrates resources from Microsoft Azure's Open AI cloud services, utilizing problem analysis skills for practical implementation and related applications. It introduces an industry-proposed, student-solved Project-Based Learning (PBL) model into the interdisciplinary project implementation of artificial intelligence. The aim is to help students understand how to apply AI technology to solve real-world problems.Through the introduction of artificial intelligence applications in enterprise management and decision-making, finance, data analysis, and smart manufacturing, the course enables students to gain practical interdisciplinary project implementation skills. This course also helps students understand the difficulties and challenges faced by industries in digital transformation.

description.zh: 「金融科技創新專題實作」課程旨在結合理論與實務，培養學生於金融科技領域的創新思維與跨域應用能力。課程將引導學生運用人工智慧、大數據分析、區塊鏈、數位支付等新興技術，解決實際金融問題並發展具創新性的解決方案。透過專題導向學習方式，學生需組成團隊，從問題定義、技術選擇、原型設計到成果展示，完整經歷一個金融科技創新專案的開發流程。課程過程中將邀請業界專家進行實務分享與技術指導，並安排期中與期末專案簡報，以強化學生的表達與簡報能力。最終目標是提升學生的實作經驗與創業潛能，為未來投身金融科技相關職涯奠定堅實基礎。
description.en: This course combines theory and practice to cultivate students’ innovative and interdisciplinary skills in financial technology. It explores the application of artificial intelligence, big data analytics, blockchain, and digital payments in solving real-world financial problems. Through project-based learning, students work in teams to complete the full FinTech project lifecycle, from problem identification to prototype development and presentation. Industry guest lectures and project presentations enhance practical experience, communication skills, and readiness for careers in the FinTech sector.

name.zh: 金融科技創新專題實作

notes: 總整課程，先鋒教室

description.zh: 本課程旨在結合理論與實務，深入探究比特幣區塊鏈的核心技術、在傳統金融以及去中心化金融（DeFi）的創新應用。課程分成三大主軸：1. 技術基礎：深入解析比特幣的核心技術架構，包括共識機制、加密算法、去中心化網絡等關鍵技術原理；2. 金融生態：探討比特幣在傳統金融與去中心化金融中的創新應用，分析其對現有金融體系的潛在衝擊。結合理論與實務，研究區塊鏈技術在跨境支付、實體資產代幣化（Real World Asset Tokenization）等領域的具體應用案例；3. 專題實作：通過專題實作模組，學生將運用所學設計並開發基於比特幣區塊鏈或 DeFi 的創新應用，從需求分析、技術設計到實際開發，完成一個具實用價值的專案。專題成果將通過展示與技術審查檢視，並輔以市場分析與報告撰寫，提升學生的實務能力與創新思維。本課程不僅幫助學生掌握比特幣區塊鏈與去中心化金融的理論與技術，還著重於培養解決問題的能力，並為學生在區塊鏈與數位資產領域的職業發展奠定堅實基礎。
description.en: This course integrates theory and practice to examine Bitcoin blockchain technology and its applications in traditional finance and decentralized finance (DeFi). It introduces Bitcoin’s core architecture, including consensus mechanisms, cryptography, and decentralized networks, and explores use cases such as cross-border payments and real-world asset tokenization. Through project-based learning, students design and implement Bitcoin- or DeFi-based applications. Assessment includes technical reviews, presentations, and analytical reports, preparing students for careers in blockchain and digital asset ecosystems.

name.zh: 比特幣系統與去中心化金融專題
name.en: Bitcoin System and Decentralized Finance Projects

description.zh: 本課程旨在講授互動式廣告的規劃與製作原理，包括互動式媒體的特性、廣告製作可如何掌握、發揮互動式媒體的特性，以及建置、設計、發展、與維護互動式廣告所需的相關概念、科技與技能。本課程亦教導同學如何應用電腦影像（computer imaging）與多媒體的科技與技術，來製作互動式廣告。
description.en: This course is mainly about the planning and principles of interactive advertisement production such as features of interactive media, how can advertisement production control and develop the features of interactive media, as well as the related concepts, technology, and skills needed in order to build, design, develop, and maintain interactive advertisement. Students will learn how to use computer imaging and the technology and techniques of multi-media to make an interactive advertisement.

notes: 互動日碩、外碩和設計博班合開，一般教室，限 20 人

description.zh: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行 "系統化創新" 是企業不可或缺的競爭策略及唯一的生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地應用。本課程以 TRIZ 創新方法為基礎，詳細的介紹系統性創新理論及實務的解題手法及落實創新方法之實務應用，可以很有系統地帶領學生們拓展革新思維，有效及系統化之應用於各種產業。讓學生也有機會應用於生活問題的解決。
description.en: Nowadays, enterprises in the phase of violating competence and decreasing profit. To make it survival, enterprises need to implement a systematic innovation technique, but only few companies really understanding and implement. The aim of this course is based on the applications of TRIZ creative method in detail which including the theory of systematic innovation and application, and also leading students to learn how the TRIZ works, and practice to solve their real life and various industries problems.

name.en: The applications of TRIZ creative method

notes: 工管四甲乙、工管所合開

description.zh: 以視覺藝術為探討重點，研究藝術起源以及原始美術、民俗與大眾藝術分野。探究式覺元素和設計原理以及應用媒材、使用技巧，涵蓋素描、水彩、油畫、版畫、混合媒材、雕塑、建築，廣告、包裝、服裝設計、工業產品設計及攝影等。配合幻燈教學，使同學對於視覺藝術有整體性、概括性的認識，以奠定將來從事藝術鑑賞和研究創造之基礎。
description.en: The focus of this course is the exploration of visual arts.  Students will study the origin of art and the distinction among primitive art, folk and popular art. This course also provides students with visual elements, design principles, applied media material, and techniques including charcoal drawing, water-colored painting, oil painting, graphic art, compound material, sculpture, architecture, advertisement, packaging, fashion design, industrial design, and photography. Slide teaching is adopted to give students a comprehensive and general understanding on visual art in order to foster students to appreciate, study, and create art.

notes: 人文與藝術向度

description.zh: 本課程提供大一學生必備之英語文語言技巧，強調專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分，並整合英語文之聽、說、讀、寫之能力，提升英語文在專業領域的應用。
description.en: This course equips first-year students with essential English language skills, focusing on developing their communication abilities in specific professional fields. The content is customized to each college's discipline and integrates the four language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing), thereby enhancing the application of English in professional contexts.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文 ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐 / 應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: (1) 數值控制工具機基本概念、系統架構、程式指令等。 (2) 數控工具機的模擬操作。 (3) 切削刀具準備、設定。 (4) 工件程式撰寫：數控車床、車銑複合工具機程式設計實習 (5) 工件程式撰寫：數控五軸工具機程式設計實習 (6) 數控工具機系統裝置、適應控制系統等
description.en: (1) Numerical control machine tool basic concepts, system architecture, program instructions, etc. (2) Numerical control machine tools simulation operation. (3) Cutting tool preparation and setting. (4) Workpiece programing: CNC lathe/ mill turn center programming practice (5) Workpiece programing: CNC five-axis machine tool programing practice. (6) CNC machine tool system devices, adaptive control systems, etc.

notes: 機械三甲和機械三乙合開

description.zh: 本模組透過適切尺度與解析度的建築設計操作，引導學生培養進階的設計能力、批判意識與空間辯證思考。課程鼓勵學生投入特定的設計專長領域，採取創新且具批判性的概念生成方法，並在回應基地與脈絡時，深化材料、形式與敘事策略，使學生得以在設計過程中建立多層次的建築思辨能力。課程以工作室為主要教學形式，置於專題式設計單元中運作。學生將依據高階設計議題，提出具備概念整合度、技術成熟度與空間解析度的建築方案。為此，本課程的訓練聚焦於培養進階建築設計所需的深度與廣度，包含概念推演、空間辯證、構築策略、材料與敘事之間的整合、以及環境條件對建築設計的影響。學生將透過研究、分析、模型與原型測試、技術模擬與反覆的設計修正，在動態的設計過程中形成更具批判性與自主性的設計思考。學生亦需在整個學期中透過專業圖面、模型、文本敘事與口頭簡報等方式，清晰溝通其設計過程與成果。透過此課程，學生將能在複雜條件、多元限制與跨領域脈絡下，提出具有批判性、創新性與技術深度的建築設計方案，並培養成熟的設計判斷與面向國際的專業能力。
description.en: This module introduces students to advanced architectural design through operations conducted at appropriate spatial scales and levels of resolution. It aims to cultivate sophisticated design abilities, critical awareness, and a capacity for spatial dialectical thinking. Students are encouraged to engage with a specific area of design specialism, adopting innovative and critically informed approaches to conceptual generation, while deepening their understanding of material, formal, and narrative strategies in response to site and context. Through this process, they develop a multilayered architectural reasoning within their design work.Delivered within a studio setting and situated in specialist design units, the module requires students to address high-level design agendas and propose architectural schemes that demonstrate conceptual coherence, technical maturity, and spatial resolution. The training emphasises both the depth and breadth required for advanced architectural design, i

description.zh: 總課程目標：在學員原有專業基礎上，增加其深度與廣度，包含自實質與非實質環境之探討與實踐等之能力。課程目標：透過設計課題培養自實質至非實質環境與實踐之總體操作能力，其深度與廣度將是評價判準。課程概要：就各學員所選定課題完成一系列設計成果及完整探討與實踐之過程書面資料，以接受目標檢驗。
description.en: Overall course objectives: To increase the depth and breadth of students’ existing professional foundation, including the ability to explore and practice in both physical and non-physical environments. Course Objective: To develop overall operational capabilities from physical to non-physical environments and practices through design projects. The depth and breadth of the design will be the criteria for evaluation. Course Overview: Each student will complete a series of design outcome and written materials on the complete discussion and practice process for the selected topic to be tested.

description.zh: 由於科技媒體技術的發展與創新，藝術與科技的關係早已密不可分，本課程主要探討新媒體藝術認知以及相關設計文化美學的議題，並藉由課堂實作讓學生更深入窺探新媒體藝術之樣貌，進而掌握新興科技與當代藝術之本質。
description.en: Because the development of technology art and media technology, the relationship between art and technology has been inseparable, this class focuses on issues related to new media art and design culture of aesthetics, and allow students to know deeper kind of new media art work by the real class work, then grasp the essence of the new technology and contemporary art.

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在教授學生機器學習、大數據等人工智慧技術，並使用在物聯網的創新與應用上。課程內容包括：人工智慧概論、大數據方法、機器學習方法、資料探勘方法、最佳化方法、物聯網概論、影音處理、雲端技術、物聯網系統實作等。
description.en: This course is to instruct students the basics of artificial intelligent methods and apply these methods to innovative applications of Internet of Things. The contents include introduction to artificial intelligence, machine learning methods, data mining methods, optimization methods, introduction to internet of things, video and audio processing, cloud computing, and innovation project implementation.

name.en: Intelligent Applications of Internet of Things

description.zh: 本課程介紹企業整合年度經營策略與財務規劃，並指導同學編製營業、生產、財務等完整預算體系，掌握各部門預算協調、預算控制方法，如彈性預算以及績效評估與差異分析實務，使大家能運用關鍵績效指標有效監控企業經營目標。
description.en: This course introduces the integration of annual business strategies and financial planning for enterprises, and guides students in developing a complete budget system for sales, production, and finance. Students will master methods for coordinating and controlling budgets across departments, such as flexible budgeting, and practical skills in performance evaluation and variance analysis, enabling them to effectively monitor business objectives using key performance indicators.

description.zh: 本課程旨在結合理論與實務，深入探究比特幣區塊鏈的核心技術、在傳統金融以及去中心化金融（DeFi）的創新應用。課程分成三大主軸：1. 技術基礎：深入解析比特幣的核心技術架構，包括共識機制、加密算法、去中心化網絡等關鍵技術原理；2. 金融生態：探討比特幣在傳統金融與去中心化金融中的創新應用，分析其對現有金融體系的潛在衝擊。結合理論與實務，研究區塊鏈技術在跨境支付、實體資產代幣化（Real World Asset Tokenization）等領域的具體應用案例；3. 專題實作：通過專題實作模組，學生將運用所學設計並開發基於比特幣區塊鏈或 DeFi 的創新應用，從需求分析、技術設計到實際開發，完成一個具實用價值的專案。專題成果將通過展示與技術審查檢視，並輔以市場分析與報告撰寫，提升學生的實務能力與創新思維。本課程不僅幫助學生掌握比特幣區塊鏈與去中心化金融的理論與技術，還著重於培養解決問題的能力，並為學生在區塊鏈與數位資產領域的職業發展奠定堅實基礎。
description.en: This course integrates theory and practice to examine Bitcoin blockchain technology and its applications in traditional finance and decentralized finance (DeFi). It introduces Bitcoin’s core architecture, including consensus mechanisms, cryptography, and decentralized networks, and explores use cases such as cross-border payments and real-world asset tokenization. Through project-based learning, students design and implement Bitcoin- or DeFi-based applications. Assessment includes technical reviews, presentations, and analytical reports, preparing students for careers in blockchain and digital asset ecosystems.

name.zh: 比特幣系統與去中心化金融專題
name.en: Bitcoin System and Decentralized Finance Projects

notes: 總整課程，大研合開，Prof. Zucco2 小時

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在修完學期校外實習 (一) 之後，在畢業之前希望能獲得較長期體驗車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation after semester practical training (1). Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於 320 小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占 50%，輔導老師占 50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break　or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。    學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，並於開學前向各系提出申請，由本系專任老師擔任指導教師，審查計畫及評核學期成績。
description.en: This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it.

description.zh: 本課程是為了培養學生自主學習的能力，由學生主動提出自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題中，學習到思考與問題解決的能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習。學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定學習計畫，於開學前向辦公室提出申請。由專任老師擔任指導教師，審查及評核學期成績。
description.en: This course is to cultivate students' self-learning ability, and students take the initiative to put forward topics they are interested in. Students learn the ability to think and solve problems in specific topics. Teachers play the role of auxiliary guidance to guide students to learn from practice. Students formulate learning plans based on their interests and abilities, and apply to the office before the start of the semester. The full-time teacher acts as the instructor to review and evaluate the semester results.

description.zh: 為培養學生自主學習能力，透過學生自發性蒐集資料擬定研究主題，由學生自行建構課程內容，從中學習規劃與執行專案實務，培育學生在特定主題研究中，學習到團隊合作、溝通表達、思考批判與問題解決等能力，由教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。本課程的評量以書面報告或口頭報告進行。
description.en: To help students cultivate the ability of self-learning, this course allows students to engage themselves in developing course content, to plan and to execute a real-world project. "Active learning" encourages students to learn by interaction, communication, collaboration, critically analyzing arguments, and problem-solving. Instructors will assist to guide and to support in the process of learning. Students are expected to develop a process to solve real-life problems collaboratively. Written reports and oral presentations are required for course evaluation.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於 320 小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占 50%，輔導老師占 50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break　or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得短期體驗光電產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a electric-optic engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the regular semester term or the summer/winter break, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on site research. The students are urged to take an active part in the training programs as well as observe and emulate the genuine research and development operations in respective manufacturers. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours (during the regular semester term and/or the summer/winter break). After the students finish the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site.

description.en: Graduate students are required to complete specific research topic under the restriction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis. The thesis focuses on the fields in "industrial design", and includes research methodology, theory background and conclusive result or findings. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. Therefore, the course includes a training of developing research, writing and bibliographic skills.
